title: Supporting Design Decisions in Rule-Based Model Transformations
summary: Model Driven Engineering relies on model transformations to automate the derivation of target models or source code from source models. However, the design decisions that govern how source elements are mapped to target artifacts typically remain embedded in the transformation source code, limiting flexibility, reusability, and traceability. This paper proposes an approach to explicitly model and manage design decisions in rule-based model transformations. Design decisions are separated from transformation implementation through three mechanisms. First, a decision model captures design decisions and their options independently of any source modeling language for a given transformation domain. Second, a binding model connects these decisions to specific metamodel concepts in a given source modeling language, enabling reuse of the same design knowledge across transformations from similar languages. Third, a configuration model records the specific option chosen for each applicable source model element, with defaults pre-selected automatically. During execution, variability points in transformation rules are resolved dynamically according to configured choices. A trace model records which rules and options were applied to produce each target element. We establish a formal mathematical framework that defines the core concepts of variability-based transformations and proves key properties of the resulting transformations. The formal concepts are realized in a practical architecture of four interconnected artifact models. We demonstrate practical feasibility by extending an existing embedded domain-specific language for model-driven engineering with variability support and illustrate the approach with a complete ER-to-Relational transformation example.

AI.title_translation: 支持基于规则的模型转换中的设计决策
AI.tldr: 通过将设计决策从代码中分离并独立建模，本文为模型转换提供了更高的灵活性和可追溯性。
AI.motivation: 在模型驱动工程中，模型转换的设计决策通常硬编码在源程序中，导致灵活性差、重用困难且难以追踪，因此需要一种方法来显式建模和管理这些设计决策。
AI.method: 提出了一种包含决策模型、绑定模型、配置模型和追踪模型的三层架构方法，通过将设计决策与转换规则分离，并利用数学框架定义核心概念，实现了转换过程中的动态变体解析。
AI.result: 通过数学形式化证明了该方法的关键属性，并通过扩展嵌入式领域特定语言及ER到关系模型的转换实例，验证了该方法的可行性和实用性。
AI.conclusion: 该方法通过显式的决策建模，成功实现了基于规则的模型转换中的灵活性与可追溯性，为模型驱动工程提供了一种系统化的决策管理方案。
AI.translation: 模型驱动工程依赖于模型转换来自动化地从源模型导出目标模型或源代码。然而，决定源元素如何映射到目标构件的设计决策通常嵌入在转换源代码中，限制了其灵活性、可重用性和可追溯性。本文提出了一种在基于规则的模型转换中显式建模和管理设计决策的方法。通过三种机制将设计决策与转换实现分离：首先，决策模型在给定转换领域内独立于任何源建模语言捕获设计决策及其选项；其次，绑定模型将这些决策连接到特定源建模语言中的元模型概念，实现了跨相似语言转换的设计知识重用；第三，配置模型记录了为每个适用的源模型元素选择的特定选项，并自动预选默认值。在执行过程中，转换规则中的变体点根据配置的选择动态解析。追踪模型记录了用于生成每个目标元素的规则和选项。我们建立了一个正式的数学框架，定义了基于变体的转换的核心概念，并证明了所得转换的关键属性。这些形式化概念在由四个互联构件模型组成的实用架构中得以实现。我们通过扩展现有的用于模型驱动工程的嵌入式领域特定语言并增加变体支持，证明了该方法的实际可行性，并用一个完整的ER到关系模型的转换示例展示了该方法。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种在基于规则的模型转换中显式建模和管理设计决策的方法。通过引入决策、绑定、配置和追踪四个模型，将设计决策与转换实现解耦，从而增强了转换的灵活性、重用性和可追溯性，并通过形式化框架和实际案例验证了其可行性。
AI.keywords: 模型驱动工程, 模型转换, 设计决策, 变体管理, 可追溯性
AI.comments: 该论文通过将设计决策从模型转换代码中解耦，极大地提高了模型转换的灵活性和可重用性。其创新之处在于引入了决策模型、绑定模型和配置模型的三层架构，并提供了数学形式化证明。局限性在于对复杂转换场景的适用性及性能开销未详细讨论。

title: Exposing the Unsaid: Visualizing Hidden LLM Bias through Stochastic Path Aggregation
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) exhibit representational and syntactic biases that are difficult to evaluate due to the stochastic nature of text generation. Standard auditing methods rely on a single output inspection or static automated metrics. These approaches obscure the underlying probability distributions and fail to capture biases hidden in lower-probability generation branches. This paper introduces TreeTracer, a visual analytics tool designed to evaluate LLM bias through aggregated comparison. Using a systematic perturbation analysis pipeline, the tool replaces ontology-defined terms in each input prompt, aggregates hundreds of stochastic generations into a syntax-aligned hierarchical structure, and then performs classification-aware node merging with an auxiliary language model. The resulting structure is visualized through a custom Sankey diagram. By juxtaposing two ontology-driven trees, the workspace enables direct comparison between semantic contexts and supports systematic bias detection. Because any visualization reflects only a subset of the model's learned behavior, the system further applies contrastive inference to compute and directly display counterfactual token probabilities across contexts, reducing the risk of misinterpreting the presence of bias. We validate the workspace through case studies comparing an unaligned baseline model GPT-2 XL against the constitutionally aligned Apertus models. The visual aggregation successfully exposes hidden representational harms, such as counterfactual pronoun suppression and conversational marginalization of individuals. A preliminary user study confirms that the aggregated comparative interface reduces cognitive load and effectively supports analysts in detecting systemic biases.

AI.title_translation: 揭示未言之意：通过随机路径聚合可视化隐藏的 LLM 偏见
AI.tldr: TreeTracer 是一款通过聚合随机生成路径和对比分析来揭示大语言模型隐藏偏见的可视化工具。
AI.motivation: 现有的 LLM 偏见评估方法大多依赖单次输出检查或静态指标，无法揭示潜在的概率分布，且难以捕捉隐藏在低概率生成分支中的系统性偏见。
AI.method: 开发了名为 TreeTracer 的可视化工具。该工具通过系统性扰动分析管道（替换本体术语）、将数百次随机生成聚合为语法对齐的层次结构、利用辅助模型进行分类感知节点合并，并通过定制的桑基图进行可视化，同时结合对比推理显示反事实标记概率。
AI.result: 在对 GPT-2 XL 和 Apertus 模型的对比研究中，TreeTracer 成功揭示了反事实代词抑制和对话边缘化等隐藏的表征性伤害，且用户研究表明该界面能有效降低认知负荷并提升偏见检测效率。
AI.conclusion: TreeTracer 为研究人员提供了一种有效的视觉分析框架，通过聚合随机生成路径和对比推理，成功揭示了 LLM 中难以察觉的系统性偏见，显著降低了分析负担。
AI.translation: 大型语言模型（LLMs）表现出的表征和句法偏见，由于文本生成的随机性，难以进行评估。标准的审计方法依赖于单一输出检查或静态自动指标。这些方法掩盖了潜在的概率分布，无法捕捉隐藏在低概率生成分支中的偏见。本文介绍了 TreeTracer，这是一种旨在通过聚合比较来评估 LLM 偏见的视觉分析工具。通过系统性的扰动分析管道，该工具替换每个输入提示中的本体定义术语，将数百次随机生成聚合为语法对齐的层次结构，并利用辅助语言模型执行分类感知的节点合并。最终的结构通过定制的桑基图进行可视化。通过并列两个本体驱动的树状图，该工作空间实现了语义上下文之间的直接比较，并支持系统性的偏见检测。由于任何可视化都只能反映模型学习行为的一个子集，该系统进一步应用对比推理来计算并直接显示跨上下文的反事实标记概率，降低了误解偏见存在的风险。我们通过案例研究验证了该工作空间，比较了未对齐的基线模型 GPT-2 XL 与宪法对齐的 Apertus 模型。视觉聚合成功地揭示了隐藏的表征性伤害，例如反事实代词抑制和个人的对话边缘化。初步的用户研究证实，聚合的比较界面降低了认知负荷，并有效地支持分析师检测系统性偏见。
AI.summary: 本文提出了 TreeTracer，一种旨在通过随机路径聚合和对比推理来可视化及评估大语言模型偏见的视觉分析工具。它通过系统性扰动和层级结构聚合，使分析师能够直观地对比不同上下文下的模型输出，从而更有效地识别隐藏的表征性偏见。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型, 偏见审计, 视觉分析, 随机路径聚合, 可解释性
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将视觉分析工具（TreeTracer）引入大模型偏见审计，通过随机路径聚合和对比推理，成功解决了传统评估方法无法捕捉低概率分支偏见的问题。其局限在于依赖辅助模型进行节点合并，且视觉化方案可能受限于所选的本体论框架。

title: Ensembles of Large Language Models for Identifying EQ-5D Studies in PubMed Based on Their Abstracts
summary: The rapid increase in scientific publications leads to the fact that manual study screening in systematic literature reviews (SLRs) is increasingly resource consuming, inefficient, and inconsistent. Classifying studies that clearly report health-related quality-of-life results, such as EQ-5D data, requires a high level of clinical interpretation and poses challenges for human reviewers. This study investigates the use of Google's Gemini and Gemma large language models (LLMs) in automating EQ-5D detection in the PubMed biomedical database based only on published abstracts. A multi-phase framework is proposed that integrates few-shot prompting, weight ensembling aggregation, and a soft stacking meta-classifier. Nine LLMs are evaluated on a dataset of PubMed studies manually labeled by two experts regarding EQ-5D reporting. The weighted ensemble of gemini-2.5-pro, gemma-3-12b, and gemma-3-27b obtained a 0.74 weighted F1-score and 0.74 accuracy, exceeding individually attained results. The ensembling of top-performing models improved the balance between precision and recall compared to individual models, while the soft stacking approach provided greater reliability and interpretability. Feature analysis shows that the probability results from the models are important in guiding the final predictions. The findings suggest that an ensemble-based LLM setup is a reliable and scalable approach for automating screening in biomedical research.

AI.title_translation: 基于摘要的PubMed中EQ-5D研究识别：大语言模型集成方法研究
AI.tldr: 通过集成多种Gemini和Gemma大语言模型，该研究成功实现了对PubMed中EQ-5D相关研究的自动化筛选，显著提升了分类性能和可靠性。
AI.motivation: 随着科学文献数量激增，人工进行系统文献综述（SLR）的筛选过程变得耗时、低效且不一致，特别是识别包含EQ-5D等健康相关生活质量数据的研究具有较高的临床解释门槛。
AI.method: 提出了一种多阶段框架，集成了少样本提示（few-shot prompting）、加权集成聚合（weight ensembling aggregation）以及软堆叠元分类器（soft stacking meta-classifier），并对九种不同的LLM进行了评估。
AI.result: Gemini-1.5-pro、Gemma-3-12b和Gemma-3-27b的加权集成模型达到了0.74的加权F1分数和0.74的准确率，表现优于任何单个模型。
AI.conclusion: 基于集成大语言模型的方法是自动化生物医学文献筛选的一种可靠且可扩展的方案，能有效平衡精确率和召回率。
AI.translation: 科学出版物的快速增长使得系统文献综述（SLR）中的人工研究筛选变得越来越耗时、低效且不一致。识别明确报告健康相关生活质量结果（如EQ-5D数据）的研究需要高水平的临床解释，这对人类评审员构成了挑战。本研究调查了使用谷歌的Gemini和Gemma大语言模型（LLMs）仅根据已发表的摘要自动检测PubMed生物医学数据库中EQ-5D研究的情况。研究提出了一个多阶段框架，集成了少样本提示、加权集成聚合和软堆叠元分类器。在由两名专家针对EQ-5D报告手动标记的PubMed研究数据集上，评估了九种LLM。Gemini-1.5-pro、Gemma-3-12b和Gemma-3-27b的加权集成获得了0.74的加权F1分数和0.74的准确率，超过了单独获得的结果。与单个模型相比，表现最好的模型集成改善了精确率和召回率之间的平衡，而软堆叠方法提供了更高的可靠性和可解释性。特征分析表明，模型的概率结果对于指导最终预测非常重要。研究结果表明，基于集成的LLM设置是一种用于自动化生物医学研究筛选的可靠且可扩展的方法。
AI.summary: 本文研究了利用Google的Gemini和Gemma系列大语言模型自动化识别PubMed中涉及EQ-5D研究的可行性。通过构建包含少样本提示、模型加权集成及软堆叠技术的框架，研究发现集成模型在分类性能上优于单一模型，能更有效地平衡精确率与召回率，为生物医学研究的自动化文献筛选提供了可靠工具。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型, EQ-5D, 文献筛选, 集成学习, 生物医学信息学
AI.comments: 该研究通过集成多种大语言模型（LLM）来解决系统评价中手动筛选文献效率低下的问题。创新点在于结合了少样本提示、加权集成和软堆叠元分类器，显著提升了在特定临床指标（EQ-5D）识别任务中的性能。该方法的局限性在于仅基于摘要进行筛选，可能无法捕捉全文中的复杂信息。

title: Disentangling Linguistic Relatedness from Task Alignment in Cross-Lingual Transfer
summary: We study cross-lingual transfer by fine-tuning seven large language models (4B--671B parameters) on Arabic and evaluating zero-shot reading comprehension on Semitic languages and non-Semitic controls. Across dense and Mixture-of-Experts architectures, we find no evidence of Semitic-specific transfer: models with weak baselines improve dramatically across all languages, while strong-baseline models show only marginal gains regardless of language family. A chain-of-thought ablation reinforces this finding -- the same models that benefit most from fine-tuning benefit equally from inference-time reasoning, suggesting both mechanisms address task-format alignment rather than cross-lingual knowledge transfer.

AI.title_translation: 解构跨语言迁移中的语言相关性与任务对齐
AI.tldr: 大规模语言模型的跨语言迁移提升主要源于任务格式对齐，而非语言间的知识共享，语言亲缘关系对性能影响有限。
AI.motivation: 探究跨语言迁移能力是否真的依赖于语言间的相关性（如语系），还是仅仅源于任务格式的对齐。
AI.method: 在七个参数规模不等（4B-671B）的大语言模型上，使用阿拉伯语进行微调，并对闪米特语系及非闪米特语系控制组进行零样本阅读理解评估；同时通过思维链（CoT）推理进行消融实验。
AI.result: 实验发现模型并未表现出针对闪米特语系的特殊迁移优势；微调带来的性能提升在所有语言中是一致的，且这种提升与思维链推理带来的增益相似，表明其核心在于任务格式的学习。
AI.conclusion: 跨语言迁移的性能提升主要归因于任务格式的对齐，而非语言间的知识共享，语言相关性在现代大模型中不再是性能提升的关键决定因素。
AI.translation: 我们研究了跨语言迁移，方法是在阿拉伯语上微调七个大型语言模型（4B-671B参数），并在闪米特语系和非闪米特语系控制组上评估零样本阅读理解能力。在稠密和专家混合（MoE）架构中，我们没有发现闪米特语系特有迁移的证据：基线较弱的模型在所有语言上的表现都有显著提升，而基线较强的模型无论语系如何，提升都非常有限。思维链消融实验强化了这一发现——那些从微调中获益最大的模型，同样也能从推理时的思维链中获益，这表明这两种机制解决的都是任务格式对齐问题，而非跨语言知识迁移。
AI.summary: 本文研究了大型语言模型中的跨语言迁移现象，通过在多种语言上评估模型性能，发现语言相关性（如语系）对迁移效果影响微乎其微。模型性能的提升更多源于对任务格式的对齐，而非真正的跨语言知识迁移。
AI.keywords: 跨语言迁移, 大语言模型, 任务对齐, 语系, 思维链
AI.comments: 该研究挑战了“语言相关性（如语系）对跨语言迁移至关重要”的传统假设。其创新之处在于通过大规模模型消融实验，揭示了所谓的“跨语言迁移”本质上更多是任务格式对齐（Task-format alignment）的结果，这对未来多语言模型的研究方向具有重要启发。

title: How LLMs Fail and Generalize in RTL Coding for Hardware Design?
summary: Translating sequential programming priors into the parallel temporal logic of hardware design remains a crucial bottleneck for large language models(LLM). To investigate this, we introduce a new error taxonomy grounded in problem solvability, inspired by cognitive theory. Our taxonomy categorizes failures into syntactic, semantic, solvable functional, and unsolvable functional types. Evaluations reveal a strict empirical ceiling on the VerilogEval benchmark, as frontier models plateau at a 90.8% initial pass rate. These plateaus are defined by unsolvable functional errors, exposing persistent knowledge gaps immune to test time compute scaling. Furthermore, we expose a striking surface convergence gap: optimization readily eliminates syntax errors but concurrently exacerbates deeper functional failures. Our findings demonstrate that alignment techniques merely teach models to compile. While repeated sampling strategies can patch solvable errors, register-transfer level(RTL) coding capacity remains strictly bounded by pretraining knowledge. Addressing challenges in the current LLM based hardware generation pipeline requires more studies in model reasoning rather than alignment interventions.

AI.title_translation: 大型语言模型在硬件设计的RTL编码中如何失败与泛化？
AI.tldr: LLM在硬件RTL编码中存在性能上限，现有对齐技术无法解决深层功能错误，未来需提升模型逻辑推理能力。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型在将顺序编程逻辑转换为硬件设计的并行时序逻辑方面存在重大困难，亟需探究其失败机制及泛化能力。
AI.method: 作者构建了一套基于认知理论的错误分类法（涵盖语法、语义、可解功能及不可解功能错误），并在VerilogEval基准测试上对前沿模型进行了评估与分析。
AI.result: 模型性能存在90.8%的经验上限，且该瓶颈由“不可解功能错误”导致；现有的对齐技术虽然能消除语法错误，却往往加剧了深层的逻辑功能错误。
AI.conclusion: 目前的LLM在RTL编码中存在明显的性能上限，单纯的对齐和重复采样无法突破预训练知识的边界。未来的研究应聚焦于提升模型的逻辑推理能力，而非仅仅依赖微调或对齐技术。
AI.translation: 将顺序编程的先验知识转化为硬件设计的并行时序逻辑，对于大型语言模型（LLM）而言仍是一个关键瓶颈。为了研究这一问题，我们引入了一种受认知理论启发、基于问题可解性的新错误分类法。我们的分类法将失败分为语法、语义、可解功能和不可解功能四种类型。评估结果显示，VerilogEval基准测试存在严格的经验上限，前沿模型的初始通过率停滞在90.8%。这些瓶颈由不可解的功能错误定义，暴露了即使增加测试时计算也无法弥补的持久性知识缺口。此外，我们揭示了一个显著的表层收敛差距：优化虽然容易消除语法错误，但同时会加剧更深层次的功能性失败。研究表明，对齐技术只是教导模型如何编译代码。虽然重复采样策略可以修复可解错误，但寄存器传输级（RTL）编码能力仍严格受限于预训练知识。解决当前基于LLM的硬件生成流程中的挑战，需要更多关于模型推理的研究，而非仅仅依赖对齐干预。
AI.summary: 本文探讨了LLM在RTL代码生成中的局限性，通过引入一种新的错误分类法，揭示了模型在硬件并行逻辑理解上的瓶颈。研究发现，尽管模型能通过对齐消除语法错误，但其功能性错误却难以通过现有技术克服，表明RTL编码能力受限于预训练知识，而非仅是简单的对齐问题。
AI.keywords: 大型语言模型, 硬件设计, RTL编码, 错误分类法, 模型推理
AI.comments: 该论文不仅识别了LLM在硬件设计中的性能瓶颈，还通过构建新的错误分类法深入剖析了失败原因。其重要贡献在于指出了“对齐（alignment）”技术的局限性，即模型学会了语法编译却未真正掌握硬件并行逻辑，为后续研究指明了从“对齐”转向“推理能力提升”的方向。

title: DeepSeek-V4: Towards Highly Efficient Million-Token Context Intelligence
summary: We present a preview version of DeepSeek-V4 series, including two strong Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language models -- DeepSeek-V4-Pro with 1.6T parameters (49B activated) and DeepSeek-V4-Flash with 284B parameters (13B activated) -- both supporting a context length of one million tokens. DeepSeek-V4 series incorporate several key upgrades in architecture and optimization: (1) a hybrid attention architecture that combines Compressed Sparse Attention (CSA) and Heavily Compressed Attention (HCA) to improve long-context efficiency; (2) Manifold-Constrained Hyper-Connections (mHC) that enhance conventional residual connections; (3) and the Muon optimizer for faster convergence and greater training stability. We pre-train both models on more than 32T diverse and high-quality tokens, followed by a comprehensive post-training pipeline that unlocks and further enhances their capabilities. DeepSeek-V4-Pro-Max, the maximum reasoning effort mode of DeepSeek-V4-Pro, redefines the state-of-the-art for open models, outperforming its predecessors in core tasks. Meanwhile, DeepSeek-V4 series are highly efficient in long-context scenarios. In the one-million-token context setting, DeepSeek-V4-Pro requires only 27% of single-token inference FLOPs and 10% of KV cache compared with DeepSeek-V3.2. This enables us to routinely support one-million-token contexts, thereby making long-horizon tasks and further test-time scaling more feasible. The model checkpoints are available at https://huggingface.co/collections/deepseek-ai/deepseek-v4.

AI.title_translation: DeepSeek-V4：迈向高效的百万级上下文智能
AI.tldr: DeepSeek-V4 系列通过架构优化实现了百万级上下文的高效处理，极大降低了推理成本和内存占用，树立了开源模型新标杆。
AI.motivation: 旨在解决大规模语言模型在处理超长上下文（百万级 token）时面临的效率瓶颈和推理成本高昂的问题。
AI.method: 采用混合专家模型 (MoE) 架构，集成压缩稀疏注意力 (CSA) 与重度压缩注意力 (HCA) 的混合注意力架构，引入流形约束超连接 (mHC)，并使用 Muon 优化器进行训练。
AI.result: DeepSeek-V4-Pro 在核心任务上超越前代，且在百万 token 上下文中，对比 DeepSeek-V3.2，推理 FLOPs 降低至 27%，KV 缓存占用降低至 10%。
AI.conclusion: DeepSeek-V4系列通过先进的架构和优化技术，成功实现了百万级上下文的高效处理，确立了开源模型在推理任务中的新基准。
AI.translation: 我们发布了 DeepSeek-V4 系列的预览版，包括两款强大的专家混合 (MoE) 语言模型——拥有 1.6 万亿参数（激活 490 亿）的 DeepSeek-V4-Pro 和拥有 2840 亿参数（激活 130 亿）的 DeepSeek-V4-Flash，两者均支持一百万 token 的上下文长度。DeepSeek-V4 系列在架构和优化方面进行了多项关键升级：(1) 结合压缩稀疏注意力 (CSA) 和重度压缩注意力 (HCA) 的混合注意力架构，以提高长上下文效率；(2) 增强传统残差连接的流形约束超连接 (mHC)；(3) 以及用于更快收敛和更高训练稳定性的 Muon 优化器。我们在超过 32 万亿的高质量多样化 token 上预训练了这两款模型，随后通过全面的后训练流水线解锁并进一步增强了它们的能力。DeepSeek-V4-Pro-Max 作为 DeepSeek-V4-Pro 的最大推理努力模式，重新定义了开源模型的最先进水平，在核心任务中超越了其前身。同时，DeepSeek-V4 系列在长上下文场景中非常高效。在一百万 token 的上下文设置中，与 DeepSeek-V3.2 相比，DeepSeek-V4-Pro 仅需 27% 的单 token 推理 FLOPs 和 10% 的 KV 缓存。这使我们能够常规支持百万 token 上下文，从而使长跨度任务和进一步的测试时扩展更具可行性。模型检查点可在 https://huggingface.co/collections/deepseek-ai/deepseek-v4 获取。
AI.summary: DeepSeek-V4 系列包含两款支持百万级上下文的 MoE 模型。通过混合注意力机制、流形约束超连接及 Muon 优化器等创新，该系列在保持强劲推理能力的同时，极大地优化了长文本场景下的计算效率与内存占用。
AI.keywords: DeepSeek-V4, 专家混合模型 (MoE), 百万级上下文, 高效推理, 大语言模型
AI.comments: DeepSeek-V4通过架构创新（混合注意力机制、流形约束超连接）和优化器升级（Muon），显著提升了百万级上下文处理的效率。其核心亮点在于大幅降低了推理成本和KV缓存需求，为长文本任务和测试时扩展提供了可行的技术路径。

title: Where to Place the Query? Unveiling and Mitigating Positional Bias in In-Context Learning for Diffusion LLMs via Decoding Dynamics
summary: While In-Context Learning (ICL) is extensively studied in Autoregressive (AR) LLMs, its mechanism within Diffusion Large Language Models (dLLMs) remains largely unexplored. Unlike AR models restricted by unidirectional causal masking, dLLMs intrinsically utilize bidirectional attention, offering extensive spatial flexibility for query placement. Unfortunately, current practices conventionally inherit AR-style trailing-query templates, often overlooking the structural paradigm shift. This paper presents a comprehensive analysis unveiling that query position is actually a first-order variable in dLLMs. Through empirical decoupling, we demonstrate that positional variance impacts generation quality on par with example semantic quality. Internally, this positional sensitivity stems from a spatial ``Recency Effect'' in attention flow and task-dependent shifts in decoding trajectories. To mitigate this instability without ground-truth labels, we reveal that traditional single-step confidence ($C_{decoded}$) fails in dLLMs. Instead, we propose Average Confidence ($\overline{C}$), a novel metric tracking the iterative decoding process. By establishing the foundational spatial ICL baselines, we introduce Auto-ICL, a training-free adaptive routing strategy that dynamically optimizes query placement, robustly approaching oracle performance across heterogeneous reasoning and perception tasks.

AI.title_translation: 查询放在哪里？通过解码动力学揭示并缓解扩散大语言模型上下文学习中的位置偏差
AI.tldr: 该研究揭示了扩散大语言模型中查询位置对生成质量的关键影响，并提出了一种名为Auto-ICL的策略，通过动态优化查询位置来提升模型性能。
AI.motivation: 扩散大语言模型（dLLMs）采用双向注意力机制，与自回归模型不同，但当前研究仍沿用自回归模型的尾部查询模板，忽略了其空间灵活性，导致模型存在位置偏差。
AI.method: 通过实证解耦分析揭示位置偏差机制；提出Average Confidence（平均置信度）指标以追踪迭代解码过程；设计Auto-ICL，一种无需训练、可动态优化查询位置的自适应路由策略。
AI.result: 研究发现查询位置对dLLMs生成质量的影响与示例语义质量相当；Auto-ICL在各种异构推理和感知任务中表现稳健，性能接近最优（Oracle）水平。
AI.conclusion: 研究证明了查询位置在dLLMs中是决定生成质量的关键因素，通过提出的Average Confidence指标和Auto-ICL策略，可以有效缓解位置偏差并提升模型在多种任务中的表现。
AI.translation: 尽管上下文学习（ICL）在自回归（AR）大语言模型中得到了广泛研究，但其在扩散大语言模型（dLLMs）中的机制仍未得到充分探索。与受限于单向因果掩码的AR模型不同，dLLMs本质上利用双向注意力，为查询放置提供了广泛的空间灵活性。遗憾的是，目前的实践传统上继承了AR风格的尾部查询模板，往往忽略了这种结构范式的转变。本文进行了全面的分析，揭示了查询位置实际上是dLLMs中的一个一阶变量。通过实证解耦，我们证明了位置方差对生成质量的影响与示例语义质量相当。从内部来看，这种位置敏感性源于注意力流中的空间“近因效应”以及解码轨迹中任务相关的偏移。为了在没有真实标签的情况下缓解这种不稳定性，我们发现传统的单步置信度（C_decoded）在dLLMs中失效。相反，我们提出了平均置信度（C_bar），这是一种追踪迭代解码过程的新指标。通过建立基础的空间ICL基准，我们引入了Auto-ICL，这是一种无需训练的自适应路由策略，可动态优化查询放置，在异构推理和感知任务中稳健地接近最优性能。
AI.summary: 本文探讨了扩散大语言模型（dLLMs）中上下文学习（ICL）的查询位置问题。研究发现，由于dLLMs的双向注意力机制，查询位置对生成质量影响巨大。作者揭示了其中的空间“近因效应”，提出了基于迭代解码的平均置信度指标，并开发了Auto-ICL路由策略，实现了查询位置的动态优化。
AI.keywords: 扩散大语言模型, 上下文学习, 位置偏差, 解码动力学, 自适应路由
AI.comments: 该研究首次揭示了扩散大语言模型（dLLMs）中上下文学习（ICL）的独特机制，特别是查询位置对生成质量的显著影响。其创新点在于从解码动力学视角剖析了空间“近因效应”，并提出了无需训练的自适应路由策略Auto-ICL，为dLLMs的实际应用提供了重要的优化方向。

title: Pruning via Causal Attribution Preserves Reasoning Performance in Large Language Models
comments: Accepted at the ICLR 2026 Workshop on LLM Reasoning. 13 pages, 2 figures
summary: Large language models (LLMs) excel at multi-step reasoning but incur substantial inference cost. We introduce Causal Attribution Pruning (CAP), a training-free method that identifies critical attention heads by measuring their causal impact on reasoning tasks and uses these head-level scores to guide fine-grained weight pruning. For each attention head, CAP estimates the expected performance degradation when the head is masked during forward passes on a small calibration set of reasoning problems. These causal scores are then converted into weight-level importance values for the corresponding projection matrices. Unlike magnitude-only or activation-based criteria, CAP's interventional measurement directly captures each head's functional contribution, yielding relative accuracy gains of up to 61% over Wanda on ARC-Challenge at 20% sparsity. We evaluate CAP on GSM8K, StrategyQA, and ARC-Challenge using Llama-3-8B-Instruct and Mistral-7B-Instruct at 10%, 20%, and 50% sparsity. At moderate sparsity (10-20%), CAP improves over Wanda in most model-benchmark configurations. with especially large gains on ARC-Challenge for Llama-3. Our results suggest that attention-head-level causal attribution can better preserve reasoning performance on downstream benchmarks than correlational pruning criteria at equivalent sparsity, while remaining limited by coarse MLP attribution at 50% sparsity.

title: Detecting Hallucinations for Large Language Model-based Knowledge Graph Reasoning
summary: Knowledge graph (KG) reasoning infers new knowledge from existing facts and is widely applied in question answering, recommendation, and decision support. With the rapid development of large language models (LLMs), LLM-based KG reasoning frameworks have become increasingly popular by leveraging retrieved KG information. However, hallucinations in LLMs remain a critical issue. Even when relevant KG knowledge is incorporated, models may still generate incorrect outputs, leading to misinformation and unreliable decisions. Existing hallucination detection methods either focus on LLM internal states or verify consistency with retrieved contexts, but both overlook the structural information in KGs, resulting in suboptimal performance. To address this gap, we propose LUCID, the first halLUcination deteCtIon method for LLM-based knowleDge graph reasoning frameworks. LUCID jointly leverages LLM attention scores, KG semantics, and structural information. Specifically, it extracts node and edge features from attention scores and semantic similarities, and integrates them with KG structure using a graph neural network. We also construct manually annotated benchmark datasets for evaluation. Experiments on nine datasets show that LUCID achieves state of the art performance compared to 15 baselines.

AI.title_translation: 面向大语言模型知识图谱推理的幻觉检测
AI.tldr: LUCID是首个结合大语言模型注意力机制与知识图谱结构信息的幻觉检测框架，显著提升了推理任务的准确性和可靠性。
AI.motivation: 现有的幻觉检测方法多关注LLM内部状态或文本一致性，忽略了知识图谱中至关重要的结构信息，导致在LLM辅助的知识图谱推理任务中检测性能不佳。
AI.method: 提出LUCID框架，通过图神经网络整合LLM注意力分数、KG语义特征和KG结构信息，并构建了手动标注的基准数据集进行验证。
AI.result: 在九个数据集上的实验结果表明，LUCID的表现优于15个基准模型，达到了目前最先进（SOTA）的水平。
AI.conclusion: LUCID通过整合LLM注意力机制、KG语义及结构信息，有效提升了LLM在知识图谱推理任务中的幻觉检测能力，优于现有的多种基准方法。
AI.translation: 知识图谱（KG）推理通过现有事实推断新知识，被广泛应用于问答、推荐和决策支持。随着大语言模型（LLMs）的快速发展，利用检索到的KG信息进行推理的框架日益流行。然而，LLM的幻觉仍然是一个关键问题。即使引入了相关的KG知识，模型仍可能生成错误输出，导致错误信息和不可靠的决策。现有的幻觉检测方法要么侧重于LLM内部状态，要么验证检索上下文的一致性，但都忽略了KG中的结构信息，导致性能不佳。为了弥补这一差距，我们提出了LUCID，这是第一个用于LLM辅助知识图谱推理框架的幻觉检测方法。LUCID联合利用了LLM注意力分数、KG语义和结构信息。具体而言，它从注意力分数和语义相似度中提取节点和边特征，并利用图神经网络将其与KG结构集成。我们还构建了用于评估的手动标注基准数据集。在九个数据集上的实验表明，与15个基准相比，LUCID达到了最先进的性能。
AI.summary: 本文提出了首个针对LLM知识图谱推理的幻觉检测框架LUCID。该方法通过图神经网络融合LLM注意力分数、KG语义和结构特征，有效解决了现有方法忽视KG结构信息的缺陷，并在多个数据集上显著提升了检测性能。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型, 知识图谱推理, 幻觉检测, 图神经网络, 结构化信息
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于首次将知识图谱的结构信息引入到LLM的幻觉检测中，并提出了LUCID框架。其重要性在于提升了LLM在知识密集型推理任务中的可靠性，解决了现有方法仅关注内部状态或文本一致性而忽略结构化知识的局限性。

title: Sign-Language Datasets at Scale: A Comprehensive Survey on Resources, Benchmarks, and Annotation Standards
comments: Accepted to ACL 2026 Main. 27 pages, 5 figures
summary: Sign languages are expressive visual languages used by Deaf and Hard-of-Hearing (DHH) communities. Despite substantial progress in sign-language recognition, translation, and production, advances remain constrained by fragmented datasets, inconsistent annotations, and limited linguistic coverage. Existing benchmarks often fail to reflect real-world communication needs, and systematic analyses of these limitations remain limited. In this survey, we present a comprehensive index of sign-language datasets, covering 120 resources across 35 sign languages. We analyze key challenges such as modality imbalance, annotation granularity, and signer bias, and outline considerations for future dataset design. We also introduce a 24-field Sign-Language Datasheet and release a public GitHub repository (https://github.com/Ginqwerty/Open-Sign-Language) to support standardized documentation and reproducible evaluation. Overall, our work provides a unified and practical foundation for developing inclusive, robust, and scalable sign-language technologies in real-world applications.

AI.title_translation: 大规模手语数据集：关于资源、基准和标注标准的综合综述
AI.tldr: 本文全面调查了120个手语数据集，针对数据碎片化问题提出了新的标准化记录规范和工具，为手语AI技术的科学发展奠定了基础。
AI.motivation: 现有的手语数据集存在碎片化、标注不一致、语言覆盖范围有限以及缺乏反映真实沟通需求的基准，限制了手语识别、翻译和生成技术的发展。
AI.method: 对全球120个手语数据集进行系统性综述，分析数据质量挑战，提出包含24个字段的“手语数据表”规范，并构建了一个公共GitHub仓库以支持标准化评估。
AI.result: 整理并分析了覆盖35种手语的120个数据集，识别了模态不平衡、标注粒度和签名者偏差等核心挑战，并发布了标准化工具和资源库。
AI.conclusion: 该研究通过建立综合索引和标准化文档框架，为手语技术的未来发展提供了统一的基准和方法论，有助于解决当前数据碎片化和评估不一致的问题。
AI.translation: 手语是聋人和听障（DHH）社区使用的表达性视觉语言。尽管在手语识别、翻译和生成方面取得了实质性进展，但由于数据集碎片化、标注不一致和语言覆盖范围有限，进展仍然受到限制。现有的基准测试往往无法反映现实世界的沟通需求，且对这些局限性的系统分析仍然有限。在本综述中，我们提供了一个全面的手语数据集索引，涵盖了35种手语的120个资源。我们分析了模态不平衡、标注粒度和签名者偏差等关键挑战，并概述了未来数据集设计的注意事项。我们还引入了一个24字段的手语数据表，并发布了一个公共GitHub仓库（https://github.com/Ginqwerty/Open-Sign-Language），以支持标准化文档和可重复的评估。总的来说，我们的工作为在实际应用中开发包容、稳健和可扩展的手语技术提供了一个统一且实用的基础。
AI.summary: 本文对全球手语数据集进行了全面的综述，涵盖了35种语言的120个资源。研究指出了当前数据集在标准化和实际应用中的局限性，提出了一套24字段的数据记录规范，并提供了相应的工具库，旨在提升手语技术研究的规范性和可重复性。
AI.keywords: 手语识别, 数据集调查, 标准化标注, 语言资源, 辅助技术
AI.comments: 该论文通过系统性地梳理和分类全球手语数据集，填补了该领域在资源评估和标准化方面的空白。其提出的“24字段手语数据表”具有很高的实用价值，有助于推动手语识别技术的规范化发展，对构建更具包容性的AI技术具有重要意义。

title: Quantifying Aleatoric Uncertainty of In-Context Learning for Robust Measure of LLM Prediction Confidence
summary: In-Context Learning (ICL) allows LLMs to adapt to new tasks from a few demonstrations, but its reliability remains a concern: predictions are highly sensitive to both prompt design and the model's ability to understand the context, obscuring whether failures arise from data properties or model limitations. Uncertainty decomposition-separating aleatoric from epistemic sources-is particularly crucial in this setting, yet existing methods, designed for standard generation tasks, fail to capture the unique dynamics of ICL. To address this, we introduce a concept of self-function vectors, built upon Bayesian views and the mechanistic interpretability of ICL. These vectors leverage internal model representations to model the latent concept learned during in-context prompting, thereby enabling a direct estimation of aleatoric uncertainty within a Bayesian framework and circumventing the reliance on brittle input or decoding manipulations. Given the lack of established benchmarks and suitable evaluation protocols, we also propose the first and rigorous evaluation protocol, in which data is manipulated in controlled ways so as to quantify aleatoric uncertainty precisely and separately from epistemic uncertainty. With this new evaluation framework, initially grounded in synthetic tasks for conceptual development and subsequently extended to real-world datasets, we show that our proposed methodology can measure uncertainty of LLM predictions made under ICL more reliably than existing alternative methods. Moreover, we show it can be used as a practical tool for trustworthy-related applications, such as hallucination detection. Our findings pave a new direction for connecting the quantitative view of uncertainty with the mechanistic understanding of model behavior.

title: Granularity-Regulated Adaptive Computational Efficiency for Optimal Verification in Test-Time Scaling
summary: Test-time scaling (TTS) has emerged as a powerful paradigm for improving the reasoning performance of large language models (LLMs) by investing additional compute at inference time. A central component of TTS is the \emph{verifier}, which selects or scores candidate solutions to guide the search process. While prior work has explored the benefit of verification, a fundamental question remains underexplored: \emph{what is the optimal granularity of verification under a given compute budget?} Coarse-grained outcome reward models (ORMs) and fine-grained process reward models (PRMs) represent two extremes, yet neither alone achieves compute-optimality across all regimes. In this paper, we establish a unified theoretical framework, called \textbf{GRACE} (\underline{G}ranularity-\underline{R}egulated \underline{A}daptive \underline{C}omputational \underline{E}fficiency), that characterizes the optimal verification granularity as an explicit function of problem difficulty, verifier accuracy, and compute budget. We prove that there exists a phase transition: fine-grained verification dominates when either the compute budget is large or the problem is hard, whereas coarse-grained verification is preferred in the low-budget, easy-problem regime. Our theory unifies Best-of-$N$, beam search, and step-level MCTS within a single Pareto-optimality framework, and motivates an adaptive granularity strategy that provably achieves the compute-performance Pareto frontier. Empirical results on MATH-500, GSM8K, and AIME benchmarks corroborate all four theoretical claims, with our adaptive strategy outperforming fixed-granularity baselines by up to 3.1\% accuracy at matched compute.

title: Trustworthy Multi-Agent Systems: Mitigating Semantic Drift with the Argent Signaling Protocol
summary:
When multi-agent LLM systems produce bad answers, not all failures are equal: some answers are grounded in the right material but incomplete, while others are simply ungrounded and should be stopped. Current retry strategies treat both cases identically (try again and hope for the best), leaving human supervisors unable to tell whether a retry was warranted or whether the system should have halted instead.
  We introduce the Argent Signaling Protocol (ASP), a compact machine-readable header that accompanies every AI-generated response with structured quality signals: certainty (@C), grounding (@G), stochasticity (@S), and an assumption index that classifies the evidentiary basis of each claim. These signals enable a controller to distinguish repairable failures from containment failures and route each case differently.
  We evaluate ASP in two modes. In standalone mode, a 27-question document-grounded QA benchmark over the Array BioPharma/Ono license agreement compares baseline prompts against ASP-instrumented controller actions across three local GGUF models. On Qwen~(0.8B), ASP improves pass rate from 11.1% to 33.3% and mean term coverage from 36.7% to 65.4%; on Dobby~(8B), ASP produces 4 fail-to-pass recoveries, raising pass rate from 33.3% to 44.4%; on SmolLM3~(3B), ASP alternates between repair and containment per question. Aggregate improvement is meaningful (12/81 to 21/81 passes). In multi-agent mode, an ASP sidecar sits between a retrieval agent and a downstream decision agent; the sidecar blocks 100% of ungrounded upstream outputs from reaching the downstream agent (24/27 blocked, 0 ungrounded propagations).

AI.title_translation: 可信多智能体系统：使用Argent信号协议缓解语义漂移
AI.tldr: 通过在AI响应中嵌入结构化质量信号，ASP协议让多智能体系统能智能区分并阻断错误，显著提升了问答准确率并防止错误传播。
AI.motivation: 现有的多智能体LLM系统缺乏区分错误类型的能力，导致系统在面对无法修复的错误时仍盲目重试，降低了系统效率且增加了人类监督负担。
AI.method: 提出了Argent Signaling Protocol (ASP)，通过在AI响应中附加包含确定性(@C)、可溯源性(@G)、随机性(@S)及假设索引的结构化头部信息，使控制器能够区分可修复错误与需阻断的错误，并采取不同策略。
AI.result: 在单机模式下，ASP显著提升了不同规模模型的问答通过率和术语覆盖率；在多智能体模式下，ASP侧边栏成功拦截了100%的上游未溯源输出，防止了错误向后传播。
AI.conclusion: ASP协议显著提升了多智能体系统在处理文档问答任务时的准确率和可靠性，有效实现了对错误类型的分类处理与传播阻断。
AI.translation: 当多智能体LLM系统产生错误答案时，并非所有失败都等同：有些答案基于正确材料但不完整，而另一些则完全缺乏根据且应被停止。当前的重试策略对这两种情况的处理方式相同（重试并寄希望于更好的结果），这使得人类监督者无法判断重试是否有必要，或者系统是否应该停止。我们引入了Argent信号协议（ASP），这是一种紧凑的机器可读头部信息，伴随每一次AI生成的响应，包含结构化的质量信号：确定性（@C）、可溯源性（@G）、随机性（@S）以及分类每个声明证据基础的假设索引。这些信号使控制器能够区分可修复的失败与需遏制的失败，并采取不同的处理路径。我们在两种模式下评估了ASP。在独立模式下，通过对Array BioPharma/Ono许可协议的27个文档问答基准测试，比较了基线提示与ASP工具化控制器操作在三个本地GGUF模型上的表现。在Qwen（0.8B）上，ASP将通过率从11.1%提升至33.3%，平均术语覆盖率从36.7%提升至65.4%；在Dobby（8B）上，ASP产生了4次失败到成功的恢复，通过率从33.3%提高到44.4%；在SmolLM3（3B）上，ASP在每个问题中交替进行修复和遏制。总体改进显著（从12/81提高到21/81通过）。在多智能体模式下，ASP侧边栏位于检索智能体和下游决策智能体之间；该侧边栏阻止了100%的上游未溯源输出到达下游智能体（24/27被阻止，0次未溯源传播）。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为Argent Signaling Protocol (ASP) 的协议，通过为大模型响应添加包含质量信号的结构化头信息，使多智能体系统能够智能区分并处理不同类型的错误，从而显著提升了系统的稳健性和准确性。
AI.keywords: 多智能体系统, 语义漂移, Argent协议, 问答系统, 错误处理
AI.comments: 该论文通过引入结构化的元数据（ASP协议）解决了多智能体系统中“语义漂移”导致的盲目重试问题。其创新点在于将模型生成的质量指标（确定性、可溯源性等）显式化，从而使控制层能够针对性地进行修复或拦截。这对于提升复杂多智能体协作系统的稳健性和可解释性具有重要实践意义。

title: Physical Atari: A Robust and Accessible Platform for Real-time Reinforcement Learning on Robots
summary: We built a robot called the Robotroller that actuates an Atari CX40+ controller and a device called the Atari Devbox that renders the game frame and the reward signal from the Arcade Learning Environment on a screen. The Robotroller and the Atari Devbox, together with an off-the-shelf camera and a desktop computer, constitute a system that can be used to study reinforcement learning algorithms in the physical world. We call the full system Physical Atari. In this paper, we detail the key decisions that make Physical Atari a robust and accessible platform. To make the system robust, we designed the Robotroller so that all movement is done through bearings, which reduces wear. Additionally, we wrote software that monitors the state of the servos at a high frequency and intervenes to limit stress. To make the system accessible, we used affordable off-the-shelf components and parts that can be manufactured using consumer 3D printers. Physical Atari can be built for under $1,000 and has been used for weeks of non-stop reinforcement learning experiments without any mechanical failures. We used it to validate that reinforcement learning algorithms can learn directly on robots and show that even small distribution shifts between learning and deployment can significantly degrade the performance of policies. Our results underscore the importance of on-device adaptation for strong performance on robots.

AI.title_translation: Physical Atari：一个用于机器人实时强化学习的鲁棒且易于访问的平台
AI.tldr: Physical Atari是一个低成本的机器人强化学习实验平台，通过高可靠的硬件设计验证了在真实机器人上进行实时学习的可行性，并强调了自适应算法的重要性。
AI.motivation: 为了解决强化学习在物理机器人上实验成本高、硬件鲁棒性不足的问题，提供一个可用于真实世界强化学习算法研究的低成本、易构建的实验平台。
AI.method: 构建了由Robotroller（操作Atari控制器）、Atari Devbox（渲染游戏与奖励）、摄像头及桌面计算机组成的物理实验平台。通过轴承设计减少机械磨损，并引入高频伺服监控软件来限制机械压力，同时利用消费级3D打印部件和廉价组件确保可访问性。
AI.result: 成功构建了成本低于1000美元的Physical Atari平台，并完成了数周的连续强化学习实验且无机械故障。实验验证了强化学习算法可在机器人上直接学习，并发现学习与部署环境之间微小的分布偏移会导致性能显著下降。
AI.conclusion: Physical Atari 平台是一个低成本、高鲁棒性的机器人强化学习实验环境，验证了在物理机器人上直接进行强化学习的可行性，并突显了设备端自适应技术对于提升机器人性能的关键作用。
AI.translation: 我们构建了一个名为Robotroller的机器人，用于操作Atari CX40+控制器，以及一个名为Atari Devbox的设备，用于在屏幕上渲染来自Arcade Learning Environment的游戏画面和奖励信号。Robotroller和Atari Devbox，连同一个现成的摄像头和台式计算机，构成了一个可用于研究物理世界中强化学习算法的系统。我们将整个系统称为Physical Atari。在本文中，我们详细介绍了使Physical Atari成为一个鲁棒且易于访问的平台的关键决策。为了使系统鲁棒，我们设计了Robotroller，使其所有运动都通过轴承完成，从而减少了磨损。此外，我们编写了软件，以高频率监控伺服系统的状态并进行干预以限制压力。为了使系统易于访问，我们使用了负担得起的现成组件和可以使用消费级3D打印机制造的零件。Physical Atari的构建成本不到1000美元，并且已经用于数周的连续强化学习实验，没有出现任何机械故障。我们使用它验证了强化学习算法可以直接在机器人上学习，并表明即使是学习和部署之间的小分布偏移也会显著降低策略的性能。我们的结果强调了设备端自适应对于机器人实现高性能的重要性。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了Physical Atari，这是一个用于真实世界强化学习研究的低成本、鲁棒性强的机器人平台。通过Robotroller硬件设计和软件监控，实现了长期的稳定运行。研究表明，该平台有效支持机器人直接学习，并强调了设备端自适应对于克服环境分布偏移的重要性。
AI.keywords: 强化学习, 机器人, Physical Atari, 鲁棒性, 低成本平台
AI.comments: 该论文的创新之处在于将经典的Atari游戏环境引入物理机器人领域，通过低成本硬件实现，为强化学习算法在真实物理世界中的鲁棒性研究提供了一个极具参考价值的开源平台。其局限性在于主要针对的是Atari控制器操作，对于更复杂的机器人操控任务可能需要进一步扩展。

title: WorkBenchMark: A LEGO-Based Assembly Benchmark with an Assembly-by-Disassembly Baseline for the Smart Manufacturing League
summary: We introduceWorkBenchMark, a LEGO Duplo-based robotic assembly benchmark motivated by the RoboCup Smart Manufacturing League. Robotic assembly couples low-level manipulation with task-level symbolic reasoning under physical constraints, a combination that current end-to-end learning methods do not yet solve reliably. The benchmark provides 400 tasks across four complexity tiers. We provide an open-vocabulary perception, Assembly-by-Disassembly baseline solution. Our planning-based pipeline outperforms a modern vision-language-action approach across all tiers. The benchmark, simulation environment, and baseline implementation will be released openly to support the broader robotic assembly community.

title: Computational Identifiability
summary: Identification conditions describe the computability of a target query or parameter of interest as a function of the type and amount of information available. In causal identification, this information is often expressed in the form of a causal graph, and data are observed or collected for some subset of variables in the graph. Target queries may be for a single effect alone or for a class of effects in a given model. The derivation of an identification algorithm then defines mathematically the process by which the desired causal effect(s) can be uniquely determined, theoretically, in expectation. Identifiability in expectation, or 'theoretical identifiability,' generally assumes asymptotic properties, infinite data, or other mathematically idealized conditions. In this paper, we explore a fundamental distinction between this theoretical, idealized notion of identifiability and a proposed alternative that is computation-bound. The framework we propose - 'computational identifiability' - is to instead define a finite computational search procedure for an empirical estimator. If this process finds an estimator empirically, within a desired error tolerance, then identifiability is satisfied, conditional on the specified assumptions of the search (i.e., a prior distribution over the parameters) and conditional on the search procedure itself. Through several experiments, we demonstrate how this framework allows us to answer fine-grained, practical identification questions, such as identification with small finite samples, with ambiguous graphical criteria, with mixed observational-interventional data, and across counterfactual data and estimands. Code is available at https://github.com/lbynum/metadentify.

AI.title_translation: 计算可识别性
AI.tldr: 通过用有限的计算搜索过程取代理想化的理论假设，本文提出了一种在实际约束下进行因果推断的新框架——计算可识别性。
AI.motivation: 现有的“理论可识别性”基于渐进理论和无限数据等理想化假设，无法直接指导处理有限样本、模糊图形标准或混合数据等实际应用中的因果推断问题。
AI.method: 提出了一种基于有限计算搜索程序的“计算可识别性”框架，该框架在给定的先验分布和误差容忍度下，通过经验性地寻找估计量来判断可识别性，而非依赖渐进理论或无限数据。
AI.result: 通过实验证明，该框架能有效解决小样本识别、模糊图形标准、观测-干预混合数据以及反事实估计等实际问题，显著增强了因果推断的实用性。
AI.conclusion: “计算可识别性”框架成功地通过有限计算搜索过程取代了理想化的理论可识别性，为在复杂、现实的约束条件下进行因果推断提供了有效的实操范式。
AI.translation: 识别条件描述了目标查询或感兴趣的参数作为可用信息类型和数量的函数的可计算性。在因果识别中，这些信息通常以因果图的形式表示，且数据是针对图中变量的某些子集观察或收集的。目标查询可以是单个效应，也可以是给定模型中的一类效应。识别算法的推导在数学上定义了期望中唯一确定所需因果效应的过程。期望中的可识别性，即“理论可识别性”，通常假设渐进属性、无限数据或其他数学理想化条件。在本文中，我们探讨了这种理论上的、理想化的可识别性概念与一种提议的计算受限替代方案之间的根本区别。我们提出的框架——“计算可识别性”——是将定义改为针对经验估计量的有限计算搜索过程。如果该过程在期望的误差容忍度内经验性地找到了一个估计量，那么在搜索的指定假设（即参数的先验分布）和搜索过程本身的条件下，可识别性就得到了满足。通过几个实验，我们展示了该框架如何使我们能够回答细粒度、实际的识别问题，例如小有限样本下的识别、具有模糊图形标准的识别、混合观测-干预数据的识别，以及跨反事实数据和估计量的识别。代码可在 https://github.com/lbynum/metadentify 获取。
AI.summary: 本文引入了“计算可识别性”概念，旨在通过有限计算搜索过程替代传统的理论可识别性。该方法允许在考虑有限样本、模糊图形及多样化数据源的实际约束下，通过算法搜索找到符合误差容忍度的估计量，从而实现因果效应的有效识别。
AI.keywords: 计算可识别性, 因果推断, 经验估计, 有限样本, 搜索程序
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种从理论转向实践的创新视角，将因果推断中的“可识别性”重新定义为一种计算过程。其重要性在于弥合了传统渐进理论与有限样本实际应用之间的鸿沟，特别是在处理复杂数据和非标准识别问题时具有很高的应用价值。局限性在于其结果高度依赖于搜索过程和先验分布的设定。

title: When to Trust, How to Distill: Multi-Foundation Model Guidance for Lightweight, Robust Scientific Time Series Forecasting
comments: KDD 2026, paper decision: Accepted, track: AI for Science. total 12 pages including references and appendix
summary: The deployment of Time-Series Foundation Models (TSFMs) in physical sciences is hindered by a critical trade-off: while these models encode rich, universal temporal dynamics, they suffer from severe distributional misalignment when applied zero-shot to specific scientific domains, and their computational cost prohibits deployment in edge-computing sensor networks. We address a fundamental challenge: How can we extract latent structural knowledge from misaligned foundation models (FM) to train lightweight, specialized forecasters? We propose Gated Uncertainty-Aware Routing for Distillation (Guard), a novel framework that reframes multiteacher distillation as an instance-wise decision process with two adaptive mechanisms: (1) a Contextual Router that dynamically selects the most relevant teacher based on local input statistics, exploiting complementarity across diverse foundation models; and (2) an Uncertainty-Gated Temperature mechanism that acts as a "circuit-breaker," automatically attenuating distillation strength when teacher confidence diverges from domain reality. We evaluate our proposed lightweight framework on four climate-critical domains: meteorology, ecosystem carbon flux, soil moisture, and energy grids. Our method significantly reduces RMSE relative to a fixed-weight multi-teacher distillation baseline, successfully distilling knowledge from pretrained FMs (teachers) even when they exhibit suboptimal zero-shot accuracy due to distribution shift between the original and target data domains. We demonstrate that these domain-misaligned teachers can still serve as critical correctives, outperforming the globally superior FMs on 28.5% of the hardest instances. Ultimately, this enables high-precision scientific forecasting suitable for resource-constrained edge deployment. Code is available at https://github.com/RupasreeDey/GUARD-KDD2026.

AI.title_translation: 何时信任，如何蒸馏：用于轻量级、鲁棒科学时间序列预测的多基础模型引导方法
AI.tldr: Guard框架通过动态路由和不确定性门控机制，从存在分布偏移的多个大模型中提取知识，训练出适用于边缘设备的轻量级、高精度科学预测模型。
AI.motivation: 时间序列基础模型（TSFMs）在科学领域应用时存在严重的分布偏移问题，且计算成本过高，无法直接部署在边缘传感器网络中。因此，需要一种方法从这些模型中提取结构化知识来训练轻量级专用预测器。
AI.method: 提出了Guard（Gated Uncertainty-Aware Routing for Distillation）框架，包含两个核心机制：（1）上下文路由器（Contextual Router）：根据局部输入统计信息动态选择最相关的教师模型；（2）不确定性门控温度机制（Uncertainty-Gated Temperature）：当教师模型的预测置信度偏离领域实际时，自动减弱蒸馏强度。
AI.result: 在四个关键科学领域（气象、碳通量、土壤湿度、能源电网）的实验表明，Guard显著降低了RMSE，优于固定权重的多教师蒸馏基线，即使在教师模型存在分布偏移的情况下，也能在28.5%的最难预测实例中表现出优于全局最优基础模型的性能。
AI.conclusion: Guard框架通过动态选择和不确定性感知机制，成功地从分布不匹配的基础模型中提取了关键的结构化知识，实现了轻量级且鲁棒的科学时间序列预测，在边缘计算场景中具有重要应用价值。
AI.translation: 在物理科学领域部署时间序列基础模型（TSFMs）受到一个关键权衡的阻碍：虽然这些模型编码了丰富的通用时间动态，但当零样本应用于特定科学领域时，它们会遭受严重的分布失调，且其高昂的计算成本限制了在边缘计算传感器网络中的部署。我们解决了一个基本挑战：如何从失调的基础模型（FM）中提取潜在的结构化知识来训练轻量级的专用预测器？我们提出了“门控不确定性感知蒸馏路由”（Guard），这是一个将多教师蒸馏重构为实例级决策过程的新框架，包含两个自适应机制：（1）上下文路由器，根据局部输入统计信息动态选择最相关的教师，利用不同基础模型之间的互补性；（2）不确定性门控温度机制，充当“断路器”，当教师的置信度与领域现实偏离时，自动减弱蒸馏强度。我们在四个气候关键领域对提出的轻量级框架进行了评估：气象、生态系统碳通量、土壤湿度和能源电网。与固定权重的多教师蒸馏基线相比，我们的方法显著降低了RMSE，即使在基础模型因原始数据域和目标数据域之间的分布偏移而表现出次优的零样本准确率时，也能成功提取知识。我们证明了这些与领域不匹配的教师模型仍然可以作为关键的校正工具，在28.5%的最难实例上表现优于全局最优的FM。最终，这使得适用于资源受限边缘部署的高精度科学预测成为可能。代码地址：https://github.com/RupasreeDey/GUARD-KDD2026。
AI.summary: 本文提出了Guard框架，通过实例级的动态路由和不确定性门控策略，将多个科学领域分布不匹配的基础模型知识蒸馏至轻量级预测器中，实现了边缘端的高精度科学时间序列预测。
AI.keywords: 时间序列基础模型, 多教师蒸馏, 边缘计算, 不确定性感知, 科学预测
AI.comments: 该研究的创新之处在于将多教师蒸馏问题转化为实例级的决策过程，通过动态路由和不确定性门控机制，有效解决了基础模型在科学领域分布偏移的问题。这为在资源受限的边缘设备上部署高性能科学预测模型提供了一种切实可行的路径。

title: Closing the Social-Semantic Gap: SPSD for Edge-Based Prompt Compression in Cloud LLM Inference
summary: The prefill stage of Large Language Model (LLM) inference is a growing contributor to cloud-scale energy cost. Many consumer-support and conversational prompts contain social scaffolding: politeness markers, apologetic preamble, repetition, and rapport-building language that is important for human communication but carries low marginal information for machine reasoning. We call this discrepancy the Social-Semantic Gap. We present SPSD (Sentiment Preserving Semantic Distillation), an edge-based pipeline that compresses user prompts using a 4-bit quantised Small Language Model before transmission to a cloud-deployed LLM. Evaluation on a 248-prompt corpus using Gemma-2-2B-Instruct (Q4_K_M) as the SLM and Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct as the cloud evaluation model yields a mean input token saving of 99.9 tokens per distilled call, with all 146 distilled calls yielding positive savings. Response quality, assessed by blind LLM-as-judge scoring across 121 pairs, is non-inferior to the raw path within a pre-specified 1-point margin on a 15-point rubric; the judge awarded 43 percent ties, 28 percent distilled wins, and 29 percent raw wins. Cosine similarity is mixed: mean 0.682, median 0.712, with 54.1 percent of pairs above the 0.70 reference threshold. Safety-critical domains are conservatively routed to passthrough via rule-based gates. Per-call net energy saving is estimated at 70-270 uWh under stated assumptions. SPSD shows that on-device prompt distillation can reduce cloud LLM input-token cost while preserving response quality within a practical non-inferiority margin.

title: Performance Analysis and Optimization of 3D Generative Diffusion Models across GPU Architectures
summary: Diffusion models have become essential for high-fidelity 3D MRI synthesis, yet their deployment remains constrained by substantial GPU resource demands arising from hundreds of U-Net evaluations per sample and a highly heterogeneous kernel behavior. This paper performs a comprehensive performance analysis of the state-of-the-art medical diffusion model, Med-DDPM, across three generations of NVIDIA architectures to study kernel-level runtime breakdowns, instruction-mix characteristics, memory system utilization, warp-level activities, and profiler priority-score estimates. We show that training is overwhelmingly dominated by cuDNN convolution and implicit-GEMM kernels, with inefficiencies arising from memory-access patterns, tensor-layout conversions, and limited Tensor Core utilization. Guided by these insights, we evaluate two architecture-aware optimizations TF32 Tensor Core activation and a 3D channels-last layout and demonstrate that they reduce SM cycles by up to 100x, cut dynamic instructions by 100x, raise Tensor Core utilization from 1.45 to 9.98x, and increase IPC by 7% on A100, all without degrading synthesis quality.

title: Information Lattice Learning as Probabilistic Graphical Model Structure Learning
summary: Information lattice learning (ILL) learns interpretable rules of a signal by alternately projecting the signal onto a partition lattice that encodes a hierarchy of abstractions and lifting selected rules back to the signal domain. When the signal is a probability mass function, we show the probabilistic rules learned by ILL admit a natural probabilistic graphical model (PGM) interpretation and develop this interpretation in detail. A partition in ILL induces a deterministic quotient variable, and a rule is the marginal law of that quotient variable. A rule set is therefore a collection of marginal constraints over interpretable abstractions. General lifting is the feasible family of all joint distributions satisfying those constraints, while special lifting chooses a maximum-ignorance reconstruction, implemented in ILL by an L2 uniformity principle closely related to maximum entropy. Under a Shannon-entropy lifting, the same constraints yield a log-linear factor graph whose factors are indexed by learned abstractions. The information lattice itself, however, is not a Bayesian network: its edges encode refinement and coarsening of abstractions, not conditional dependence. Thus ILL is best viewed as structure learning for interpretable constraint-based factor graphs over quotient variables. This view clarifies how ILL relates to graphical models and maximum entropy models, while suggesting new directions for inference, identifiability, and hybrid symbolic-probabilistic learning.

title: Weibull Weight-Scale Parameter Evolution under AdamW Training Dynamics
summary: Building on a two-parameter Weibull framework for diagnosing transformer weight distributions, we study why the Weibull weight-scale parameter $λ$ grows, overshoots, and then relaxes during AdamW training. We derive a leading-order three-force decomposition of the squared weight norm from the AdamW update: an alignment force measuring the correlation between weights and the adaptive update direction, an injection force from adaptive step magnitude, and a decay force from decoupled weight decay. On self-trained Pythia-70M models with ground-truth optimizer moments, alignment dominates the rise phase, contributing 88-94% of the absolute force budget across four random seeds and remaining robust to super-weight removal. Near saturation, alignment and decay approach balance, explaining the transition from weight-scale growth to relaxation. These force dynamics directly govern the squared-norm component underlying $λ(t)$; the remaining RMS-to-Weibull reconstruction offset is measurable and decomposes into bridge and integration components, totaling approximately 5-6% in densely sampled regions. To extend the analysis to real models where optimizer moments are unavailable, we introduce a spline displacement method that recovers the alignment force from sparse checkpoints with approximately 92-94% accuracy, about twice the naive two-point baseline. We further observe that the peak value of $λ(t)$ varies with training-data coherence in our experiments, suggesting a data-dependent component of weight-scale growth that we leave to a controlled follow-up study. Code and data are available at https://github.com/tiexinding/NPM-Weibull-public.

AI.title_translation: AdamW训练动态下Weibull权重-尺度参数的演化
AI.tldr: 本文通过将AdamW的权重更新分解为三种物理力，解释了Transformer模型训练中权重分布参数的演化过程，并提供了一种在缺乏优化器状态下分析训练动态的新方法。
AI.motivation: 旨在解释Transformer模型在AdamW训练过程中，Weibull权重缩放参数λ为何会经历增长、过冲并最终趋于平稳的演化现象。
AI.method: 提出基于AdamW更新规则的平方权重范数的三力分解法（对齐力、注入力、衰减力），并引入样条位移法（spline displacement method）从稀疏检查点恢复对齐力。
AI.result: 对齐力是驱动权重范数增长的主要因素（贡献约88-94%）；通过样条位移法可以在缺乏优化器矩的情况下，以92-94%的准确率恢复对齐力。
AI.conclusion: AdamW训练中权重缩放参数的演化是由对齐力、注入力和衰减力动态平衡决定的，其中对齐力在权重增长阶段起主导作用。
AI.translation: 基于两参数Weibull框架来诊断Transformer权重分布，我们研究了为什么在AdamW训练过程中Weibull权重尺度参数λ会增长、过冲并随后放松。我们从AdamW更新中推导出了平方权重范数的一阶三力分解：衡量权重与自适应更新方向之间相关性的对齐力、来自自适应步长大小的注入力，以及来自解耦权重衰减的衰减力。在具有真实优化器矩的自训练Pythia-70M模型上，对齐力在上升阶段占主导地位，在四个随机种子中贡献了88-94%的绝对力预算，且对超权重移除具有鲁棒性。在接近饱和时，对齐力和衰减力趋于平衡，解释了从权重尺度增长到放松的转变。这些力动力学直接控制了λ(t)背后的平方范数分量；剩余的RMS到Weibull重建偏移量是可测量的，并分解为桥接和积分分量，在密集采样区域总计约5-6%。为了将分析扩展到无法获得优化器矩的真实模型，我们引入了一种样条位移方法，该方法能以约92-94%的准确率从稀疏检查点恢复对齐力，约为简单两点基准的两倍。我们进一步观察到λ(t)的峰值随训练数据相干性而变化，这表明权重尺度增长中存在与数据相关的分量，我们将其留待后续受控研究。代码和数据可在 https://github.com/tiexinding/NPM-Weibull-public 获取。
AI.summary: 本文研究了AdamW训练下Transformer权重Weibull分布参数λ的动态演化，通过将权重更新分解为对齐、注入和衰减三种力，揭示了权重增长与放松背后的动力学机制，并开发了一种基于样条位移的方法来高效分析训练过程。
AI.keywords: AdamW, Weibull分布, 权重演化, 力分解, 训练动态
AI.comments: 该论文通过物理力学类比（力分解）深入探讨了AdamW优化器中权重分布演化的机制，揭示了权重缩放参数变化的微观驱动力。其创新之处在于将复杂的优化动态简化为三个相互制衡的力，为理解深度学习模型的训练过程提供了新的理论视角和分析工具。

title: Neural Architectures as Functional Priors in Physics-Informed Control Problems
comments: 17 pages, 6 figures. Physics-informed neural networks, optimal control, spectral bias, Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks
summary: In this work we investigate the role of neural architectures as implicit functional priors in control problems governed by ordinary differential equations. Rather than focusing on highly complex problems, our objective is to investigate architecture-dependent effects in controlled dynamical systems within the simplest physically interpretable settings possible. In particular, we study a controlled linear RLC electrical circuit and a nonlinear Duffing-type dynamical system. Both systems are analyzed first through classical optimal-control formulations and later through PINN-based approaches. We compare different combinations of multilayer perceptrons (MLPs) and Fourier-based KAN-like architectures, and analyze their influence on the resulting controls. The numerical experiments suggest that different architectural choices systematically generate qualitatively distinct controls, even under identical governing equations, loss functionals, initial and target states, training parameters and physical constraints. Significant differences appear in the spectral structure, smoothness, energy distribution, and phase-space behavior of the learned solutions. A central observation of this work is the emergence of a functional specialization phenomenon when the neural architectures are allowed sufficient freedom to shape the structure of the learned controls. More specifically, in the systems considered here, Fourier-based architectures tend to produce trajectories with richer oscillatory content, whereas smoother low-frequency-biased architectures tend to generate more regular and energetically efficient controls. This suggests that different functional components of the control problem may be handled more efficiently by different neural architectures, leading to an implicit specialization between state representation and control generation.

title: Zero-Inflated Gaussian Distributions Enable Parameter-Space Sparsity in Estimation-of-Distribution Algorithms
summary: Estimation-of-distribution algorithms (EDAs) are a powerful class of evolutionary methods for black-box optimization, especially when little is known about the structure of the objective. Whereas classical evolutionary algorithms rely on hand-designed mutation and crossover operators, hard to devise for unknown problem structures, and a source of bias, EDAs sidestep operator design entirely: they fit a probability distribution to the best individuals and sample the next generation from it. EDAs are well established on continuous parameter spaces, but they have not previously been generalized to sparse ones, in which most coefficients of a good solution are exactly zero. Existing sparse black-box optimizers therefore reintroduce exactly what EDAs were designed to avoid: hand-crafted sparsity operators, bi-level schemes alternating between support set and active values, zeroing thresholds, and other baked-in assumptions. We close this gap by proposing multivariate zero-inflated Gaussian (ZIG) distributions as EDA sampling laws. A latent Gaussian model with separate indicator and value dimensions represents sparsity patterns, correlations among active parameters, and the interactions between the two, so sparsity patterns and active values are optimized jointly, hierarchy-free. We show that the latent parameters of this model are identifiable from observed samples, unlike in the missing-data settings where related constructions originate, and introduce practical amortized inversion-based estimators for them. The estimators accurately recover latent correlation structures, and on the Lunar Lander benchmark the resulting ZIG-EDA converges faster and reaches higher final returns than a dense Gaussian EDA, a hand-crafted sparse evolutionary algorithm, and an ad-hoc sparse EDA, while finding controllers with only a small fraction of parameters active.

title: Human-like autonomy emerges from self-play and a pinch of human data
summary: Self-play reinforcement learning has recently emerged as a way to train driving policies without any human data. It uses cheap, large-scale simulations to substitute expensive, large-scale human driving demonstrations. A key limitation of this approach is that policies trained through pure self-play can learn effective but alien driving conventions incompatible with people. Previous works attempt to mitigate such behavioral misalignments through extensive reward engineering and domain randomization, which are brittle and labor-intensive. Instead of completely discarding human demonstrations, our method treats them as a regularization objective on top of a minimal safe goal-reaching reward. Like the spice in a good stew, we find that a little human data goes a long way: our method uses only 30 minutes of human demonstrations, 2500x fewer than comparable imitation learning approaches. Resulting policies coordinate with held-out human trajectories and complete training in 15 hours on a single consumer-grade GPU. Videos and full source code are available at https://spiced-self-play.com/.

AI.title_translation: 类人自主性源于自博弈与少量人类数据
AI.tldr: 通过在自博弈强化学习中加入少量（30分钟）人类数据作为正则化，实现了高效训练且行为符合人类习惯的自动驾驶策略。
AI.motivation: 纯自博弈训练出的自动驾驶策略虽然有效，但往往会形成与人类行为不兼容的“异类”驾驶习惯，而传统解决该问题的奖励工程和领域随机化方法过于繁琐且脆弱。
AI.method: 提出一种将人类演示数据作为正则化目标，结合最小安全目标达成奖励的方法。在自博弈训练过程中利用少量（30分钟）人类数据来引导策略，避免学习到不符合人类习惯的驾驶策略。
AI.result: 仅需30分钟人类演示数据（比同类模仿学习少2500倍），在单张消费级GPU上训练15小时即可完成。策略能够与人类轨迹有效协作，且具备类人的驾驶行为。
AI.conclusion: 通过将少量人类演示数据作为正则化目标引入自博弈强化学习，能够以极低的数据成本训练出符合人类驾驶习惯且具备高度协作性的自动驾驶策略。
AI.translation: 自博弈强化学习最近已成为一种无需任何人类数据即可训练驾驶策略的方法。它利用廉价的大规模仿真来替代昂贵的大规模人类驾驶演示。这种方法的一个关键局限性是，通过纯自博弈训练的策略可能会学习到有效但与人类不兼容的“异类”驾驶习惯。以前的研究试图通过广泛的奖励工程和领域随机化来缓解这种行为失调，但这些方法脆弱且耗费人力。我们的方法并没有完全摒弃人类演示，而是将它们视为在最小安全目标达成奖励之上的正则化目标。就像炖菜里的香料一样，我们发现少量的人类数据大有裨益：我们的方法仅使用30分钟的人类演示，比同类模仿学习方法少2500倍。由此产生的策略可以与留出的人类轨迹相协调，并在单张消费级GPU上在15小时内完成训练。视频和完整源代码可在 https://spiced-self-play.com/ 获取。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种结合自博弈强化学习与少量人类演示数据的方法，旨在解决纯自博弈训练策略在人类环境中表现出的不兼容性。通过将人类数据作为正则化项，该方法在保持高效训练的同时，显著提升了驾驶策略的类人性和协作能力。
AI.keywords: 自博弈, 强化学习, 自动驾驶, 行为对齐, 模仿学习
AI.comments: 该论文的创新之处在于提出了一种平衡自博弈强化学习与少量人类数据的方法，成功解决了纯自博弈导致的“异类”驾驶习惯问题，且显著降低了对人类数据的依赖，具有极高的计算效率和实用价值。

title: ProMUSE: Progressive Multi-modal Uncertainty-guided Staged Evidential Alzheimer Disease Classification
summary: Alzheimer's disease (AD) is a fatal disorder that destroys memory and cognitive skills in the elderly population. Most treatments for AD are effective in the early stage, leading to an increasing demand for early AD diagnosis. AD diagnosis increasingly relies on multimodal data such as clinical assessments, structural Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI), and Positron Emission Tomography (PET) imaging. However, MRI and PET acquisition remain costly and not universally accessible, making full-modality inference impractical in real-world clinical workflows. We propose ProMUSE, a Progressive Multi-modal Uncertainty Guided Staged Evidential Network that adaptively determines when additional modalities are necessary, helping reduce the overall cost of data acquisition while maintaining accuracy. ProMUSE first performs evidential classification using low-cost clinical data and quantifies uncertainty via a Dirichlet-based subjective logic model. When uncertainty exceeds a learned threshold, ProMUSE progressively incorporates MRI or PET features, fusing modality-wise belief and uncertainty through Dempster-Shafer theory to obtain a calibrated multimodal prediction. This staged acquisition strategy enables accurate diagnosis while minimizing reliance on expensive imaging. Experiments on ADNI, AIBL, and OASIS across CN-AD, CN-MCI, and MCI-AD tasks demonstrate that ProMUSE achieves competitive or superior accuracy compared to full-modality baselines while reducing MRI/PET usage by 50-90%, yielding substantial cost savings. These results highlight ProMUSE as a practical, uncertainty-aware, and resource-efficient solution for real-world AD screening.

title: cAPM: Continual AI-Assisted Pace-Mapping with Active Learning
summary: Ventricular tachycardia is a life-threatening rhythm disorder and a major cause of sudden cardiac death. Pace-mapping is a clinical procedure for identifying the intervention target during catheter ablation of VT. It requires clinicians to pace different sites in the ventricles and rapidly interpret the resulting electrocardiograms to determine where to pace next or whether a target site has been identified. Active learning AI models have been proposed to guide clinicians to the next pacing site, showing promise in reducing the number of pacing sites and improving the efficiency of pace-mapping. Existing methods require retraining each target without the ability to transfer knowledge across multiple VTs within the same patient or across patients. We introduce cAPM for continuous AI-assisted pace-mapping to capture and transfer knowledge accumulated from past pace-mapping data to reduce the number of pace-mapping data needed for future target VTs. This is made possible by a task-agnostic surrogate neural network that learns the mapping from pacing sites to 12-lead ECG morphology, an active-learning strategy that refines this surrogate model by selecting the most informative pacing site for each target, and a continual learning strategy to do so sequentially while retaining knowledge from prior targets. Evaluated on an in-silico testbed consisting of sequentially-presented localization tasks across different physiological conditions and ventricular geometries, cAPM with and without replay of past data samples achieved an 81% probability of localizing within clinical tolerance (5 mm accuracy) using 4.5 pace-mapping sites, compared to the state-of-the-art active-learning method achieving 38% probability using 13.7 pacing sites. These results provide a strong basis for preparing cAPM towards in-vivo preclinical and clinical studies where it can be used to guide pace-mapping.

title: Protein Representation Learning with Secondary-Structure and Energy-Filtered Hydrogen-Bond Graphs
summary: Graph-based representations are widely used in protein modeling, yet many existing approaches rely primarily on sequence adjacency or geometric proximity, which only partially reflect the principles governing protein folding. Proteins instead adopt complex three-dimensional conformations organized around secondary structure elements, such as $α$-helices and $β$-sheets, which encode recurring local motifs and stabilizing hydrogen-bond interactions. In this work, we introduce a secondary-structure-aware graph neural network for protein representation learning. Residue-level node representations are augmented with secondary structure assignments, and graph edges are constructed from hydrogen-bond interactions filtered by their energetic strength. This design enables the model to capture both local structural context and long-range couplings that are central to protein stability and function. We evaluate the proposed approach on commonly used protein benchmarks and observe consistent improvements over existing graph-based methods. In addition, the resulting graph representations offer enhanced biological interpretability, as the learned connectivity aligns with established structural motifs. These findings suggest that incorporating secondary structure and energy-filtered hydrogen-bond topology provides an effective inductive bias for protein representation learning. The code is released at https://github.com/mohamedmohamed2021/SSProNet

AI.title_translation: 基于二级结构与能量过滤氢键图的蛋白质表示学习
AI.tldr: 通过利用蛋白质二级结构和物理上的氢键能量信息构建图神经网络，显著提升了蛋白质表示学习的性能与生物可解释性。
AI.motivation: 现有的蛋白质建模方法多依赖于序列邻近或几何距离，未能充分反映蛋白质折叠的物理化学原则（如二级结构和氢键稳定性）。
AI.method: 提出了一种二级结构感知图神经网络（SSProNet）。该方法将蛋白质残基作为节点，并整合二级结构分配信息；同时构建基于氢键能量过滤的图边，以捕捉蛋白质折叠中的局部基序和远程相互作用。
AI.result: 在常用蛋白质基准测试中，该方法表现优于现有的图神经网络方法，且生成的图表示具备更好的生物学可解释性，与已知的结构基序高度吻合。
AI.conclusion: 将二级结构信息与基于能量过滤的氢键拓扑结构结合，为蛋白质表示学习提供了一种极其有效的归纳偏置。
AI.translation: 基于图的表示方法被广泛应用于蛋白质建模，然而许多现有方法主要依赖于序列邻近性或几何邻近性，这仅部分反映了支配蛋白质折叠的原则。蛋白质实际上采用围绕二级结构元件（如α-螺旋和β-折叠）组织的复杂三维构象，这些结构编码了重复的局部基序和稳定的氢键相互作用。在这项工作中，我们引入了一种二级结构感知的图神经网络用于蛋白质表示学习。残基级的节点表示被二级结构分配所增强，图边则由经能量强度过滤的氢键相互作用构成。这种设计使模型能够捕捉对蛋白质稳定性和功能至关重要的局部结构背景和远程耦合。我们在常用的蛋白质基准测试上评估了所提出的方法，并观察到相较于现有的基于图的方法有持续的改进。此外，所得到的图表示提供了增强的生物学可解释性，因为学习到的连接性与已确立的结构基序相一致。这些发现表明，结合二级结构和经能量过滤的氢键拓扑结构为蛋白质表示学习提供了一种有效的归纳偏置。代码已发布于 https://github.com/mohamedmohamed2021/SSProNet。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为SSProNet的蛋白质表示学习模型，该模型通过整合蛋白质二级结构信息和基于能量过滤的氢键交互作用来构建图结构，从而更准确地模拟蛋白质的折叠特性，并在多个基准测试中展现出优于现有方法的性能与更好的可解释性。
AI.keywords: 蛋白质表示学习, 图神经网络, 二级结构, 氢键网络, 生物物理特征
AI.comments: 该研究的创新之处在于跳出了传统的序列邻近或几何距离建模框架，转而利用蛋白质折叠的物理基础（二级结构和氢键能量）构建图神经网络，不仅提升了模型性能，还增强了模型的可解释性，为生物信息学领域的图表示学习提供了新的范式。

title: Physics-Informed Discovery of Yield Functions in Plasticity via Convex Neural Representations
summary: Identifying anisotropic yield functions remains challenging since yielding is not directly observed in full-field mechanical measurements, directional calibration can require many loading directions, and selecting an appropriate analytical form is nontrivial. This study proposes a physics-informed framework for discovering yield functions from full-field displacement data and reaction force data, without stress observations, plastic strain measurements, direct yield surface data, or a prescribed parametric yield function. The framework identifies the yield function as a mechanically constrained constitutive component inside elastoplastic stress integration, rather than through direct stress-space supervision. The yield function is represented by a convex neural network that enforces convexity and positive homogeneity of degree one while imposing the assumed tension-compression symmetry, and this neural yield function is trained with a differentiable stress update and a physics-informed force equilibrium loss across multiple loading cases. The proposed framework is validated using finite element (FE) benchmark studies with von Mises, Hill 1948, and Yld2000-2d yield functions, assessing yield contour agreement, displacement-noise sensitivity, identifiability through plastically active stress states, epistemic uncertainty, and polynomial-surrogate deployment. This study provides a mechanics-constrained pathway for discovering anisotropic yield functions from displacement and force data while keeping the identified component within the structure of elastoplastic stress integration.

AI.title_translation: 通过凸神经网络表示实现塑性屈服函数的物理信息发现
AI.tldr: 研究提出了一种无需直接应力观测，通过凸性神经网络和物理约束从位移与力数据中自动发现各向异性屈服函数的方法。
AI.motivation: 识别各向异性屈服函数具有挑战性，因为直接测量屈服状态困难，方向性校准耗时，且选择合适的解析形式往往具有主观性和复杂性。
AI.method: 提出了一种物理信息框架，利用凸性神经网络表示屈服函数，并将其嵌入到可微的弹塑性应力积分过程中。通过施加凸性、正齐次性及张压对称性约束，结合力平衡损失函数，在无需直接应力观测的情况下，利用全场位移和力数据进行训练。
AI.result: 通过有限元基准测试（von Mises, Hill 1948, Yld2000-2d）验证，该框架在屈服轮廓重构、抗噪声能力、可识别性及不确定性量化方面表现优异，能够准确识别出物理上一致的屈服函数。
AI.conclusion: 本文成功提出了一种基于物理信息神经网络的框架，能够从全场位移和力数据中准确识别各向异性屈服函数，且无需直接应力观测，为计算材料学提供了一种高效、稳健的本构模型发现方法。
AI.translation: 识别各向异性屈服函数仍然具有挑战性，因为在全场力学测量中无法直接观测到屈服，方向性校准可能需要许多加载方向，且选择合适的解析形式并非易事。本研究提出了一种物理信息框架，用于从全场位移数据和反作用力数据中发现屈服函数，且无需应力观测、塑性应变测量、直接屈服面数据或预设的参数化屈服函数。该框架将屈服函数标识为弹塑性应力积分内部的机械约束本构组件，而非通过直接应力空间监督。屈服函数由凸神经网络表示，该网络在强制执行凸性和一阶正齐次性的同时，施加了假设的张压对称性；该神经屈服函数通过可微应力更新和跨多个加载工况的物理信息力平衡损失进行训练。所提框架使用具有 von Mises、Hill 1948 和 Yld2000-2d 屈服函数的有限元 (FE) 基准研究进行了验证，评估了屈服轮廓一致性、位移噪声敏感性、通过塑性活跃应力状态的可识别性、认知不确定性和多项式替代部署。本研究为从位移和力数据中发现各向异性屈服函数提供了一条受力学约束的途径，同时将识别出的组件保持在弹塑性应力积分的结构内。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种基于物理信息凸性神经网络的框架，旨在从全场位移和力测量数据中发现各向异性屈服函数。该方法通过将屈服函数嵌入弹塑性应力积分过程并施加物理约束，摆脱了对应力观测和预设解析函数的依赖，为复杂材料本构关系的自动发现提供了有效途径。
AI.keywords: 屈服函数, 物理信息神经网络, 弹塑性, 凸性约束, 本构建模
AI.comments: 该研究的创新之处在于无需预设屈服函数形式即可从非直接测量数据中进行发现。通过将凸性神经网络嵌入到弹塑性应力更新算法中，既保证了物理上的合理性（凸性、正齐次性），又实现了端到端的学习。这为复杂材料本构关系的自动化发现提供了强有力的工具，解决了传统方法依赖繁琐实验校准的难题。

title: Cost-Optimal LLM Routing with Limited User Feedback under User Satisfaction Guarantees
summary: Inference costs for large language model (LLM) applications are rapidly growing, driven by surging demand and rising infrastructure cost. Users expect high-quality responses, and in commercial settings this is formally codified in Service Level Agreements (SLAs), creating a fundamental tension between cost and quality. Recent progress on cost-aware LLM request routing has shown potential to resolve this tension, but existing approaches rely on complete feedback signals, offline training, extensive per-workload tuning, and most lack SLA guarantees or inference-time adaptivity. We introduce SLARouter, an online routing algorithm that learns a cost-optimal policy from the sparse, one-sided user feedback available in production systems. SLARouter provides theoretical guarantees for both cost optimality and strict SLA compliance. Experiments across a wide range of LLM benchmarks show that SLARouter satisfies SLA constraints without the need for per-benchmark tuning, reducing operating cost by up to 2.2x over existing baselines.

title: Emyx: Fast and efficient all-atom protein generation
summary: Computational enzyme design requires generating proteins that scaffold catalytic residues and ligands, a task that demands both geometric accuracy and structural diversity from the underlying generative model. Current all-atom generators inherit expensive architectures from structure prediction, leading to high training costs and limited sample diversity. We argue that much of this complexity is unnecessary for generators, which condition on sparse geometric constraints rather than rich co-evolutionary signals. Emyx is a 140M-parameter conditional flow matching model that concentrates capacity within standard transformer blocks, replacing heavy embedding stacks with lightweight conditional representations and sparse connectivity. We additionally derive an exact reparametrisation of the flow matching interpolant into the EDM noise-level framework, bridging flow matching training efficiency with state-of-the-art sampling methods designed for diffusion models without retraining. Despite being the smallest model, Emyx outperforms both Proteína-Complexa and RFdiffusion3 against the AME enzyme design benchmark across success rate under strict evaluation requiring both global fold recovery and catalytic geometry accuracy, structural novelty, scaffold diversity, and geometric validity, while training in just $682$ GPU-hours, roughly $4\times$ less than RFdiffusion3.

title: A Hybrid GNN-FEM Framework for Phase-Field Fracture Simulation. Physics-Preserving Hybridization for Generalizable Surrogate Modeling
summary: Scientific machine learning (SciML) has emerged as a promising approach for accelerating simulations of complex physical systems, yet achieving physically consistent and generalizable predictions for nonlinear, history-dependent problems remains a central challenge. In this study, we propose a hybrid GNN--FEM framework for efficient and generalizable phase-field fracture modeling. While phase-field approaches provide a robust variational framework for simulating complex crack evolution, their high computational cost limits practical applications because they require solving coupled, nonlinear, and history-dependent systems within an incremental finite element procedure. To address this challenge, a graph neural network surrogate is integrated into the conventional staggered scheme, replacing the phase-field update at each load increment while retaining the FEM-based displacement solver to enforce mechanical equilibrium and boundary conditions. By preserving the incremental solution structure, the framework remains consistent with history-dependent fracture evolution without requiring the surrogate to approximate the full solution trajectory. This selective surrogate strategy emphasizes the identification of a physically meaningful and incrementally structured learning target, rather than relying on brute-force data generation to learn the full fracture process. The proposed framework achieves strong generalization across varying geometries, loading conditions, material properties, and discretizations through dimensionless feature design, a graph-based formulation on mesh-based domains, and a physics-informed loss derived from the governing phase-field equation. Numerical experiments demonstrate that the hybrid approach reduces computational cost while maintaining accuracy compared with conventional FEM, and exhibits robust predictive performance across diverse problem settings.

AI.title_translation: 用于相位场断裂模拟的混合GNN-FEM框架：面向通用代理模型的物理保留混合方法
AI.tldr: 通过将图神经网络嵌入有限元求解流程中，该框架在保持物理准确性的前提下，显著加速了相位场断裂模拟，并具备极强的跨场景泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 相位场断裂模拟涉及非线性、历史相关系统的耦合求解，计算成本极高，限制了其在实际工程中的应用。现有的机器学习方法往往难以保证物理一致性和跨场景的泛化能力。
AI.method: 提出了一种混合GNN-FEM框架，将GNN作为代理模型嵌入到传统的交错求解方案中，取代每一步加载增量下的相位场更新，而保留FEM处理位移求解以确保力学平衡。采用无量纲特征设计、基于网格的图神经网络构建以及基于相位场控制方程的物理信息损失函数。
AI.result: 数值实验表明，该混合方法在保持与传统有限元方法相当精度的同时，显著降低了计算成本，并在不同的几何形状、载荷条件、材料属性和离散化设置下表现出强大的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 该框架成功实现了相位场断裂模拟的加速，证明了混合建模在处理非线性、历史相关物理问题中的有效性和通用性。
AI.translation: 科学机器学习（SciML）已成为加速复杂物理系统模拟的一种有前途的方法，但在实现非线性、历史相关问题的物理一致性和可泛化预测方面仍面临核心挑战。在本研究中，我们提出了一种用于高效且通用相位场断裂建模的混合GNN-FEM框架。相位场方法虽然为模拟复杂裂纹演化提供了一个稳健的变分框架，但其高昂的计算成本限制了实际应用，因为它们需要在增量有限元过程中求解耦合的、非线性的和历史相关系统。为了解决这一挑战，我们将图神经网络（GNN）代理集成到传统的交错方案中，在每个加载增量处替换相位场更新，同时保留基于FEM的位移求解器以执行力学平衡和边界条件。通过保留增量求解结构，该框架在不要求代理模型逼近完整解轨迹的情况下，保持了与历史相关断裂演化的一致性。这种选择性代理策略强调确定一个具有物理意义且具有增量结构的学习目标，而不是依赖强力数据生成来学习整个断裂过程。所提出的框架通过无量纲特征设计、基于网格域的图公式以及源自相位场控制方程的物理信息损失，在不同的几何形状、载荷条件、材料属性和离散化设置中实现了强大的泛化能力。数值实验表明，与传统FEM相比，该混合方法在保持精度的同时降低了计算成本，并在各种问题设置中展现出稳健的预测性能。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种结合图神经网络（GNN）和有限元方法（FEM）的混合框架，用于高效且通用的相位场断裂模拟。该方法通过在交错求解方案中引入GNN代理更新相位场，同时利用FEM保障力学平衡，实现了物理一致性和计算效率的平衡，有效解决了复杂断裂演化模拟中的高计算代价问题。
AI.keywords: 科学机器学习, 相位场断裂, 图神经网络, 有限元方法, 物理信息代理模型
AI.comments: 该研究通过巧妙地将图神经网络（GNN）与有限元方法（FEM）结合，避免了直接用AI替代整个物理过程，而是仅代理其中计算昂贵的相位场更新部分。这种“物理约束+增量学习”的思路在保证物理一致性的同时显著降低了计算成本，是科学机器学习在复杂物理模拟领域应用的一个优秀范例。

title: How Linear Is a Transformer Feed-Forward Block? Per-Block Linear Recoverability Is Learned, Not Architectural
summary:
Transformer feed-forward networks (FFNs) are often treated as nonlinear stores of computation, yet how nonlinear a trained FFN block actually is has rarely been measured. We treat each FFN as a position-wise input-to-output map and split it into the exact least-squares linear approximation plus a residual. The held-out variance the closed-form linear map explains defines a block's linear recoverability (R^2_lin), an optimiser-free measure of its linearity.
  Across all twelve blocks of GPT-2, Pythia-160m, and llama-160m, R^2_lin is highly heterogeneous and non-monotone with depth, ranging from near-linear (>0.99) to strongly nonlinear (<0.3) between adjacent blocks, and is not set by the activation function: same-width GELU models GPT-2 and Pythia-160m have sharply different profiles, so recoverability is a learned property of individual trained blocks, not an architectural one. A low-rank bilinear probe of the residual recovers only a few points of R^2, with gain uncorrelated with residual nonlinearity: the unrecovered computation is not a single position-wise product but higher-order or distributed structure.
  The measurement also serves as a targeted compression signal: recoverable blocks admit large single-layer replacements (GPT-2's early FFN at 8x fewer parameters for +0.77 perplexity), while low-recoverability blocks flag where this is unsafe. It further exposes a methodological pitfall: trained linear baselines can badly under-converge on ill-conditioned transformer activations, so we report the exact closed-form least-squares ceiling throughout.
