title: Score Approximation for Diffusion Models on Arbitrary Low-Dimensional Structures
summary: The remarkable success of score-based diffusion models has spurred significant efforts to establish their theoretical foundations. However, existing complexity bounds for score approximation rely heavily on restrictive assumptions like Lipschitz continuous densities or smooth manifold supports, which are routinely violated by the singularities, sharp boundaries, and disjoint clusters inherent to real-world perceptual data. This work establishes a universal score approximation theorem that works for any distribution supported on any compact set of upper Minkowski dimension $d$. Using a novel discrete-mixture formulation, we prove that the score function can be approximated with a ReLU network whose complexity grows exponentially only with $d$, thus breaking the exponential curse of ambient dimensionality. Combined with existing theories on accurately solving the backward diffusion SDE for arbitrary compact distributions, our work shows that diffusion models readily adapt to irregular, non-smooth data structures, explaining their competence in real-world generative tasks.

AI.title_translation: 任意低维结构下扩散模型的分数近似
AI.tldr: 本文证明了扩散模型无需平滑性假设即可处理复杂数据，其分数函数可通过ReLU网络高效逼近，且复杂度仅取决于数据的内在维数。
AI.motivation: 现有扩散模型的理论复杂性边界过度依赖于Lipschitz连续密度或光滑流形等限制性假设，而这些假设在处理包含奇异点、尖锐边界和不连续簇的真实数据时往往失效。
AI.method: 提出了一种新的离散混合公式（discrete-mixture formulation），并利用ReLU神经网络对分数函数进行逼近，证明了其复杂性仅随数据内在维数（上闵可夫维数）呈指数增长，而非环境维度。
AI.result: 建立了一个通用的分数近似定理，证明了对于任何上闵可夫维数为d的紧致集上的分布，分数函数都可以被ReLU网络高效逼近。
AI.conclusion: 扩散模型在理论上能够有效处理任意具有紧致支撑集和有限上闵可夫维数的数据分布，无需依赖平滑性假设。
AI.translation: 基于分数的扩散模型的显著成功促使人们对其理论基础进行了大量的研究。然而，现有的分数近似复杂性界限严重依赖于诸如Lipschitz连续密度或光滑流形支撑等限制性假设，而这些假设经常被现实世界感知数据中固有的奇异点、尖锐边界和不连续簇所破坏。本工作建立了一个通用的分数近似定理，适用于任何支撑在任何上闵可夫维数为d的紧致集上的分布。利用一种新颖的离散混合公式，我们证明了分数函数可以被一个ReLU网络逼近，其复杂性仅随d呈指数增长，从而打破了环境维度的指数诅咒。结合关于为任意紧致分布准确求解反向扩散随机微分方程（SDE）的现有理论，我们的工作表明扩散模型能够轻易适应不规则、非平滑的数据结构，解释了它们在现实世界生成任务中的能力。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种针对任意低维结构下扩散模型的分数近似理论，证明了即使在非平滑、非流形的数据分布下，ReLU网络也能有效逼近分数函数，且复杂度仅受内在维数影响，从而解释了扩散模型在现实任务中的强大性能。
AI.keywords: 扩散模型, 分数近似, 上闵可夫维数, ReLU网络, 生成模型
AI.comments: 该论文通过引入离散混合公式，在理论上解决了扩散模型在处理非平滑、非流形数据时的适用性问题。其核心贡献在于打破了对数据分布正则性的强假设，为扩散模型在处理复杂真实世界数据时的有效性提供了坚实的理论支撑。

title: A fast direct solver based neural network for solving PDEs
summary: The matrices arising from large scale $N$-body problems can be efficiently represented using hierarchical matrices, whose key idea is that the admissible off-diagonal sub-matrices can be well approximated by low-rank matrices across a hierarchy of matrix partitions. HODLR (Hierarchical Off-Diagonal Low-Rank) matrices are a subclass of hierarchical matrices in which all off-diagonal submatrices at every level of a recursive binary partition are low-rank. In this article, we present a neural network that learns the inverse operation of HODLR matrices based on the fast direct solver for HODLR matrices developed by Ambikasaran and Darve (2013). We further extend the architecture to learn nonlinear solution operators associated with PDEs by replacing some of the linear layers with deep sub-networks. We demonstrate the performance of the proposed architecture by performing a comprehensive set of experiments that include (i) solving a linear problem such as the Fredholm integral equation of the second kind, (ii) solving PDEs such as the nonlinear Schrödinger equation, Burgers' equation, and the steady-state Darcy's flow equation, (iii) generalization study across varying parameter values, (iv) comparing the inference time of the proposed network with the run time of a classical numerical solver, and (v) comparing the proposed network with some of the existing neural operator learning networks.

AI.title_translation: 一种基于快速直接求解器的偏微分方程神经网络求解器
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种结合HODLR矩阵低秩结构与深度学习的神经网络，用于高效求解偏微分方程，在速度和泛化性能上均优于传统方法。
AI.motivation: 旨在结合HODLR矩阵的快速直接求解优势与神经网络的学习能力，以提高求解大规模PDE及其逆问题的效率。
AI.method: 提出了一种基于HODLR矩阵逆运算的神经网络架构，通过将线性层替换为深度子网络来扩展该架构，以学习偏微分方程的非线性解算子。
AI.result: 实验证明该模型能有效求解Fredholm积分方程及多种非线性PDE（如Schrödinger方程、Burgers方程等），在推理时间上优于传统数值求解器，并具备良好的参数泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的基于HODLR矩阵的神经网络能够有效学习偏微分方程的解算子，在推理速度和精度上表现出优于部分现有神经算子方法的潜力。
AI.translation: 大规模N体问题中产生的矩阵可以利用分层矩阵有效地表示，其核心思想是可容许的非对角子矩阵可以通过矩阵分层中的低秩矩阵进行良好近似。HODLR（分层非对角低秩）矩阵是分层矩阵的一个子类，其中递归二分划分每一层的非对角子矩阵都是低秩的。在本文中，我们提出了一个基于Ambikasaran和Darve（2013）开发的HODLR矩阵快速直接求解器的神经网络，用于学习HODLR矩阵的逆运算。我们进一步扩展了该架构，通过将一些线性层替换为深度子网络来学习与PDE相关的非线性解算子。我们通过一系列综合实验证明了所提架构的性能，包括（i）求解线性问题，如第二类Fredholm积分方程；（ii）求解PDE，如非线性Schrödinger方程、Burgers方程和稳态Darcy流方程；（iii）跨不同参数值的泛化研究；（iv）将所提网络的推理时间与传统数值求解器的运行时间进行比较；以及（v）将所提网络与现有的神经算子学习网络进行比较。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种利用HODLR矩阵结构优化神经网络的新方法，用于快速求解偏微分方程。该方法通过模拟HODLR矩阵的直接求解过程，并引入深度子网络处理非线性问题，实现了对多种线性及非线性PDE的高效求解。
AI.keywords: 偏微分方程, HODLR矩阵, 神经算子, 快速直接求解器, 低秩近似
AI.comments: 该研究创新性地将传统数值线性代数中的HODLR矩阵结构与神经网络相结合，为解决PDE提供了一种混合求解框架。其意义在于利用矩阵结构的低秩特性来加速神经网络的学习与推理，但在处理高度非线性复杂问题时的泛化能力仍需进一步验证。

title: One-to-Two Acting: A Novel Framework for Single-arm Agent Action Expansion to Dual Arms
summary: Dual-arm manipulation can improve throughput via parallel execution, but collecting bimanual demonstrations for training is costly and difficult. We present ExS2D, a hierarchical action expansion framework that enables dual-arm manipulation from single-arm supervision. ExS2D first generates structured subtasks from textual instructions while explicitly capturing temporal precedence. It then grounds each subtask into executable actions through subtask-guided action mapping in observation. Finally, precedence-aware action allocation and synchronized planning are performed by a multimodal large language model driven coordinator to select collision-free dual-arm executions. Simulation experiments demonstrate that ExS2D reduces the average execution steps by 54.4% while maintaining a comparable success rate to a single-arm baseline. Real-robot experiments on four tasks further demonstrate the reliability of ExS2D for dual-arm execution under few-shot single-arm samples, while using zero bimanual demonstrations.

AI.title_translation: 一对二行动：一种用于单臂智能体动作扩展至双臂的新型框架
AI.tldr: ExS2D 框架通过单臂演示训练双臂机器人，无需双臂数据，在保持成功率的同时显著提升了操作效率。
AI.motivation: 双臂操作虽能提升效率，但获取双臂训练演示数据既昂贵又困难，因此需要一种能从单臂演示中学习双臂操作的方法。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为 ExS2D 的分层动作扩展框架：1. 从文本指令生成结构化子任务；2. 通过子任务引导的动作映射将任务落地；3. 利用多模态大模型驱动的协调器进行 precedence-aware（考虑先后顺序的）动作分配与同步规划。
AI.result: 在仿真实验中，执行步数平均减少了 54.4%，且成功率与单臂基线相当；在真实机器人实验中，在零双臂演示的情况下实现了可靠的双臂操作。
AI.conclusion: ExS2D 框架成功证明了仅通过单臂演示即可实现高效的双臂操作，无需任何双臂样本，为机器人双臂协同提供了一种低成本且可扩展的解决方案。
AI.translation: 双臂操作可以通过并行执行提高吞吐量，但收集用于训练的双臂演示数据既昂贵又困难。我们提出了 ExS2D，这是一个分层动作扩展框架，能够通过单臂监督实现双臂操作。ExS2D 首先根据文本指令生成结构化子任务，同时明确捕捉时间先后顺序。然后，它通过观察中的子任务引导动作映射，将每个子任务落地为可执行动作。最后，由多模态大模型驱动的协调器执行考虑先后顺序的动作分配和同步规划，以选择无碰撞的双臂执行方案。仿真实验表明，ExS2D 在保持与单臂基线相当的成功率的同时，将平均执行步数减少了 54.4%。在四个任务上的真实机器人实验进一步证明了 ExS2D 在少量单臂样本下进行双臂执行的可靠性，且全程无需任何双臂演示。
AI.summary: ExS2D 是一种分层动作扩展框架，旨在通过单臂演示实现双臂操纵。该框架利用多模态大模型将文本指令分解为子任务，并进行同步规划，从而在无需双臂数据的情况下有效提升了任务执行效率。
AI.keywords: 双臂操作, 动作扩展, 多模态大模型, 机器人学习, 模仿学习
AI.comments: 该论文的创新之处在于利用多模态大模型实现从单臂演示到双臂操作的迁移，有效解决了双臂数据获取昂贵且困难的痛点。其分层架构设计合理，通过子任务拆解与协调器规划，实现了高效的并行操作，具有很强的实用价值和扩展性。

title: Query-aware Routing for Filtered Approximate Nearest Neighbors Search
summary: Filtered ANN search, which combines vector similarity with attribute predicates, is a core primitive in modern vector databases and retrieval-augmented generation. We benchmark all major categorical filtered ANN methods across multiple datasets under three predicates and find that no single method dominates. Moreover, even within a single dataset and predicate type, the best method for a query can vary. Therefore, we propose a query-aware routing framework. A lightweight ML model predicts each candidate method's recall on the query, and the router consults an offline benchmark table that maps every method and parameter setting to its measured recall and QPS, then selects the method with the best recall--QPS trade-off. Our ablation study narrows 22 candidate features to a minimal set of three and we adopt regression rather than classification as the prediction target to sharpen accuracy. Our model is trained on six real-world datasets and applied to five unseen validation datasets. The final result shows that our router achieves state-of-the-art recall and QPS balance across all five validation datasets compared to existing filtered ANN baselines, while incurring negligible latency overhead.

title: Measuring Biological Capabilities and Risks of AI Agents
summary: This paper addresses a rapidly emerging policy challenge: how to generate and interpret credible evidence about the biological capabilities and risks of AI scientists, or agentic AI systems capable of autonomously or collaboratively performing multi-step scientific tasks. As these systems enter real research workflows, decision-makers increasingly face evaluation results whose meaning depends on underlying design choices that are often implicit or under-documented. We synthesize current evidence on AI-enabled biological risks and introduce biological agentic evaluations as a promising, but interpretation-sensitive, tool for assessing these systems. Our central contribution is a set of practical, experience-grounded considerations -- drawing from our own evaluations -- that show how choices around defining, designing, running, scoring, and documenting evaluations materially shape what results do and do not imply about risk. The analysis is intended to help policymakers interpret biological evaluation outputs with appropriate caution; guide public and private funders toward high-leverage investments in AI-biology evaluation research; and support biosecurity practitioners assessing emerging AI systems. A secondary audience includes researchers designing or conducting agentic evaluations within frontier AI labs, AI providers, scientific institutions, and third-party evaluation organizations.

AI.title_translation: 衡量AI代理的生物能力与风险
AI.tldr: 本文探讨了如何科学地评估AI代理的生物风险，强调评估设计对结果解读的关键影响，并为政策制定者和研究人员提供了评估实践指南。
AI.motivation: 随着具备自主科学研究能力的AI代理进入实际工作流，决策者在面对其带来的生物风险评估结果时，缺乏统一的解释标准和对评估设计潜在偏见的认知。
AI.method: 通过综合现有的AI生物风险证据，并结合作者自身的评估经验，提出了一套关于定义、设计、执行、评分和记录生物代理评估的实践考量框架。
AI.result: 构建了一套实践指南，明确了评估设计中的各项选择如何实质性地影响风险评估结论的有效性，为政策制定者、资助者及生物安全从业者提供了评估指引。
AI.conclusion: 评估AI代理的生物风险是一个复杂且受设计选择高度影响的过程，政策制定者和研究人员需要通过严谨的评估设计与文档记录，以科学审慎的态度来解读评估结果。
AI.translation: 本文探讨了一个迅速出现的政策挑战：如何针对AI科学家（即能够自主或协作执行多步骤科学任务的代理式AI系统）的生物能力和风险，产生并解读可信的证据。随着这些系统进入实际的研究工作流，决策者面临的评估结果往往依赖于隐性或记录不全的设计选择。我们综合了当前关于AI驱动的生物风险证据，并引入了“生物代理评估”这一工具，尽管该工具对解释非常敏感。我们的核心贡献是一套基于实践经验的考量，展示了在定义、设计、执行、评分和记录评估方面的选择如何实质性地塑造了结果对风险的暗示。本分析旨在帮助政策制定者以适当的谨慎态度解读生物评估输出；引导公共和私人资助者对AI生物评估研究进行高杠杆投资；并支持评估新兴AI系统的生物安全从业者。次要受众包括在前沿AI实验室、AI提供商、科研机构和第三方评估组织中设计或执行代理评估的研究人员。
AI.summary: 本文针对AI代理在生物科学领域的潜在风险，提出了一套系统的评估框架。作者指出，AI代理的风险评估结果高度依赖于其设计与实验设置，并提供了基于实践的评估指南，旨在帮助决策者科学地解读评估数据，从而加强对前沿AI系统的生物安全监管。
AI.keywords: AI代理, 生物风险, 评估框架, 生物安全, 科学研究工作流
AI.comments: 该论文及时地填补了AI在生物安全领域评估框架的空白。其创新之处在于将评估过程本身作为研究对象，强调了评估设计中的“解释敏感性”。局限性在于主要侧重于方法论的指导，而非具体的生物风险技术指标。对于AI治理政策制定者具有极高的参考价值。

title: Linear Recurrent Unit with Semantic Modulation for Image Super-Resolution
summary: Linear recurrent unit (LRU), designed with a principled formulation for stable linear recurrence, has demonstrated promising accuracy and robustness on long-range dependency tasks. However, its static parameterization and single-scan method limits its applicability to 2D vision tasks. In this study, we propose a LRU-based restoration network with a semantic modulating unit (SMU) to achieve a harmonious balance between performance and efficiency in single-image super-resolution. The SMU plays three key roles: LRU modulation, spatial categorization, and feature enhancement through learned prototype. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method quantitatively and qualitatively surpasses recent state-of-the-art methods. Notably, our approach achieves superior performance with computational complexity on par with existing methods. The source code and models are available at https://github.com/MingyuChoi-run/LSM

title: Toward Temporal Realism in City-Scale Crisis Response Simulation using LLM Agents
summary: Human collective participation is rarely steady in time: it is bursty, with short episodes of intense activity separated by long quiet intervals. In crisis response and community mobilization, predicting when people act matters as much as predicting whether they act. Such settings are increasingly modeled with LLM-based social simulators, yet these simulators are validated on whether each action is individually plausible, not on whether actions are timed as in reality. Their temporal realism, the degree to which simulated activity reproduces the bursty, heavy-tailed timing of real human systems, thus remains untested. We examine this gap using a multi-year, city-scale log of offline volunteering in Shenzhen that spans the COVID-19 pandemic. Empirically, we establish that bursty timing is common at individual and tracked-group levels, that it is largely endogenous and self-exciting, and that it is amplified by the pandemic rather than produced by daily activity cycles. A standard LLM-only simulator reproduces almost none of this timing: its synchronous schedule has no self-excitation channel, so agents act on a near-regular clock. Guided by these findings, we build a simulator in which a data-calibrated self-excitation channel and a crisis-period regime decide when each agent acts and query the LLM only at those moments, leaving it to decide which task to join and whether to commit. The LLM-only baseline yields no bursty agents (median burstiness $B=-0.14$); a single data-calibrated gate is then sufficient to lift per-agent timing above the burst threshold (median $B\approx0.37$) without degrading LLM content decisions. These results indicate that temporal realism in LLM-based crisis-response simulation is best achieved by decoupling when agents act, governed by an explicit self-excitation and crisis-activation mechanism, from what they do, governed by the LLM.

AI.title_translation: 迈向城市规模危机响应仿真中的时间真实性：基于LLM智能体的方法
AI.tldr: 现有的LLM社会仿真器无法模拟人类行为的“突发性”。研究提出将“何时行动”（由自激发机制决定）与“做什么”（由LLM决定）解耦，成功提升了仿真在时间维度上的真实性。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于LLM的社会模拟器主要关注动作的合理性，却忽略了人类行为在时间维度上的“突发性”特征，导致仿真结果无法真实反映危机响应中人类行为的动态分布。
AI.method: 研究首先利用深圳多年的志愿服务日志进行实证分析，发现人类行为具有明显的突发性和自激发特征；随后构建了一个新型仿真框架，将“何时行动”（由数据校准的自激发机制和危机时期模型决定）与“做什么”（由LLM决定）进行解耦。
AI.result: 标准LLM仿真器无法产生突发行为（中位数突发性指标B=-0.14），而引入数据校准的触发机制后，智能体的行为突发性显著提升（中位数B≈0.37），且未降低LLM在行为内容决策上的质量。
AI.conclusion: 在LLM驱动的社会仿真中，通过引入数据校准的自激发机制和危机状态切换机制，能够有效提升仿真在时间维度上的真实性，使其更能反映人类行为的突发性和长尾分布特征。
AI.translation: 人类的集体参与在时间上很少是稳定的：它呈现出突发性，即短暂的密集活动期被长期的静默期所隔开。在危机响应和社区动员中，预测人们何时行动与预测他们是否行动同样重要。此类场景越来越多地使用基于LLM的社会模拟器进行建模，但这些模拟器的验证标准仅在于每个动作在个体上是否合理，而非动作的时间安排是否符合现实。因此，它们的时间真实性——即模拟活动在多大程度上再现了真实人类系统那种突发性的、长尾的时间分布——仍未得到检验。我们利用深圳跨越新冠疫情期间多年的线下志愿服务日志来考察这一差距。实证表明，突发性时间安排在个体和群体层面都很常见，它主要源于内生性和自激发，且被疫情放大，而非由日常活动周期产生。标准的纯LLM模拟器几乎无法再现这种时间特征：其同步调度机制缺乏自激发通道，导致智能体按近乎规律的时钟行事。基于这些发现，我们构建了一个模拟器，其中由数据校准的自激发通道和危机时期机制决定每个智能体何时行动，仅在这些时刻查询LLM，由其决定加入何种任务以及是否参与。纯LLM基准模型没有产生突发性智能体（中位数突发性B=-0.14）；而引入单一的数据校准门控机制后，足以将每个智能体的时间安排提升至突发阈值之上（中位数B≈0.37），且不降低LLM的内容决策质量。这些结果表明，通过将智能体何时行动（由显式的自激发和危机激活机制控制）与智能体做什么（由LLM控制）进行解耦，可以最好地实现基于LLM的危机响应仿真中的时间真实性。
AI.summary: 本文探讨了LLM社会仿真中时间真实性的缺失问题，通过分析真实志愿服务数据发现人类行为具有自激发特性，进而提出了一种将时机触发机制与LLM决策分离的仿真架构，显著提升了模拟器对突发性行为的刻画能力。
AI.keywords: LLM智能体, 危机响应仿真, 时间真实性, 自激发机制, 社会模拟
AI.comments: 该研究精准识别了当前大语言模型（LLM）社会仿真在“时间维度”上的缺失，提出了将“行为触发时机”与“行为内容决策”解耦的创新思路。这种方法不仅提升了仿真的现实感，也为LLM在复杂社会系统建模中的应用提供了重要的方法论指导。

title: Gaussian Process Prior Variational Autoencoder for Endoscopic Videos
summary:
Endoscopic video analysis is essential for gastrointestinal diagnosis and computer-assisted interventions, but video sequences are routinely degraded by specular reflections, motion artifacts, and missing frames. These transient corruptions can distract clinicians, reduce image interpretability, and disrupt downstream tasks such as 3D reconstruction and navigation. Effective restoration therefore requires methods that exploit temporal continuity rather than treating frames in isolation. We introduce a Gaussian Process Prior Variational Autoencoder (GPVAE) framework for endoscopic video restoration that replaces the standard factorized latent prior with a temporal Gaussian process prior, enabling interpolation of missing frames with uncertainty-aware reconstruction.
  The framework combines endoscopy-specific encoders, including a convolutional EndoVAE backbone and pretrained Vision Transformer encoders from GastroNet-5M, with two scalable GP approximations: Hierarchical Prior Approximation (HPA) and Sparse Precision Approximation (SPA). Specular reflections are handled using a DUCKNet-based masking pipeline that excludes corrupted pixels from the reconstruction objective. On the C3VDv2 colonoscopy dataset, the best GPVAE variants reduced image reconstruction RMSE by 21.9\% on average, and by up to 26.1\%, relative to matched VAE baselines. Downstream trajectory RMSE was reduced by 12.7\% on average across classical visual odometry and a pretrained PoseNet, at an average increase of 27.3\% in training time per epoch. Finally, the GP posterior provides per-frame uncertainty estimates that reflect temporal support and offer a confidence signal for restored frames.

AI.title_translation: 用于内窥镜视频的高斯过程先验变分自编码器
AI.tldr: GPVAE通过引入时序高斯过程先验，显著改善了受损内窥镜视频的重建质量，并提供不确定性估计以增强临床可靠性。
AI.motivation: 内窥镜视频常受反光、运动伪影和帧丢失影响，破坏了图像可解释性及下游任务（如3D重建和导航），传统孤立帧处理方法不足以利用时序连续性。
AI.method: 提出GPVAE框架，用时序高斯过程先验替换传统VAE的因子化先验；结合EndoVAE和GastroNet-5M特征提取器；采用分层先验近似（HPA）和稀疏精度近似（SPA）进行优化；利用DUCKNet进行反光遮罩处理。
AI.result: 在C3VDv2数据集上，重建RMSE平均降低21.9%（最高26.1%），下游轨迹RMSE平均降低12.7%，并能提供有效的逐帧不确定性评估。
AI.conclusion: GPVAE框架通过时序建模和不确定性感知，显著提升了内窥镜视频的重建质量及下游任务（如轨迹估计）的准确性。
AI.translation: 内窥镜视频分析对于胃肠道诊断和计算机辅助干预至关重要，但视频序列经常受到镜面反射、运动伪影和帧丢失的影响。这些瞬时损坏可能会干扰临床医生、降低图像可解释性，并破坏诸如3D重建和导航等下游任务。因此，有效的修复需要利用时序连续性，而不是孤立地处理每一帧。我们引入了一种用于内窥镜视频修复的高斯过程先验变分自编码器（GPVAE）框架，该框架用时序高斯过程先验取代了标准的因子化潜在先验，实现了具有不确定性感知的缺失帧插值。该框架结合了内窥镜特定的编码器（包括卷积EndoVAE主干和来自GastroNet-5M的预训练视觉Transformer编码器）以及两种可扩展的GP近似方法：分层先验近似（HPA）和稀疏精度近似（SPA）。镜面反射通过基于DUCKNet的掩模流水线处理，将损坏的像素从重建目标中排除。在C3VDv2结肠镜检查数据集上，最佳GPVAE变体相对于匹配的VAE基线，图像重建RMSE平均降低了21.9%，最高降低了26.1%。在经典的视觉里程计和预训练的PoseNet中，下游轨迹RMSE平均降低了12.7%，但每个epoch的训练时间平均增加了27.3%。最后，GP后验提供了逐帧不确定性估计，反映了时序支持并为修复帧提供了置信度信号。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种用于内窥镜视频修复的GPVAE框架。通过引入时序高斯过程先验，该模型能够有效处理视频中的反光、伪影和丢帧问题，不仅提升了图像重建质量，还为下游导航任务提供了更准确的轨迹估计和不确定性度量。
AI.keywords: 内窥镜视频, 高斯过程先验, 变分自编码器, 视频修复, 不确定性估计
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将高斯过程先验引入VAE模型，有效利用了内窥镜视频的时序连续性。其亮点在于引入了不确定性估计，这对于医疗影像的临床可信度至关重要。不过，训练时间的增加（27.3%）是实际应用中需要权衡的因素。

title: Light-weight Pronunciation Assessment via Discrete Speech Token Surprisal
summary: Training automated pronunciation assessment often relies on labeled learner errors or non-native corpora that are costly to collect. We propose a lightweight framework trained only on native speech resources, operating unsupervised or lightly calibrated with a small set of scored utterances. At inference, learner speech is discretized with an SSL encoder and a K-means codebook. A token language model trained on native sequences computes surprisal where higher surprisal indicates phonotactic deviation. We add a transcript-guided Text2DUnit--DTW module that predicts native token sequences from reference text and aligns them to acoustic tokens to derive error-sensitive features. Surprisal and alignment features are fused via simple regression. On SpeechOcean762, PCC improves from 0.60 to 0.66 with transcript guidance, near supervised baselines. Cross-dataset evaluation on L2-ARCTIC shows consistent gains.

AI.title_translation: 基于离散语音Token惊奇度的轻量级发音评估
AI.tldr: 提出了一种仅需母语资源训练的轻量级发音评估方法，通过离散语音Token的惊奇度与对齐特征，实现了接近有监督模型的高性能评估。
AI.motivation: 自动化发音评估通常依赖昂贵且难以获取的标注非母语语料库，因此需要一种仅利用母语资源且轻量化的评估框架。
AI.method: 利用SSL编码器和K-means对语音进行离散化；训练母语Token语言模型计算惊奇度；引入Text2DUnit-DTW模块将参考文本转化为母语Token序列并对齐；最后通过回归模型融合惊奇度和对齐特征进行评估。
AI.result: 在SpeechOcean762数据集上，PCC从0.60提升至0.66，接近有监督基准；在L2-ARCTIC数据集上的跨数据集评估表现出一致的性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 该方法通过结合惊奇度和对齐特征，证明了在无需大量标注数据的情况下，能够实现与有监督基准相媲美的发音评估效果。
AI.translation: 自动发音评估的训练通常依赖于昂贵的标注学习者错误或非母语语料库。我们提出了一种仅利用母语资源训练的轻量级框架，该框架可无监督运行或通过少量评分话语进行轻度校准。在推理阶段，学习者的语音通过SSL编码器和K-means码本进行离散化。在母语序列上训练的Token语言模型计算惊奇度，其中较高的惊奇度表示音位偏差。我们添加了一个转录引导的Text2DUnit--DTW模块，该模块从参考文本预测母语Token序列，并将它们与声学Token对齐以导出错误敏感特征。惊奇度和对齐特征通过简单回归融合。在SpeechOcean762上，在转录引导下PCC从0.60提高到0.66，接近有监督基准。在L2-ARCTIC上的跨数据集评估显示了一致的增益。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种轻量级的发音评估框架，仅依赖母语资源即可实现。通过将语音离散化并计算语言模型惊奇度，结合文本引导的对齐特征，该方法在无需大规模标注数据的情况下，在多个数据集上取得了显著的评估性能提升。
AI.keywords: 发音评估, 自监督学习, 离散语音Token, 惊奇度, 无监督学习
AI.comments: 该研究的创新之处在于利用自监督学习（SSL）生成的离散语音Token与语言模型计算的惊奇度（Surprisal）来量化发音偏差，摆脱了对大规模标注非母语语料库的依赖。其轻量化设计和跨数据集的泛化能力使其在实际应用中具有很高的价值，但在处理复杂语音错误时的鲁棒性仍有待观察。

title: Multi-Agent Transactive Memory
summary: The decentralized deployment of LLM agents with diverse capabilities across diverse tasks motivates infrastructure for knowledge sharing across heterogeneous agent populations. Just as search engines index human-generated artifacts to support human problem solving, retrieval systems can organize agent-generated artifacts for reuse across agent populations. We extend retrieval-augmented generation - which demonstrates the value of human-authored artifacts to individual agents - to retrieval of agent-generated artifacts supporting a population of agents. In particular, agent trajectories encode reusable procedural knowledge, yet these artifacts are typically discarded after a single use or retained only by the producing agent, forcing newly instantiated agents to repeatedly rediscover existing solutions. We propose Multi-Agent Transactive Memory (MATM), a framework for population-level storage and retrieval of agent-generated trajectories, where producer agents contribute trajectories to a shared repository and consumer agents retrieve them to improve task execution. We focus on interactive environments (ALFWorld and WebArena), where trajectories are long and encode especially rich procedural structure. Our experiments demonstrate that retrieving trajectories from MATM improves downstream task performance and reduces interaction steps without coordination or joint training. These results position MATM as a design pattern for population-level experience sharing in open agent ecosystems.

AI.title_translation: 多智能体交互记忆
AI.tldr: MATM通过建立共享的智能体轨迹库，让智能体能够复用他人的成功经验，从而在复杂任务中提升效率并减少重复探索。
AI.motivation: 当前多智能体系统中，智能体生成的程序性知识（轨迹）往往被浪费或局限于个体，导致新智能体需重复探索，缺乏跨智能体群体的知识共享基础设施。
AI.method: 提出多智能体交互记忆（MATM）框架，该框架作为共享存储库，允许生产者智能体贡献其交互轨迹，并允许消费者智能体检索这些轨迹以辅助任务执行。无需联合训练或显式协调。
AI.result: 在ALFWorld和WebArena环境中的实验表明，使用MATM检索轨迹显著提高了下游任务性能，并减少了完成任务所需的交互步骤。
AI.conclusion: MATM框架通过在群体层面存储和检索智能体生成的轨迹，有效促进了经验共享，显著提升了智能体在复杂交互环境中的任务表现，是构建开放智能体生态系统的有效设计模式。
AI.translation: 随着具有不同能力的LLM智能体在各种任务中的去中心化部署，建立跨异构智能体群体的知识共享基础设施变得至关重要。正如搜索引擎索引人类生成的制品以支持人类解决问题一样，检索系统也可以组织智能体生成的制品以供群体复用。我们将检索增强生成（RAG）——它证明了人类创作的制品对单个智能体的价值——扩展到了支持智能体群体的制品检索。特别地，智能体轨迹编码了可复用的程序性知识，但这些制品通常在一次使用后被丢弃或仅由生成智能体保留，迫使新实例化的智能体重复探索已有的解决方案。我们提出了多智能体交互记忆（MATM），这是一个用于群体级存储和检索智能体生成轨迹的框架，生产者智能体将轨迹贡献给共享存储库，消费者智能体检索它们以改进任务执行。我们专注于交互环境（ALFWorld和WebArena），其中的轨迹很长且编码了特别丰富的程序结构。我们的实验表明，从MATM检索轨迹可以在没有协调或联合训练的情况下，提高下游任务性能并减少交互步骤。这些结果将MATM定位为开放智能体生态系统中群体级经验共享的一种设计模式。
AI.summary: 本文提出了多智能体交互记忆（MATM）框架，旨在通过共享存储和检索智能体生成的交互轨迹，实现多智能体群体间的知识复用。该方法扩展了检索增强生成技术，使智能体能够利用他人的经验，从而在无需额外训练的情况下提升任务执行效率。
AI.keywords: 多智能体系统, 检索增强生成, 交互记忆, 经验共享, 程序性知识
AI.comments: 该研究提出了一个非常有意义的框架，旨在解决多智能体系统中知识孤岛的问题。通过将“交互记忆”概念引入LLM智能体，该方法不仅提高了任务执行效率，还为构建大规模、协作性的智能体生态系统提供了一种轻量级、无需联合训练的通用设计范式。

title: Structure-Oriented Randomized Neural Networks for Poisson-Nernst-Planck and Poisson-Nernst-Planck-Navier-Stokes Systems
summary: We develop a structure-oriented randomized neural network framework, termed SO-RaNN, for the Poisson-Nernst-Planck (PNP) system and the Poisson-Nernst-Planck-Navier-Stokes (PNP-NS) system. The decoupled linearized subproblems are solved iteratively by randomized neural networks in a space-time framework. For the concentration variables, a pointwise cut-off is used to enforce positivity at the value level, and discrete mass-scaling factors are computed at selected correction instants and interpolated in time, so as to ensure exact mass matching at those instants and to promote approximate mass preservation between them. To introduce an auxiliary discrete dissipation mechanism, we further employ an SAV-type post-processing correction, which yields monotonicity of the SAV auxiliary variable under the ideal SAV update. For the PNP-NS system, a structure-preserving randomized neural network (SP-RaNN) is used for the velocity field, so that the velocity approximation satisfies the incompressibility constraint pointwise by construction. On the theoretical side, we derive residual-based estimates for the raw, uncorrected RaNN solvers of the linearized subproblems, formulate a conditional local-in-time convergence result for the raw outer Picard iteration of the PNP system, and analyze the value-level positivity correction together with the mass-correction and SAV post-processing steps. For the PNP-NS system, we establish an approximation result for the SP-RaNN space and provide a conditional error statement for the corresponding linearized Oseen-type problem. Numerical experiments demonstrate approximation accuracy in the source-driven manufactured tests and illustrate the intended value-level positivity correction, selected-time mass matching, computed free-energy curves based on the final gauge-fixed potential, and divergence-free approximation in benchmark tests.

AI.title_translation: 面向Poisson-Nernst-Planck和Poisson-Nernst-Planck-Navier-Stokes系统的结构导向随机神经网络
AI.tldr: 提出了一种结合物理约束（保正、保质量、保不可压缩）的随机神经网络求解器，有效解决了PNP及PNP-NS系统的数值模拟难题。
AI.motivation: 针对Poisson-Nernst-Planck (PNP)及PNP-NS复杂耦合系统，现有神经网络求解器往往难以保证物理约束（如正性、质量守恒、不可压缩性），缺乏结构保持特性。
AI.method: 开发了SO-RaNN框架，采用迭代求解解耦线性子问题；利用点状截断保证浓度正性；通过离散质量缩放因子实现质量匹配；引入SAV型后处理修正以增强耗散机制；对于PNP-NS系统，采用SP-RaNN确保速度场的点状不可压缩约束。
AI.result: 理论上推导了残差估计及收敛性结果；数值实验证明了该方法在制造解测试中的高精度，且成功实现了正性保持、质量匹配、自由能曲线计算及无散度场逼近。
AI.conclusion: 该研究提出的SO-RaNN和SP-RaNN框架为求解PNP及PNP-NS系统提供了一种高效、高精度且具备物理保真度的数值求解方案。
AI.translation: 我们为Poisson-Nernst-Planck (PNP)系统和Poisson-Nernst-Planck-Navier-Stokes (PNP-NS)系统开发了一种结构导向的随机神经网络框架，称为SO-RaNN。通过随机神经网络在时空框架下迭代求解解耦线性化子问题。对于浓度变量，使用点状截断在数值层面强制正性，并在选定的校正时刻计算离散质量缩放因子并进行时间插值，以确保这些时刻的精确质量匹配，并促进它们之间的近似质量守恒。为了引入辅助离散耗散机制，我们进一步采用了SAV型后处理修正，这在理想SAV更新下产生了SAV辅助变量的单调性。对于PNP-NS系统，速度场采用结构保持随机神经网络（SP-RaNN），使得速度近似在构造上满足点状不可压缩约束。在理论方面，我们推导了线性化子问题原始、未经修正的RaNN求解器的基于残差的估计，制定了PNP系统原始外层Picard迭代的条件局部时间收敛结果，并分析了数值层面的正性校正以及质量校正和SAV后处理步骤。对于PNP-NS系统，我们建立了SP-RaNN空间的近似结果，并为相应的线性化Oseen型问题提供了条件误差陈述。数值实验展示了在源驱动制造测试中的逼近精度，并说明了预期的数值层面正性校正、特定时刻质量匹配、基于最终规范固定势计算的自由能曲线，以及基准测试中的无散度逼近。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种针对PNP和PNP-NS系统的结构导向随机神经网络（SO-RaNN）框架。该方法通过迭代解耦线性化子问题，并集成质量守恒、正性保持、SAV耗散机制以及不可压缩性约束（SP-RaNN），实现了对复杂耦合系统的物理一致性求解，并通过理论分析与数值实验验证了其有效性。
AI.keywords: 随机神经网络, Poisson-Nernst-Planck系统, 结构保持, 质量守恒, 不可压缩性
AI.comments: 该论文通过引入结构化约束（如保质量、保正性、保不可压缩性）显著提升了随机神经网络（RaNN）在求解复杂多物理场耦合系统（PNP/PNP-NS）时的物理一致性，弥补了传统神经网络在处理带约束偏微分方程时的不足。其创新在于将经典的数值分析技巧（如SAV、投影法）巧妙地集成到神经网络框架中。

title: Design and Evaluation of Energy-Efficient Whisper Dot-Product Kernel Offloading on a CGLA Architecture
comments: This paper is accepted at Concurrency and Computation: Practice and Experience (Wiley)
summary: In this paper, we implement and evaluate Whisper dot-product kernel offloading on IMAX, a programmable Coarse-Grained Linear Arrays (CGLAs) architecture. Whisper-tiny.en profiling on an ARM Cortex-A72 shows that dot-product operations account for 90.6% of FP16 execution time and 87.1% of Q8_0 execution time. To address this kernel bottleneck, we combine kernel mapping, local-memory sizing, and burst scheduling. The implementation uses inline FP16-to-FP32 conversion, 2-way SIMD FMA on a 64-bit datapath, column-wise multithreading, and mixed execution in which aligned vector segments run on IMAX and residual segments run concurrently on the host CPU. We evaluate the design with an FPGA prototype and a 28nm ASIC projection at 840MHz. For Whisper-tiny.en, 32KB local memory and burst length 16 jointly minimize PDP and EDP. Under a TDP-based cross-platform comparison, the projected IMAX records a PDP of 11.58J for Whisper-tiny.en Q8_0, 2.35x lower than Jetson AGX Orin (27.16J) and 10.48x lower than RTX 4090 (121.38J). The same design extends to Whisper-base.en and Whisper-small.en, where the PDP gap narrows as 32KB local-memory coverage drops from 93.8% for tiny to about 66.5% for base and small. These results position IMAX as a programmable architecture for lower-PDP local ASR in the tiny-model regime.

title: Co-policy: Responsive Human-Robot Co-Creation for Musical Performances
summary: Art has long stood as a pivotal expression of human creativity. Embodied artificial intelligence offers a route for generative models to participate in that creativity through physical action rather than disembodied digital content. In robotic music co-creation, it is challenging to connect semantic musical understanding with real-time and physically executable performance. We present Co-policy, a framework for human-robot musical co-creation that separates semantic intent grounding, constrained musical variation, and visuomotor execution. To ground musical semantics, Co-policy uses pre-inference semantic anchors and a fine-tuned Qwen-vl planner (F-Qwen) to transform speech, live musical seeds, and visual observations into structured co-creation plans. To support low-latency execution, Co-policy introduces a Gaussian-Mixture Visuomotor Policy (GMP), implemented as a conditional mixture-density policy that maps target notes and visual context to multimodal robot actions in a single forward pass. Unlike robotic playback systems that merely reproduce user-specified notes, Co-policy generates complementary musical responses under both musical and physical constraints. Real-robot chime experiments, ablations, and expert evaluation show improved intent alignment, execution accuracy, and response frequency over diffusion-policy and ablated baselines, supporting physically grounded action generation as a key requirement for embodied human-AI co-creation.

title: SpatialSV: Internalizing Interpretable 3D Spatial Awareness in MLLMs via Task-Oriented Visual Supervision
summary: Unlocking the spatial intelligence of multimodal large language model (MLLMs) is crucial for understanding and interacting with the 3D world. Prevailing approaches typically inject spatial priors via external tools, which impose significant inference overhead, or rely on latent feature distillation, which remains uninterpretable and lacks fine-grained geometric constraints. To address these issues, we propose SpatialSV, a framework designed to internalize robust 3D spatial awareness within MLLMs while simultaneously offering inherent interpretability. Deviating from passive feature imitation, SpatialSV employs task-oriented visual supervision, compelling the model to actively lift its 2D visual features into explicit 3D representations, including depth maps, camera poses, and point clouds. Crucially, this 2D-to-3D lifting process provides a transparent window into the model's representations: the resulting 3D reconstructions serve as an intuitive proxy for visualizing and diagnosing the quality of the model's intrinsic spatial knowledge. Extensive experiments across multiple models and benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of SpatialSV in enhancing and interpreting MLLMs' spatial intelligence. Furthermore, the framework exhibits strong generalization in semi-supervised settings, validating its potential to leverage unlabeled visual data for scalable, interpretable spatial representation learning.

AI.title_translation: SpatialSV：通过任务导向视觉监督在多模态大模型中内化可解释的3D空间感知能力
AI.tldr: SpatialSV通过让MLLM主动学习2D到3D的几何转换，实现了更强、更可解释的3D空间感知能力，并降低了对外部工具的依赖。
AI.motivation: 现有的MLLM空间智能提升方法要么依赖高开销的外部工具，要么使用不可解释且缺乏几何约束的隐式特征蒸馏，难以满足复杂3D世界交互的需求。
AI.method: 提出SpatialSV框架，通过任务导向的视觉监督，强制模型将2D视觉特征主动提升为显式的3D表示（包括深度图、相机位姿和点云），从而实现空间意识的内化与透明化。
AI.result: 实验表明SpatialSV在多个模型和基准测试中显著增强了MLLM的空间智能，并且在半监督设置下表现出强大的泛化能力，证明了其在利用未标记数据进行可扩展学习方面的潜力。
AI.conclusion: SpatialSV成功实现了一种既能增强MLLM空间智能，又能提供透明可解释性评估的框架，且具备良好的半监督扩展潜力。
AI.translation: 释放多模态大模型（MLLM）的空间智能对于理解和交互3D世界至关重要。主流方法通常通过外部工具注入空间先验，这会带来显著的推理开销；或者依赖潜在特征蒸馏，但这往往不可解释且缺乏细粒度的几何约束。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了SpatialSV，一个旨在将稳健的3D空间感知内化到MLLM中，同时提供内在可解释性的框架。SpatialSV偏离了被动的特征模仿，采用任务导向的视觉监督，强制模型主动将其2D视觉特征提升为显式的3D表示，包括深度图、相机位姿和点云。至关重要的是，这种2D到3D的提升过程为模型的表示提供了一个透明的窗口：生成的3D重建结果可作为可视化和诊断模型内在空间知识质量的直观代理。在多个模型和基准测试上的广泛实验证明了SpatialSV在增强和解释MLLM空间智能方面的有效性。此外，该框架在半监督设置中展现了强大的泛化能力，验证了其利用未标注视觉数据进行可扩展、可解释空间表示学习的潜力。
AI.summary: SpatialSV是一种用于增强MLLM 3D空间感知能力的新型框架。它通过任务导向的视觉监督，让模型主动学习将2D视觉特征转换为显式的3D表示（如深度、位姿、点云），从而在提升模型性能的同时，通过3D重建实现了对模型内部知识的可解释性评估与诊断。
AI.keywords: 多模态大模型, 3D空间感知, 视觉监督, 可解释性, 2D到3D转换
AI.comments: SpatialSV的创新之处在于抛弃了依赖外部工具或不透明的特征蒸馏，转而采用任务导向的视觉监督，通过明确的2D到3D转换（深度图、位姿、点云）将空间意识内化。这种方法不仅提升了模型性能，还因其可解释性（通过3D重建进行诊断）而具有显著的实际应用价值。

title: A Novel FeFET Differential Bit-Cell With Hybrid Volatile and Non-Volatile Memory Modes
summary: Non-volatile SRAM (nvSRAM) designs have been investigated to address the high leakage power of CMOS-based SRAM and the large write latency of emerging non-volatile memory (eNVM) technologies. However, prior nvSRAM designs that combine SRAM with eNVM devices typically require backup and restore (B\&R) operations and incur significant cell-area overhead. Here, we propose a differential memory bit-cell consisting of a pair of cross-coupled ferroelectric field-effect transistors (FeFETs) and a pair of access transistors, resulting in a four-transistor (4T) structure, which is smaller than conventional 6T SRAM and many prior nvSRAM designs. The proposed bit-cell can be configured to operate in either volatile or non-volatile mode by adjusting the write conditions. In the non-volatile mode, the proposed nvSRAM achieves a store power of 0.13~$μ$W with a 2~ns store time, and no explicit B\&R operation is required. The proposed bit-cell can also be viewed as a cross-coupled gain cell, enabling further applications.

title: ADaPT: Token-Level Decoupling for Efficient Large Reasoning Models
summary: Large reasoning models rely on long chain-of-thought to achieve strong performance, but applying such reasoning uniformly incurs high computational cost. Existing efficiency-oriented methods attempt to shorten or mix reasoning strategies, yet often degrade reasoning capability. We identify the root cause as sequence-level coupling between efficiency incentives and correctness optimization, which implicitly penalizes long but correct reasoning trajectories. To address this issue, we propose Adaptive Dual-Process Thinking (ADaPT), a token-level dual-process framework that explicitly decouples efficiency and correctness signals during training. ADaPT introduces a mode-selection token to control fast and slow reasoning, applying efficiency-related rewards exclusively to this token to avoid penalizing correct long reasoning while encouraging efficiency when appropriate. Moreover, ADaPT enables precise and continuous control over the efficiency-performance trade-off at inference time: by adjusting the generation probability of the mode-selection token, a single trained model can smoothly move along the efficiency-performance Pareto frontier. Extensive experiments demonstrate that ADaPT significantly reduces inference cost while maintaining strong reasoning performance across multiple benchmarks.

AI.title_translation: ADaPT：用于高效大型推理模型的Token级解耦方法
AI.tldr: ADaPT通过在Token级解耦效率和正确性训练，实现了在保持高性能推理的同时，灵活降低大型模型推理成本的目标。
AI.motivation: 大型推理模型依赖长思维链，但统一的推理策略导致计算成本过高；现有的效率优化方法往往会以牺牲推理正确性为代价，因为它们在序列层面将效率激励与正确性优化耦合在一起，错误地惩罚了正确的长推理轨迹。
AI.method: 提出ADaPT（自适应双过程思维）框架，通过引入模式选择Token，在训练时仅对该Token施加效率奖励，从而实现效率信号与正确性信号的解耦；支持推理时通过调整模式选择Token的生成概率来动态平衡效率与性能。
AI.result: 实验表明，ADaPT在多个基准测试中显著降低了推理成本，同时保持了强大的推理性能。
AI.conclusion: ADaPT通过Token级的双过程框架，成功在保持高推理性能的同时显著降低了大型推理模型的计算成本。
AI.translation: 大型推理模型依赖于长思维链来实现强大的性能，但统一应用此类推理策略会产生高昂的计算成本。现有的效率导向方法试图缩短或混合推理策略，但往往会降低推理能力。我们确定了其根本原因是效率激励与正确性优化之间的序列级耦合，这隐式地惩罚了长但正确的推理轨迹。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了自适应双过程思维（ADaPT），这是一个Token级的双过程框架，在训练期间明确解耦了效率和正确性信号。ADaPT引入了一个模式选择Token来控制快速和慢速推理，并将与效率相关的奖励专门应用于该Token，以避免惩罚正确的长推理，同时在适当的时候鼓励效率。此外，ADaPT在推理时实现了对效率-性能权衡的精确和连续控制：通过调整模式选择Token的生成概率，单一训练模型可以在效率-性能帕累托前沿上平滑移动。大量实验表明，ADaPT在多个基准测试中显著降低了推理成本，同时保持了强大的推理性能。
AI.summary: 该论文提出了一种名为ADaPT的Token级双过程框架，旨在解决大型推理模型中长思维链带来的高计算成本问题。通过将效率和正确性信号解耦，并引入模式选择Token，ADaPT既避免了对正确长推理路径的惩罚，又实现了推理阶段的效率与性能动态权衡。
AI.keywords: 大型推理模型, 思维链, 计算效率, 双过程思维, 动态控制
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种创新的训练范式，通过在Token级别解耦效率和正确性，巧妙解决了长思维链模型在追求效率时容易牺牲推理能力的矛盾。其允许在推理阶段动态调节效率与性能的平衡，具有很高的实用价值和灵活性。

title: Deep-Unfolded Coordination
comments: The second and third authors contributed equally (equal second authorship). 35 pages (10 pages main text), 17 figures, 3 tables
summary: Distributed optimization is a highly scalable and structurally transparent technique to solve multi-agent robotics problems; however, such methods often suffer from the need for highly-specialized, problem-specific hyperparameter tunings. In this work, we propose Deep Coordinator, a deep-unfolding framework that learns to dynamically adjust the hyperparameters of ADMM-DDP, a popular distributed solver for robotics tasks, at solve-time in response to optimizer performance. Our architecture consists of unrolling a fixed number of ADMM-DDP iterations into a neural network with learnable functions between layers mapping the optimizer state to the next hyperparameters. To the best of our knowledge, Deep Coordinator is the first deep-unfolding framework to adapt the penalty parameters of a non-convex optimizer at solve-time; we show that the mainstream supervised approach can yield degenerate solutions when training such models, and propose an unsupervised learning scheme. On simulations with fleets of cars and quadrotors, Deep Coordinator produces trajectories of comparable quality 6.18-9.44x faster than conventional solvers. Furthermore, Deep Coordinator retains its performance benefits when deployed to systems up to 8x larger than trained on.

title: eCNNTO: A Highly Generalizable ConvNet for Accelerating Topology Optimization
summary: This work proposes an element-based Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) to accelerate density-based Topology Optimization (TO), termed eCNNTO. TO generally undergoes a large number of iterations, where finite element analysis is performed in every iteration, leading to the efficiency bottleneck especially when dense meshes are used to achieve high-resolution designs. To address this limitation, eCNNTO is proposed to build upon Kallioras et al. (2020), where a Deep Belief Network (DBN) was trained for every element to predict its near-optimal density from its early history, thereby skipping the great majority of iterations and significantly accelerating the TO procedure. However, the method lacks spatial correlations among neighboring elements and may lead to disconnected features in the final structure. The proposed method employs CNN with residual connections to address this issue. On top of it, a novel training strategy is introduced to further enhance the optimization efficiency, where the training dataset consists of the final stage density histories rather than early ones. This change can also help reduce the required training data size. eCNNTO requires only a small dataset to train and yet it can be generalized to problems with largely different boundary conditions, loading cases, design domain geometries, mesh resolutions, as well as non-design domains. In the end, the generalization capabilities and efficiency of eCNNTO are demonstrated through a variety of examples in two and three dimensions, achieving up to 90% and 97% reduction of iterations, respectively.

title: The Tao of Agency: Autotelic AI, Embedded Agency and Dissolution of the Self
summary:
Most artificial intelligence systems are built on the assumption that goals are exogenous and specified by the designer. Exploring what happens when an agent begins generating its own goals opens the field of autotelic AI. Agents are expected not merely to pursue objectives but to discover them. In this article, we trace its consequences through intrinsic motivation, resource-driven priors, causal-interventional learning, homeostasis, and embeddedness; the last of which is found to be a necessary but not sufficient condition for autotelic agency. Embeddedness individuates the agent at the cost of revealing that the individuation is non-unique, such that the same dynamics admit many valid partitions, each defining a different candidate self.
  The deepest problem with autotelic AI is therefore not how the agent generates goals, but how it generates and relativizes the self to which the goals are assigned. The agent must believe in its own boundary in order to act, and see through that boundary in order to understand. We consolidate these developments into a single framework and extend it along three directions: a quantum formulation in which the agent-environment cut becomes physical, a philosophical reading against non-dual contemplative traditions, and a concrete LLM-based agentic instantiation.

AI.title_translation: 代理之道：自生AI、嵌入式代理与自我的解构
AI.tldr: 自生AI不仅要自己设定目标，还必须解决“自我”边界如何构建与相对化的哲学与技术难题。
AI.motivation: 当前人工智能系统依赖于设计者设定的外生目标，缺乏真正的自主性。文章旨在探索AI如何通过生成自己的目标（自生AI）来实现本质上的自主，并解决由此产生的“自我边界”定义问题。
AI.method: 通过整合内在动机、资源驱动先验、因果干预学习、稳态和嵌入性理论，构建了一个统一的自生AI框架；并结合量子力学中“代理-环境”切割的物理化、非二元哲学解读以及大语言模型（LLM）代理实例化进行了验证。
AI.result: 研究发现，嵌入性是自生代理的必要非充分条件；个体的“自我”是个体化过程的产物，且这种个体化是非唯一的，存在多种有效的动力学分区方式。
AI.conclusion: 自生目标AI（Autotelic AI）的核心挑战不在于目标生成，而在于如何构建和相对化“自我”边界。通过将自我视为一种物理和逻辑上的动态分区，可以实现更具自主性的代理模型。
AI.translation: 大多数人工智能系统建立在目标是外生的且由设计者指定的假设之上。探索代理开始生成自身目标时会发生什么，开启了自生AI（autotelic AI）的研究领域。代理不仅被期望追求目标，更被期望发现目标。在本文中，我们通过内在动机、资源驱动先验、因果干预学习、稳态和嵌入性来追踪其后果；其中嵌入性被发现是自生代理的必要非充分条件。嵌入性使代理个体化，但代价是揭示了这种个体化并非唯一，以至于相同的动力学允许许多有效的划分，每一个都定义了一个不同的候选自我。因此，自生AI最深层的问题不是代理如何生成目标，而是它如何生成并相对化被分配目标的自我。代理必须相信自己的边界才能行动，并看穿该边界才能理解。我们将这些进展整合到一个单一的框架中，并沿三个方向扩展：一个将代理-环境的切割物理化的量子表述、一种针对非二元冥想传统的哲学解读，以及一个具体的基于LLM的代理实例化。
AI.summary: 本文探讨了自生AI（Autotelic AI）的理论框架，研究代理如何从外生目标转向自生目标。文章指出，嵌入性是自生代理的基础，但会导致“自我”边界的相对化与非唯一性。通过整合量子力学、哲学思考与LLM技术，作者提出了一种处理自我边界构建与解构的新框架。
AI.keywords: 自生AI, 嵌入式代理, 自我解构, 内在动机, 非二元论
AI.comments: 该论文视角新颖，将AI代理的自主性与哲学中的“无我”概念相结合，挑战了传统AI目标外生的假设。其创新之处在于将“自我”的边界视为一种动态且非唯一的构建，并尝试通过量子力学和非二元哲学框架来重构代理模型。局限性在于其理论跨度极大，具体的LLM实例化细节在摘要中未展开。

title: MemGUI-Agent: An End-to-End Long-Horizon Mobile GUI Agent with Proactive Context Management
summary: MLLM-based mobile GUI agents have made substantial progress on short-horizon tasks, yet remain unreliable on long-horizon tasks that require retaining intermediate facts across many steps and app transitions. We attribute this limitation to ReAct-style prompting, which passively accumulates per-step records, leading to prompt explosion and dilution of critical cross-app facts. To address this, we introduce MemGUI-Agent, an end-to-end long-horizon mobile GUI agent with proactive context management. MemGUI-Agent is built on Context-as-Action (ConAct), which casts context management as first-class actions emitted by the same policy that selects UI actions. Instead of passively appending history, ConAct maintains three structured context fields: folded action history, folded UI state, and recent step record, preserving critical UI facts while keeping context compact. To make proactive context management learnable across model scales, we construct MemGUI-3K, a 2,956-trajectory dataset with full ConAct annotations for supervised training and offline analysis. Training an 8B model on MemGUI-3K produces MemGUI-8B-SFT, an 8B MemGUI-Agent that achieves the best open-data 8B performance on MemGUI-Bench and generalizes to the out-of-distribution MobileWorld benchmark. Code, data, and trained models will be released at https://memgui-agent.github.io/.

title: CARE: Competence-Aware Reward Shaping for Adaptive Reasoning Length in Video-MLLMs
summary: In multimodal video reasoning, reinforcement learning-based methods typically rely on simplistic and inflexible reasoning-length control strategies that fail to adapt to the model's evolving competence. This mismatch may suppress necessary exploration at early stages, while encouraging redundant reasoning and inefficient decoding once the model becomes more competent. In this paper, we propose CARE, a competence-aware reward shaping framework for adaptive reasoning length optimization in multimodal reasoning. Specifically, CARE maintains a smoothed competence estimate via an exponential moving average of pass rates, and uses it to route training into progressive stages that shift the reward preference from exploration-oriented long-form reasoning to efficiency-oriented concise reasoning. To avoid conflating verbosity with intrinsic task complexity, CARE further normalizes reasoning effort with batch-level statistics, and introduces a posterior amplifier to strengthen reward signals for unexpectedly strong performance on historically difficult samples. The proposed mechanism is seamlessly integrated into the GRPO training pipeline and incurs no additional inference-time overhead. Extensive experiments on multiple video reasoning and general video understanding benchmarks demonstrate that CARE consistently improves reasoning accuracy, stabilizes reinforcement learning, and significantly enhances token efficiency. Moreover, CARE exhibits a characteristic inverted-U trajectory of reasoning length during training, and yields shorter yet more informative reasoning traces at convergence, indicating effective adaptive allocation of reasoning budget. We provide the source code for our proposed CARE framework and experiments at https://github.com/1Pansy/Video-CARE.

AI.title_translation: CARE：视频多模态大模型中用于自适应推理长度的能力感知奖励塑造
AI.tldr: CARE是一个为Video-MLLM设计的奖励塑造框架，通过根据模型能力动态调节推理长度，在提升推理精度的同时显著提高了计算效率。
AI.motivation: 现有视频多模态推理中的强化学习方法缺乏灵活性，无法随模型能力演进而动态调整推理长度，导致早期探索受限或后期产生冗余的低效推理。
AI.method: 提出CARE框架，通过指数移动平均（EMA）追踪模型能力，将训练划分为不同阶段，从侧重探索的长推理向侧重效率的简洁推理过渡；通过批次统计归一化推理代价，并利用后验放大器强化对困难样本的奖励信号。
AI.result: 在多个视频推理和理解基准测试中，CARE显著提升了推理准确率，稳定了训练过程，提高了令牌效率，并在收敛时展现出更短且更具信息量的推理轨迹。
AI.conclusion: CARE框架通过引入能力感知奖励塑造，实现了Video-MLLM在推理长度上的自适应优化，有效平衡了模型探索与效率，在提升推理精度的同时显著降低了冗余计算。
AI.translation: 在多模态视频推理中，基于强化学习的方法通常依赖于简单且僵化的推理长度控制策略，无法适应模型能力的演进。这种不匹配可能在早期阶段抑制必要的探索，而在模型变得更有能力后鼓励冗余的推理和低效的解码。在本文中，我们提出了CARE，一个用于多模态推理中自适应推理长度优化的能力感知奖励塑造框架。具体而言，CARE通过通过率的指数移动平均值来维持平滑的能力估计，并利用它将训练引导至渐进阶段，将奖励偏好从面向探索的长形式推理转向面向效率的简洁推理。为了避免将冗余与内在任务复杂度混淆，CARE进一步利用批次级统计数据对推理工作量进行了归一化，并引入了后验放大器来增强对历史上困难样本的超预期表现的奖励信号。所提出的机制无缝集成到GRPO训练流程中，且不会产生额外的推理时间开销。在多个视频推理和通用视频理解基准上的广泛实验表明，CARE持续提高了推理准确性，稳定了强化学习过程，并显著增强了令牌效率。此外，CARE在训练过程中表现出推理长度的倒U型轨迹，并在收敛时产生更短但信息量更大的推理轨迹，表明了推理预算的有效自适应分配。我们提供了CARE框架的源代码及实验结果，网址为 https://github.com/1Pansy/Video-CARE。
AI.summary: 本文提出了CARE框架，旨在解决视频多模态大模型中推理长度控制僵化的问题。该方法通过能力感知奖励塑造，根据模型训练阶段动态调整推理策略，在保障推理精度的前提下，实现了推理长度的自适应优化与令牌效率的显著提升。
AI.keywords: 视频多模态大模型, 强化学习, 奖励塑造, 推理长度优化, 令牌效率
AI.comments: 该研究通过动态奖励塑造解决了视频多模态大模型（Video-MLLM）在推理长度控制上的僵化问题，创新性在于引入了“能力感知”机制，使模型能根据训练进程自动平衡探索与效率。其优势在于无需推理时额外开销，且实验证明该方法在提升准确率的同时显著增强了推理效率，为强化学习在多模态推理任务中的应用提供了有效范式。

title: SWAP: Symmetric Equivariant World-Model for Agile Robot Parkour
summary: While latent world models enable the proactive predictions required for extreme parkour, their purely data-driven nature forces them to redundantly encode left-right symmetric interactions as independent patterns. This inflates the learning burden and hinders the capture of geometric regularities, restricting the latent space's efficiency for downstream policies. To address this, we propose SWAP, an end-to-end equivariant symmetric world model. This framework embeds symmetry directly into both the world model and the actor-critic networks. In real-world tests, the robot leaps across a 2.13 m gap and climbs a 1.63 m platform, breaking records for quadruped parkour. Furthermore, the framework exhibits robust geometric generalization to unseen mirrored terrains and exceptional zero-shot transferability across diverse outdoor environments. These results demonstrate that symmetry equivariance is an effective structural prior for pushing the physical boundaries of learned legged locomotion.

title: Motor Angular Speed Preintegration for Multirotor UAV State Estimation
summary: A precise state estimate is crucial for a tight feedback control that enables agile and near-obstacle flights of UAVs. The state-of-the-art methods fuse slow pose measurements with high-frequency inertial measurements to obtain a precise state estimate. However, the inertial measurements from the IMU onboard the UAV are degraded by vibrations from spinning propellers and the precision of the estimated state suffers. We propose a novel approach based on the preintegration of accelerations obtained from motor speeds. We show that the accelerations obtained in this manner can be used for state propagation on their own to achieve better precision without including the IMU. Further, we propose a factor composed of the preintegrated motor speeds that can be directly employed in factor graph optimization frameworks. We combine our factor with LiDAR measurements into the proposed Motor Angular Speed LiDAR Odometry (MAS-LO) algorithm for precise state estimation, which we open-source. Lastly, we evaluate the estimation precision against a state-of-the-art inertial algorithm LIO-SAM to show 28% improvement in position and 65% in velocity estimation accuracy, 14% lower measurement lag, and high robustness to wrong parameter values.

title: MobileForge: Annotation-Free Adaptation for Mobile GUI Agents with Hierarchical Feedback-Guided Policy Optimization
summary: MLLM-based mobile GUI agents have made substantial progress in UI understanding and action execution, but adapting them to real target apps remains costly because mobile apps are numerous, frequently updated, and hard to cover with human-written tasks, demonstrations, or reward labels. Existing annotation-free GUI learning reduces manual supervision, yet lacks a unified substrate connecting target-app exploration, curriculum mining, rollout execution, and feedback, while policy optimization often relies on isolated rollouts and coarse rewards that are hard to convert into reliable improvement signals. We present MobileForge, an annotation-free adaptation system for mobile GUI agents. MobileForge consists of MobileGym, which grounds task generation and rollout evaluation in real mobile app interaction, and Hierarchical Feedback-Guided Policy Optimization (HiFPO), which turns trajectory outcomes, step-level process feedback, and corrective hints into hint-contextualized step-level GRPO updates. Using only automatically generated annotation-free adaptation data, MobileForge adapts Qwen3-VL-8B to 67.2% Pass@3 on AndroidWorld, close to the closed-data GUI-specialized GUI-Owl-1.5-8B base model at 69.0%. The MobileForge-adapted ForgeOwl-8B further reaches 77.6% Pass@3 on AndroidWorld and 41.0% success on the out-of-domain MobileWorld GUI-only split, establishing the strongest open-data mobile GUI agent in our evaluation. Code, data, and trained models will be released at https://mobile-forge.github.io/.

AI.title_translation: MobileForge：基于分层反馈引导策略优化的移动端 GUI 智能体无标注适应框架
AI.tldr: MobileForge 是一种无需人工标注的移动端 GUI 智能体适应框架，通过分层反馈机制和自动数据生成，实现了智能体在各类应用上的高效学习与性能提升。
AI.motivation: MLLM 移动 GUI 智能体在适应特定应用时面临标注成本高、应用更新频繁且难以覆盖等挑战，现有无标注学习方法缺乏统一的执行与优化闭环，且策略优化信号不够可靠。
AI.method: 提出 MobileForge 系统，包含 MobileGym（负责任务生成与评估）和分层反馈引导策略优化（HiFPO，利用轨迹结果、过程反馈和纠错提示进行步级 GRPO 更新）。
AI.result: MobileForge 使得 Qwen3-VL-8B 在 AndroidWorld 上达到 67.2% Pass@3，ForgeOwl-8B 在 AndroidWorld 上达到 77.6% Pass@3，并在 MobileWorld 上取得 41.0% 的成功率。
AI.conclusion: MobileForge 通过分层反馈引导的策略优化，成功实现了移动端GUI智能体的自动化、低成本适应，达到了开源领域的最优性能。
AI.translation: 基于 MLLM 的移动 GUI 智能体在 UI 理解和动作执行方面取得了巨大进展，但将它们适配到真实目标应用仍然成本高昂，因为移动应用数量众多、更新频繁，且难以通过人工编写的任务、演示或奖励标签来覆盖。现有的无标注 GUI 学习减少了人工监督，但缺乏连接目标应用探索、课程挖掘、执行和反馈的统一基础，且策略优化往往依赖于孤立的执行和难以转化为可靠改进信号的粗粒度奖励。我们提出了 MobileForge，这是一个用于移动 GUI 智能体的无标注适应系统。MobileForge 由 MobileGym（将任务生成和执行评估植根于真实移动应用交互）和分层反馈引导策略优化（HiFPO，将轨迹结果、步骤级过程反馈和纠错提示转化为提示上下文相关的步骤级 GRPO 更新）组成。仅使用自动生成的无标注适应数据，MobileForge 将 Qwen3-VL-8B 在 AndroidWorld 上的 Pass@3 提升至 67.2%，接近闭源数据 GUI 专用模型 GUI-Owl-1.5-8B 的 69.0%。经 MobileForge 适配的 ForgeOwl-8B 在 AndroidWorld 上进一步达到 77.6% 的 Pass@3，并在域外 MobileWorld GUI 分割中达到 41.0% 的成功率，成为我们评估中最强的开源移动 GUI 智能体。代码、数据和训练模型将在 https://mobile-forge.github.io/ 发布。
AI.summary: MobileForge 是一个无需人工标注的移动端 GUI 智能体适应系统。它通过 MobileGym 实现自动化的任务生成与评估，并引入分层反馈引导策略优化（HiFPO），将过程反馈和提示转化为有效的训练信号，从而在不依赖人工数据的情况下显著提升了智能体的执行性能。
AI.keywords: 移动GUI智能体, 无标注适应, 分层反馈引导, 策略优化, 移动应用自动化
AI.comments: MobileForge 的创新之处在于提出了一个无需人工标注的闭环系统，通过分层反馈机制将移动端UI交互转化为有效的策略优化信号，有效解决了现有GUI智能体在面对海量、动态应用时的适应性难题。其性能表现优异，证明了无需昂贵标注即可实现高水平模型微调的可能性。

title: Blame is easier than praise: Measuring off-ball defensive performance in football
summary: The defensive performance of football players is commonly measured through a limited number of actions like tackles and interceptions while their continuous impact through positional behaviour has hardly been studied before. We formulate this problem as an attribution over multi-agent spatiotemporal trajectories without player-level ground truth labels, where event-level changes of expected threat are distributed among individuals. We propose a framework that performs this attribution using player involvement scores calculated from defensive pressure areas (DPAs). By computing role-conditioned baselines within automatically detected team structures, we can determine each defender's expected responsibility for threat created through arbitrary passes. The validity and robustness of this approach are evaluated on a uniquely extensive cross-gender and cross-competition data set, including positional and event data from 64 matches of the men's World Cup, 116 matches of the women's German Bundesliga and 336 matches of the men's German 3. Liga. In the absence of a ground truth, we propose an evaluation protocol that combines multiple relatively weak proxies into robust summary scores. We find a validity score that is improved by around 1 standard deviation compared to the best action-based metric and demonstrate that many popular measures show limited validity. The "blame" for conceding high-value actions shows especially strong correlations with external ratings and market values, making it the first published metric in football to reliably measure positioning errors. All code underlying this work is publicly available to support reproducibility and further research.

AI.title_translation: 责备比赞美更容易：衡量足球中的无球防守表现
AI.tldr: 本研究提出了一种基于位置数据的新框架，通过计算防御压力区域，首次实现了对足球运动员无球防守定位失误的可靠量化评估。
AI.motivation: 现有的足球防守指标多局限于抢断或拦截等离散动作，忽略了球员在无球状态下通过位置行为产生的持续防守影响。
AI.method: 提出一种基于防御压力区域（DPA）的框架，通过在自动检测的团队结构中计算角色条件基准线，将比赛中威胁的变化量化并归因于个人的防守责任。同时，设计了一套结合多种弱代理指标的评估协议来验证结果。
AI.result: 该指标在有效性上比现有的最佳动作指标提升了约1个标准差；研究发现“责备”指标与外部评级及市场价值呈现强相关，是首个能可靠衡量防守定位失误的指标。
AI.conclusion: 该研究证明了基于无球位置行为的防守评估框架优于传统的动作计数指标，特别是在识别防守定位失误方面表现出极高的有效性，并与外部市场价值高度相关。
AI.translation: 足球运动员的防守表现通常通过抢断和拦截等有限的动作来衡量，而他们通过位置行为产生的持续影响此前几乎没有被研究过。我们将此问题表述为多智能体时空轨迹上的归因问题，且无需球员层面的真实标签，将预期威胁的事件级变化分配给个人。我们提出了一个使用防御压力区域（DPA）计算的球员参与度得分进行归因的框架。通过在自动检测的团队结构中计算角色条件基准线，我们可以确定每位防守者对通过任意传球产生的威胁应承担的预期责任。该方法的有效性和稳健性在一个独特的广泛跨性别和跨赛事数据集上进行了评估，包括来自男足世界杯64场比赛、德国女足甲级联赛116场比赛和德国男足丙级联赛336场比赛的位置和事件数据。在缺乏真实标签的情况下，我们提出了一种将多个相对较弱的代理指标结合为稳健汇总得分的评估协议。我们发现，与最佳的基于动作的指标相比，有效性得分提高了约1个标准差，并证明了许多流行指标的有效性有限。为高价值动作“背锅”（即责备）显示出与外部评级和市场价值的极强相关性，使其成为足球领域首个能可靠衡量定位失误的已发表指标。本研究的所有代码均已公开，以支持可重复性和进一步研究。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种评估足球运动员无球防守表现的新框架。通过分析时空轨迹数据，利用防御压力区域（DPA）将预期威胁的变化归因于各个球员，从而量化其在防守中的责任。研究通过跨性别、跨赛事的广泛数据集验证了该方法的有效性，发现该指标在衡量防守定位失误方面优于传统动作导向指标。
AI.keywords: 足球, 防守表现, 无球行为, 时空轨迹, 防御压力区域
AI.comments: 该论文的一大创新在于将防守表现评估从基于动作（如抢断）转向基于无球位置行为，特别是在缺乏球员级真实标签的情况下，通过构建防御压力区域（DPA）和角色条件基准线，成功量化了球员在防守中的“责备”程度。这种方法在评估防守定位失误方面具有开创性意义。

title: Spatial-Aware Reduction Framework: Towards Efficient and Faithful Visual State Space Models
summary: Mamba demonstrates strong efficiency in modeling long visual sequences. However, when token reduction is applied to structurally enhanced Mamba variants, these models exhibit a severe performance collapse. We attribute this degradation to the spatially agnostic nature of existing reduction methods, which violate the two-dimensional structural premise required by the selective scanning mechanism. In this work, we propose STORM, a spatial-aware token reduction framework designed to maintain structural integrity throughout the compression process. STORM reformulates reduction into a structured operation on spatial units, enforcing localized constraints to maintain both grid topology and neighborhood coherence. As a plug-and-play module, STORM equips existing reduction pipelines with explicit spatial awareness without any training. Empirical results demonstrate that STORM achieves state-of-the-art pruning accuracy across diverse vision Mamba backbones under training-free settings. Notably, STORM delivers a substantial accuracy recovery on VMamba, outperforming prior methods by up to 63.3\% in top-1 accuracy. Meanwhile, STORM incurs only a 1.0\% accuracy drop on PlainMamba, achieving performance comparable to ViT.

title: Speeding up the annotation process in semantic segmentation industrial applications
summary: Current machine learning models commonly require large and well-annotated datasets. However, the annotation process often becomes a bottleneck, with increased complexity leading to higher chances of human errors. Within this context, our goal in this paper is to leverage unsupervised algorithms to improve data annotation efficiency for complex semantic segmentation problems in industrial materials science. Previous research has quantified labeling time and others explored unsupervised methods. However, to the best of our knowledge, this is the first study to quantify how much unsupervised algorithms accelerate the labeling process. We aim to validate the extent to which this laborious process can be accelerated, focusing on semantic segmentation tasks that involve annotating each pixel of high-resolution images, such as the microstructure characterization challenge in materials science. Specifically, we demonstrate that by using unsupervised computer vision algorithms, the time required for the labeling process can be reduced from 170 hours to 37 hours, achieving an approximate reduction of 78\%. The dataset we work with includes large images of dimensions 1280x959 and 960x703, which further increases the complexity of the annotation task. Despite these challenges, we create and share the largest public steel microstructure segmentation dataset to date, available under MIT License with permanent DOI, contributing a fully annotated, high-resolution dataset to the field. Additionally, this is the first work to compare the labeling time from scratch (a common approach in previous studies) to the labeling time when using these unsupervised algorithms as a pre-annotation step. Furthermore, we provide a Deep Learning model trained on this dataset, validated by field experts, and deployed in an industrial setting, serving as an initial benchmark for this public dataset.

title: PhysDrift: Bridging the Embodiment Gap in Humanoid Co-Speech Motion Generation
summary: Humanoid robots require co-speech motions that are not only expressive and speech-aligned, but also physically executable under embodiment constraints. Existing co-speech generation pipelines are predominantly human-centric: motions are first generated in human-body representations such as SMPL-X and subsequently retargeted to humanoid robots. In this work, we identify a fundamental embodiment gap in this paradigm, where the mismatch between human motion manifolds and humanoid embodiment constraints disrupts embodiment consistency during motion transfer and physical execution. Through extensive analysis, we show that although retargeting can preserve coarse motion semantics, it significantly compresses motion diversity and weakens prosody-motion synchronization, limiting expressive humanoid behaviors. To address this problem, we first propose IK-EER, a prosody-preserving humanoid motion curation framework that jointly optimizes kinematic feasibility and speech-motion temporal alignment during retargeting. Building upon the curated robot-native motion dataset, we further introduce PhysDrift, an embodiment-aware co-speech motion generation framework that directly predicts executable humanoid joint trajectories from speech without relying on intermediate human-body representations. Unlike conventional human-centric pipelines, PhysDrift maintains embodiment consistency throughout both training and inference while incorporating physical regularization to stabilize robot motion dynamics. Extensive experiments and real-world humanoid deployment demonstrate that embodiment-aware robot-native generation substantially improves speech-motion alignment, physical plausibility, motion smoothness, inference efficiency, and real-time interaction capability.

AI.title_translation: PhysDrift：弥合人形机器人语音驱动动作生成中的具身鸿沟
AI.tldr: PhysDrift 绕过了传统的人体动作重定向流程，通过直接生成符合机器人物理约束的原生动作，显著提升了人形机器人的动作自然度与语音对齐效果。
AI.motivation: 现有的“人转机器人”动作生成流程存在“具身鸿沟”，导致动作在迁移过程中丢失多样性、破坏语音对齐，且难以满足机器人的物理约束。
AI.method: 1. 提出 IK-EER 框架，在重定向过程中联合优化运动学可行性与语音-动作的时间对齐；2. 提出 PhysDrift 框架，直接从语音预测人形机器人关节轨迹，引入物理正则化以增强动作稳定性。
AI.result: 实验证明 PhysDrift 在语音-动作对齐、物理合理性、运动平滑度及实时推理能力方面显著优于现有的以人为中心的生成管线。
AI.conclusion: PhysDrift 框架证明了直接生成原生人形机器人动作优于传统的重定向方法，在物理可行性、语音对齐和实时性方面表现更佳。
AI.translation: 人形机器人需要不仅具有表现力且与语音对齐，同时还要在具身约束下具有物理可执行性的协同语音动作。现有的协同语音生成流程主要以人为中心：动作首先以人体表示（如 SMPL-X）生成，随后重定向到人形机器人。在这项工作中，我们确定了该范式中存在的根本性“具身鸿沟”，即人体运动流形与人形具身约束之间的不匹配，破坏了运动迁移和物理执行过程中的具身一致性。通过广泛分析，我们表明虽然重定向可以保留粗略的动作语义，但它显著压缩了动作多样性并削弱了韵律-动作同步，限制了人形机器人的表现力。为了解决这个问题，我们首先提出了 IK-EER，这是一个韵律保持的人形动作策展框架，在重定向过程中联合优化运动学可行性和语音-动作时间对齐。基于策展后的机器人原生动作数据集，我们进一步引入了 PhysDrift，这是一个具身感知的协同语音动作生成框架，无需依赖中间的人体表示，直接从语音预测可执行的人形关节轨迹。与传统的以人为中心的流程不同，PhysDrift 在训练和推理过程中保持了具身一致性，同时纳入了物理正则化以稳定机器人运动动力学。广泛的实验和真实世界的人形机器人部署表明，具身感知的机器人原生生成显著提高了语音-动作对齐、物理合理性、运动平滑度、推理效率和实时交互能力。
AI.summary: 本文针对人形机器人语音驱动动作生成中存在的“具身鸿沟”问题，提出了 IK-EER 动作策展框架与 PhysDrift 生成框架，通过直接生成原生机器人动作，绕过了传统重定向带来的性能损失，实现了更自然、更具物理可行性的交互体验。
AI.keywords: 人形机器人, 语音驱动动作生成, 具身智能, 动作重定向, 物理一致性
AI.comments: 该研究通过直接针对人形机器人进行原生动作生成，而非依赖传统的“人转机器人”流程，有效解决了动作迁移中的语义丢失与物理不一致问题，为具身智能领域提供了重要的范式转变。

title: Prismriver: Formalization of Music Theory and Algorithmic Composition in Lean 4
summary: Music theory obeys a rich set of mathematical rules and symmetries. These symmetries follow mathematical structure which can be verified and expressioned in the precise language of a proof assistant. In this paper, we present Prismriver, a formalization of music theory in Lean 4. By formalizing music theory in Lean 4, we open the door to verifiable algorithmic composition and accompaniment generation. We also enable the analysis of monadic analysis of structures in music.

AI.title_translation: Prismriver：Lean 4中音乐理论的形式化与算法作曲
AI.tldr: Prismriver是一个基于Lean 4的音乐理论形式化框架，旨在实现可验证的算法作曲与音乐结构分析。
AI.motivation: 音乐理论蕴含丰富的数学规则与对称性，作者旨在利用证明助手的精确语言对这些结构进行形式化，从而支持可验证的算法作曲及音乐分析。
AI.method: 在Lean 4证明助手中对音乐理论进行形式化建模，利用其证明辅助特性对音乐结构和对称性进行数学定义与验证。
AI.result: 成功开发了Prismriver系统，实现了音乐理论在Lean 4中的形式化，并支持了音乐结构的单子（monadic）分析。
AI.conclusion: Prismriver为音乐理论在Lean 4中的形式化提供了一个基础框架，为未来可验证的算法作曲和音乐结构分析奠定了基础。
AI.translation: 音乐理论遵循一套丰富的数学规则和对称性。这些对称性遵循数学结构，可以在证明助手的精确语言中进行验证和表达。在本文中，我们提出了Prismriver，这是Lean 4中音乐理论的一种形式化方法。通过在Lean 4中形式化音乐理论，我们为可验证的算法作曲和伴奏生成打开了大门。我们还实现了音乐中结构的单子分析。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了Prismriver，这是一个基于Lean 4证明助手的音乐理论形式化系统。通过将音乐理论规则数学化，该系统实现了音乐结构的可验证性，并为算法作曲、自动伴奏生成及音乐结构的深入分析提供了新的工具。
AI.keywords: 音乐理论, Lean 4, 形式化验证, 算法作曲, 数学结构
AI.comments: 该研究通过将音乐理论形式化引入Lean 4证明助手，不仅为音乐理论的严谨性提供了数学基础，还为计算机辅助作曲提供了可验证的框架，具有很强的跨学科创新性。局限性在于目前仅提及框架建立，尚未展示大规模实际作曲应用的效果。

title: AutoTam: Specifying Secure Protocol Implementations with Tamarin Model Generation
summary:
Formal verification is a challenging but important task for ensuring the security of cryptographic protocols. While modern protocol verification tools significantly reduce verification effort, modelling remains challenging to practitioners without a background in formal verification. In addition, transferring verification results to a concrete protocol implementation requires expert knowledge.
  In this paper, we present a novel language-first method for verification of trace properties using a domain-specific language for protocol implementations. We target the Tamarin prover for verification, and we prove that verified universal trace properties translate back to the implementation. We additionally integrate symbolic execution in order to analyse the memory safety of protocol implementations. We use our tool to implement and generate accurate models for a signed Diffie-Hellman protocol, and for the WireGuard VPN protocol. Our WireGuard implementation is interoperable with existing implementations when using our interpreter, and achieves acceptable performance. We formally prove our implementations secure using a combination of symbolic execution and verification of the generated Tamarin models.

AI.title_translation: AutoTam：通过Tamarin模型生成实现安全协议的规范化
AI.tldr: AutoTam是一种通过领域特定语言自动生成Tamarin验证模型并结合符号执行的方法，有效降低了协议安全验证的难度，并保障了实际实现的安全性。
AI.motivation: 现有的形式化验证工具对从业者要求较高，且将验证结果映射到具体的协议实现过程复杂，缺乏将实现与模型有效关联的方法。
AI.method: 提出了一种面向协议实现的领域特定语言，通过该语言自动生成Tamarin证明模型，并结合符号执行技术分析实现的内存安全性，最后证明了验证的追踪属性可映射回具体实现。
AI.result: 成功实现并验证了签名Diffie-Hellman协议和WireGuard VPN协议，WireGuard实现不仅保持了互操作性，且性能可接受，同时通过了符号执行和Tamarin模型验证的安全性证明。
AI.conclusion: AutoTam成功实现了从协议实现到形式化模型验证的自动化桥梁，证明了在保证安全性的前提下，降低协议开发和验证难度是可行的。
AI.translation: 形式化验证是确保密码协议安全的重要但具有挑战性的任务。虽然现代协议验证工具显著降低了验证工作量，但对于没有形式化验证背景的从业者来说，建模仍然具有挑战性。此外，将验证结果转换为具体的协议实现需要专家知识。在本文中，我们提出了一种用于追踪属性验证的新型语言优先方法，该方法使用了一种用于协议实现的领域特定语言。我们以Tamarin prover为验证目标，并证明了经过验证的通用追踪属性可以转换回实现中。此外，我们集成了符号执行，以分析协议实现的内存安全性。我们使用我们的工具实现并生成了签名Diffie-Hellman协议和WireGuard VPN协议的准确模型。当使用我们的解释器时，我们的WireGuard实现与现有实现互操作，并实现了可接受的性能。我们结合符号执行和生成的Tamarin模型的验证，正式证明了我们的实现是安全的。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为AutoTam的语言优先方法，通过领域特定语言编写协议实现，并自动生成Tamarin模型进行形式化验证。该方法不仅实现了验证属性到代码的映射，还通过符号执行增强了内存安全分析，成功应用于包括WireGuard在内的实际协议，有效降低了协议安全验证的门槛。
AI.keywords: 形式化验证, Tamarin Prover, 协议实现, 符号执行, 安全性保障
AI.comments: 该研究通过领域特定语言（DSL）弥合了形式化验证与实际代码实现之间的鸿沟，降低了安全协议建模的门槛。其创新之处在于能够自动生成Tamarin模型并证明实现与模型的一致性，同时结合符号执行增强了内存安全性，在WireGuard等实际协议上的应用验证了其有效性和性能。

title: Triangular Consistency as a Universal Constraint for Learning Optical Flow
summary: We propose triangular consistency as a first-principled constraint for optical flow, which is agnostic to network architecture, supervision type, and dataset, and applies to both image-pair and multi-frame settings. This simple but powerful constraint is to compose two flows to induce a third flow and enforce consistency among the three. The composed flows may arise from (i) image pairs, yielding cycle consistency; (ii) multiple video frames, producing longer-range motion through temporal chaining; or (iii) image pairs combined with controlled synthetic transformations, which becomes data augmentation. This triangular consistency introduces negligible computational overhead and requires no additional annotations. Since it is derived directly from the geometry of optical flow, it does not rely on model-specific assumptions and serves as a ``universal'' plug-and-play component for optical flow training. Experiments show consistent improvement across supervised, unsupervised, and transfer learning settings.

AI.title_translation: 三角一致性：作为光流学习的一种通用约束
AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于几何原理的“三角一致性”约束，作为一种即插即用的通用工具，显著提升了各类光流学习任务的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的光流训练方法通常依赖特定的网络架构或监督类型，缺乏一种能够在各种设置下普遍适用的几何约束来提升模型性能。
AI.method: 提出了一种基于三角一致性的约束方法，通过组合两个光流场来诱导第三个光流场并强制三者之间的一致性。该方法可应用于图像对（循环一致性）、视频帧（时间链式结构）以及合成变换（数据增强）等多种场景。
AI.result: 实验证明，该方法在监督学习、无监督学习及迁移学习等多种设置下均能带来持续的性能提升，且计算开销极小。
AI.conclusion: 三角一致性是一种通用的、轻量级的几何约束，能够有效提升光流估计在多种学习设置下的性能，且无需额外标注。
AI.translation: 我们提出了三角一致性作为光流的一种第一性原理约束，它与网络架构、监督类型和数据集无关，适用于图像对和多帧设置。这一简单而强大的约束是将两个光流组合以诱导第三个光流，并强制三者之间的一致性。组合的光流可以来自：(i) 图像对，产生循环一致性；(ii) 多个视频帧，通过时间链式结构产生长距离运动；或 (iii) 图像对与受控合成变换的结合，这构成了数据增强。这种三角一致性带来的计算开销微乎其微，且不需要额外的标注。由于它直接源于光流的几何结构，因此不依赖于模型特定的假设，并作为光流训练的一种“通用”即插即用组件。实验表明，它在监督学习、无监督学习和迁移学习设置中均表现出持续的改进。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种通用的“三角一致性”约束方法，通过强制三个光流场之间的一致性，将其作为一种即插即用的组件应用于光流训练，有效提升了模型性能且无需额外标注或增加显著计算开销。
AI.keywords: 光流, 三角一致性, 几何约束, 深度学习, 通用训练策略
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种极具通用性的“三角一致性”约束，其核心优势在于不依赖特定网络架构或监督方式，能够作为即插即用的模块提升现有光流算法的性能。这种基于几何原理的设计非常简洁且高效，为提升光流估计的鲁棒性提供了一种通用的优化思路。

title: DiffMath: Symbol- and Graph-Aware Latent Diffusion Transformer for Handwritten Mathematical Expression Generation
summary: Handwritten Mathematical Expression Generation (HMEG) is challenging due to the complex two-dimensional layouts and long-range structural dependencies of mathematical expressions. Existing methods typically rely on explicit spatial supervision, such as symbol-level bounding boxes, which incurs high annotation costs and limits scalability. In this work, we propose DiffMath, a symbol- and graph-aware latent diffusion framework that leverages the hierarchical structure inherent in LaTeX as a structural prior, eliminating the need for positional supervision. First, we design a Relational Abstract Syntax Tree (RelAST), a generation-oriented representation that distills MathML trees into compact triplet sequences [S, R, D], where each token directly encodes a symbol identity, spatial relation, or nesting depth. Second, we introduce MathVAE, which learns structure-preserving latent representations through symbol-aware and relation-aware perceptual regularization, ensuring that the latent space captures both character semantics and spatial topology. Third, MathDiT performs conditional denoising in this structured latent space, further guided by a global symbol-count prior via Adaptive Layer Normalization (AdaLN) to improve structural coherence. Experiments show that DiffMath produces structurally consistent handwritten expressions, achieves superior performance over existing methods, and improves the accuracy of downstream OCR models through synthetic data augmentation.

title: Compositionality Emerges in a Narrow Depth-Connectivity Regime: Architecture Constraints and Solution Manifolds
summary: Compositionality is believed to be the foundation for generalization, enabling models to reuse meaningful primitives in novel combinations. Yet, models trained with standard gradient-based optimization rarely, and often only weakly, exhibit compositional internal structure, and it remains unclear how or why such compositionality forms. In this work, we show that compositionality emerges in a narrow connectivity-depth sweet spot. Along the connectivity axis, compositionality only appears in some specifically sparse networks, heavily depends on which connections remain rather than on weights' sparsity alone. Along the depth axis, compositionality emerges within a narrow, target-dependent regime, peaking at specific depths, while both shallower and deeper networks fail. When either the depth or connectivity condition is violated, gradient descent silently converges to fractured solutions rather than compositional ones. To discover and exploit this emergence, we introduce (i) similarity-based pruning (SP) to recover compositional connectivity and (ii) a heuristic depth predictor to estimate where compositionality is most likely to appear. Finally, we support these empirical findings with a theoretical framework based on compositional sparsity, volume-ratio arguments, and feature-interference bounds, explaining why compositional solutions are reachable only in a narrow depth-connectivity regime.

title: Timage: A Generative Text-in-Image Paradigm for Fine-Tuning Vision-Language Models
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) often lose track of the right image regions during fine-grained spatial reasoning, because a textual query rarely carries any explicit geometric anchor into the pixel domain. Prevailing remedies either rewire the model's weights or pad the prompt with verbose instructions, yet neither reliably pins the language to the correct visual coordinates without eroding the backbone's general competence. We introduce Timage, a paradigm that recasts multimodal understanding as an alignment problem solved at the input: the query is drawn, as a typeset overlay, onto the image itself. The placement and appearance of this overlay are produced by a Constrained Schrödinger Bridge (cSB), an entropic optimal-transport sampler that factorizes layout synthesis into two coupled stochastic stages. The first stage, Region Search, transports noise toward query-aligned image zones while obeying a hard occlusion barrier that protects salient foreground content; the second stage, Appearance Shaping, sizes the glyphs through an ``ink-budget'' regularizer so that the rendered text stays legible and visually balanced. The resulting overlay behaves as an explicit attention beacon that channels the model's focus along spatial semantics. On the VMCBench suite, Timage paired with a modest 7B backbone clearly overtakes far larger proprietary systems as well as parameter-tuned baselines. The study positions deliberate input reconstruction as a powerful, architecture-neutral lever for strengthening multimodal reasoning.
