title: Data dependent Shepard approximation through and adaptive modification of the shape parameter
summary: In this article, we introduce a novel data-dependent Shepard interpolation method inspired by the adaptive strategies proposed in [2]. In this case, as Shepard interpolation does not produce oscillations, our approach has the core objective of reducing the smearing near jump discontinuities in the data in one and two dimensions. While the original work in [2] focuses in on Radial Basis Function (RBF) interpolation, we extend these ideas to the Shepard framework by incorporating a data-dependent adaptation mechanism. Specifically, we modify the classical Shepard interpolation by adaptively adjusting the influence weights based on local smoothness indicators that modify the shape parameter. These indicators, similar to those used in [2], are designed to detect discontinuities: for grid-based data, we use squared undivided second-order differences, and for scattered data, we employ squared least-squares approximations of the Laplacian scaled by the square of the mean local separation of stencil points. The resulting data-dependent weighting scheme forces the kernels close to a discontinuity to behave like a local delta function, effectively reducing the smearing of the discontinuities introduced by the classical Shepard approach. We establish the theoretical foundation of the method, including the properties of the new interpolation and we theoretically prove that the reduction of the smearing of discontinuities is possible. Numerical experiments in one and two dimensions confirm that the proposed data-dependent Shepard interpolation significantly reduces the smearing of jump discontinuities while maintaining high accuracy in smooth regions.

title: SoftSkill: Behavioral Compression for Contextual Adaptation
summary: Agent skills are commonly deployed as natural-language Markdown files that encode answer policies, evidence-use habits, and task procedures. These files are readable and portable, but they are consumed indirectly: for each task instance, a frozen language model must translate a long textual artifact into generation-time behavior. This paper asks whether a natural-language skill can instead initialize a compact continuous context object, refined by a trainable soft delta while the base model remains frozen. We propose SoftSkill, a frozen-backbone method that tunes such soft skills with next-token prediction and deploys them as latent behavioral priors at inference time. In our main single-round setting, a length-32 SoftSkill prefix on Qwen3.5-4B improves over no-skill prompting by 8.3 points on SearchQA, 42.1 points on LiveMath, and 1.3 points on DocVQA. Relative to SkillOpt, SoftSkill improves accuracy by 5.2 points on SearchQA and 12.5 points on LiveMath, while replacing hundreds to thousands of Markdown skill tokens with a few virtual tokens. We further study agentic execution as a harder boundary case, where sparse trajectory imitation provides useful signal but does not yet robustly compress long-horizon procedural behavior. More broadly, the results suggest that some task skills are better treated not as additional Markdown to be reinterpreted at inference time, but as compact latent controls over how a frozen model enters the task.

AI.title_translation: SoftSkill：面向上下文适应的行为压缩
AI.tldr: 通过将复杂的文本任务指令压缩为紧凑的潜在前缀向量，SoftSkill 实现了在保持骨干模型冻结的同时，显著提升了代理在多种任务中的执行性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的 Markdown 自然语言技能需要模型在每次任务时进行昂贵的重解释，效率低下。作者旨在探讨是否能将这些技能转化为紧凑的、可训练的连续上下文对象，从而实现更高效的上下文适应。
AI.method: 提出 SoftSkill 方法，通过下个 token 预测对软技能（长度为 32 的前缀）进行微调，并将其作为冻结骨干模型（如 Qwen3.5-4B）的潜在行为先验，无需在推理时重新解释长文本技能。
AI.result: 在 SearchQA、LiveMath 和 DocVQA 等任务上，SoftSkill 显著优于无技能提示和 SkillOpt，且将数百至数千个文本 token 压缩为仅 32 个虚拟 token。但研究发现该方法在处理长程复杂执行任务时仍面临挑战。
AI.conclusion: SoftSkill 证明了将任务技能压缩为冻结模型的可训练软前缀是有效的，能够实现比传统文本提示更高效、更精准的上下文适应。
AI.translation: 代理技能通常以自然语言 Markdown 文件的形式部署，用于编码回答策略、证据使用习惯和任务流程。这些文件虽然可读且可移植，但使用效率较低：对于每个任务实例，冻结的语言模型必须将长文本转化为生成时的行为。本文探讨了自然语言技能是否可以初始化为一个紧凑的连续上下文对象，并通过可训练的软增量进行优化，同时保持基础模型冻结。我们提出了 SoftSkill，这是一种冻结骨干模型的方法，通过下个 token 预测来调整此类软技能，并在推理时将其作为潜在的行为先验进行部署。在主要的单轮设置中，Qwen3.5-4B 上长度为 32 的 SoftSkill 前缀在 SearchQA 上比无技能提示提高了 8.3 个点，在 LiveMath 上提高了 42.1 个点，在 DocVQA 上提高了 1.3 个点。相对于 SkillOpt，SoftSkill 在 SearchQA 上将准确率提高了 5.2 个点，在 LiveMath 上提高了 12.5 个点，同时将数百到数千个 Markdown 技能 token 替换为少数虚拟 token。我们进一步研究了作为更难边界情况的代理执行，其中稀疏轨迹模仿提供了有用的信号，但尚未能稳健地压缩长程程序化行为。更广泛地说，结果表明，某些任务技能与其作为在推理时需要重新解释的额外 Markdown 处理，不如作为冻结模型进入任务方式的紧凑潜在控制。
AI.summary: 本文提出 SoftSkill，一种将自然语言任务技能压缩为冻结语言模型可学习的紧凑潜在前缀的方法，替代了传统的 Markdown 文本提示，实现了更高效的行为引导和性能提升。
AI.keywords: 软技能, 行为压缩, 上下文适应, 冻结骨干模型, 潜在先验
AI.comments: SoftSkill 提出了一种将自然语言技能转化为紧凑连续潜在向量的方法，不仅提升了模型性能，还显著降低了推理时的上下文开销。这标志着从“文本提示”向“潜在行为先验”范式的转变，具有很高的实用价值和理论意义。但对于长程复杂行为的压缩仍存在局限性。

title: Autonomous Driving with Priority-Ordered STL Specifications Under Multimodal Uncertainty
summary: Autonomous vehicles must plan trajectories that satisfy a multitude of requirements on safety, passenger comfort, and compliance with traffic rules. However, in safety-critical scenarios, it is not always possible to satisfy all requirements simultaneously, necessitating their prioritization based on importance. At the same time, in these safety-critical scenarios, the uncertainty in trajectory predictions of the surrounding traffic, such as other vehicles and pedestrians, should be explicitly accounted for. In this work, we propose an uncertainty-aware trajectory planning framework that incorporates a predefined lexicographic ordering over Signal Temporal Logic (STL) specifications that stays valid under uncertainty. We implement this formulation with Model Predictive Path Integral (MPPI) control and we demonstrate the effectiveness of our method on simulation scenarios, showing that our framework efficiently handles conflicting objectives under realistic multi-modal uncertainty.

title: Critical Percolation as a Synthetic Data Model for Interpretability
comments: 21 pages, 10 figures, accepted to the Mechanistic Interpretability Workshop at ICML 2026
summary: Neural networks learn features that reflect the hierarchical, multi-scale structure of natural data. Synthetic datasets used to evaluate interpretability methods typically lack this structure, limiting their value as realistic toy models. To close this gap, we introduce a family of synthetic datasets consisting of hierarchical functions defined on critical mean-field percolation clusters embedded in a high-dimensional data space. The percolation data consists of sparse, low-dimensional fractal clusters with a power-law size distribution. Latent variables modeling a taxonomic hierarchy generate each data point's target value. The data model is analytically tractable with known critical exponents that fix its properties without requiring hyperparameter tuning. We leverage a mapping between percolation clusters, random trees, and additive coalescence to propose an almost linear-time algorithm to jointly sample a random tree and its hierarchical latent decomposition, enabling data generation at arbitrary scale. Using probing experiments, we find that the model's ground-truth latent variables can be linearly decoded from neural network activations. Together, sparsity, self-similarity, power-law statistics, and analytical tractability make critical percolation a principled testbed for interpretability research.

AI.title_translation: 作为可解释性合成数据模型的临界逾渗
AI.tldr: 引入了一种基于临界逾渗的新型合成数据集，旨在通过模拟自然数据的分形和层次结构，为神经网络的可解释性评估提供一个科学且易于分析的基准。
AI.motivation: 现有的可解释性研究中使用的合成数据集缺乏自然数据所具备的层次化、多尺度结构，难以真实反映神经网络在复杂任务中的特征学习表现。
AI.method: 提出了一种基于临界平均场逾渗簇的合成数据集生成方法，利用逾渗簇、随机树和加性合并之间的映射，开发了一种近线性时间复杂度的算法来采样随机树及其层次化潜在分解。
AI.result: 通过探测实验证明，神经网络的激活值中可以线性解码出该模型的地面真值潜在变量，验证了该模型作为可解释性研究基准的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 临界逾渗模型为可解释性研究提供了一个具备稀疏性、自相似性和幂律统计特性的理想合成测试平台，能够有效验证神经网络对层次化潜在特征的提取能力。
AI.translation: 神经网络学习到的特征反映了自然数据中层次化、多尺度的结构。用于评估可解释性方法的合成数据集通常缺乏这种结构，限制了它们作为现实玩具模型的价值。为了弥补这一差距，我们引入了一系列由定义在嵌入高维数据空间的临界平均场逾渗簇上的层次函数组成的合成数据集。逾渗数据由稀疏的、低维的分形簇组成，具有幂律尺寸分布。建模分类层次结构的潜在变量生成了每个数据点的目标值。该数据模型在解析上是可处理的，具有已知的临界指数，无需超参数调整即可固定其属性。我们利用逾渗簇、随机树和加性合并之间的映射，提出了一种近线性时间的算法来联合采样随机树及其层次化潜在分解，从而实现了任意尺度的生成。通过探测实验，我们发现模型的地面真值潜在变量可以从神经网络激活中线性解码出来。总之，稀疏性、自相似性、幂律统计和解析可解性使得临界逾渗成为可解释性研究的一个原则性测试平台。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种基于临界逾渗理论的合成数据集生成模型，该模型通过在逾渗簇上定义层次函数，模拟了自然数据中的稀疏、分形和幂律分布特性，为评估神经网络的可解释性提供了一个具有解析性质的标准化测试框架。
AI.keywords: 临界逾渗, 神经网络可解释性, 合成数据集, 分形结构, 层次特征
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地引入了统计物理中的临界逾渗（Critical Percolation）概念，为可解释性研究提供了一个具有数学严谨性和多尺度结构的合成数据集。其优势在于克服了以往合成数据缺乏自然数据层次结构的局限性，且具有解析可解性，为评估模型特征学习能力提供了可靠的基准。

title: A cubical formalisation of conditional independence, Bayesian conditioning, and Pearl's d-separation soundness
summary: The standard convex-algebra interchange axiom, common to probability-monad formalisations since Stone, is provably too weak to support full Bayesian conditioning. We make this precise in Cubical Agda: finite distributions as a higher inductive type, conditional independence as a cubical path between kernels, recursive Bayesian conditioning as a total function on a full-support fragment. Lifting conditioning to the full HIT exposes a structural mismatch -- the two halves of the rearranged 4-leaf mix carry distinct Bayesian weights related by Bayes' formula, not the single shared inner weight the standard axiom provides. We exhibit the minimal generalisation that resolves this and prove the standard form is the degenerate case where the two inner weights coincide. Around this observation we verify the algebraic context constructively, with zero postulates above an abstract ordered-field interface: bind commutativity, the four semi-graphoid axioms, intersection (reduced to contraction via structural $Σ$-witnesses, without positivity), Pearl's do-calculus Rules~1, 2, and~3 in kernel form, finite-type Bayesian conditioning, and Pearl's d-separation theorem (soundness) on arbitrary $n$-vertex finite directed acyclic graphs (DAGs) in both interventional and Bayesian forms. The probability monad is also verified as a Markov category; the abstract interface discharges at $Q$.

AI.title_translation: 条件独立性、贝叶斯条件化与Pearl的d-分离可靠性的立方形式化
AI.tldr: 本文在Cubical Agda中修正了概率论的形式化公理，并构造性地证明了Pearl的d-分离定理及do-calculus。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于Stone的概率单子形式化方法中，标准的凸代数交换公理在支持完全贝叶斯条件化时显得过于薄弱，导致结构性失配。
AI.method: 使用Cubical Agda进行形式化验证；将有限分布定义为高阶归纳类型（HIT）；将条件独立性定义为核之间的立方路径；引入最小推广公理以解决标准凸代数公理的结构不匹配问题；在抽象有序域接口上进行构造性验证。
AI.result: 证明了标准形式是两个内部权重重合时的退化情况；验证了绑定交换律、半图论公理、Pearl的do-calculus规则以及在任意有限DAG上的d-分离定理。
AI.conclusion: 作者成功地在Cubical Agda中形式化了条件独立性和贝叶斯推理，证明了Pearl的d-分离定理的可靠性，并揭示了现有概率公理体系在处理贝叶斯条件化时的结构性局限及其修正方法。
AI.translation: 自Stone以来的概率单子形式化中，标准的凸代数交换公理被证明过于薄弱，无法支持完全的贝叶斯条件化。我们在Cubical Agda中精确地阐述了这一点：将有限分布作为高阶归纳类型（HIT），将条件独立性作为核之间的立方路径，并将递归贝叶斯条件化作为全支持片段上的全函数。将条件化提升至完整的HIT暴露了一个结构性失配——重排后的4叶混合的两部分带有由贝叶斯公式关联的不同贝叶斯权重，而非标准公理所提供的单一共享内部权重。我们展示了解决这一问题的最小推广，并证明了标准形式是两个内部权重重合时的退化情况。围绕这一观察，我们在抽象有序域接口之上，无需额外公理，构造性地验证了代数背景：绑定交换律、四个半图论公理、交集公理、核形式的Pearl do-calculus规则1、2和3、有限类型贝叶斯条件化，以及任意n顶点有限有向无环图（DAG）上干预形式和贝叶斯形式的Pearl d-分离定理（可靠性）。概率单子也被验证为Markov范畴。
AI.summary: 本文在Cubical Agda中对条件独立性和贝叶斯条件化进行了形式化。研究发现标准凸代数公理不足以支持贝叶斯条件化，并提出了一个最小推广方案。基于此，作者构造性地验证了Pearl的d-分离定理及其do-calculus，并证明了概率单子作为Markov范畴的性质。
AI.keywords: 立方类型论, 贝叶斯条件化, 条件独立性, d-分离, Cubical Agda
AI.comments: 该论文通过立方类型论（Cubical Agda）解决了概率论形式化中的核心结构缺陷。其创新之处在于通过区分贝叶斯权重，修正了传统凸代数公理在贝叶斯条件化中的不足，并以构造性的方式证明了Pearl的d-分离定理和do-calculus。这是一项极具理论深度的成果，将概率图模型与现代类型论进行了严谨的结合。

title: On the Variance of Temporal Difference Learning and its Reduction Using Control Variates
summary: We analyze the variance of temporal difference (TD) learning using the phased setting with tabular representation, and show that one of the mechanisms behind its ability to reduce variance is by effectively aggregating over a larger number of independent trajectories. Based on this insight, we demonstrate that (1) the variance of TD is asymptotically bounded from above by Monte Carlo (MC) estimators, and (2) shorter horizon updates incurs less variance for a fixed number of samples. Beyond TD, we show that Direct Advantage Estimation (DAE), a method for estimating the advantage function, can be seen as a type of regression-adjusted control variate, which achieves a tighter bound on the variance compared to TD in the large-sample limit. Finally, we numerically illustrate the behaviors of these estimators with carefully designed environments.

title: Train, Retrieve, or Both? A Four-Arm Head-to-Head for Correct Statutory Citation on the Ontario Residential Tenancies Act
summary: Self-represented tenants, landlords, and help-desk staff need to be pointed at the provision of law that actually governs a question, with a correct statutory citation. We study this task on the Ontario Residential Tenancies Act, 2006 (RTA) and its core regulation, asking the operator's question empirically: is fine-tuning enough, or is hybrid retrieval needed? We run a four-arm head-to-head on Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct (base zero-shot, LoRA SFT-only, RAG-only, and an SFT+RAG hybrid), scored on citation exact-match (section+subsection) over a small, human-verification-pending real eval set. The base model cannot cite the RTA and SFT-only mis-recalls sections; retrieval is essential and drives hallucination to zero by construction; and the SFT+RAG hybrid scores highest at 0.481 exact-match with zero hallucinated citations. Its edge comes from SFT making provision selection more robust to the higher-recall candidate sets that hurt zero-shot RAG. Notably, this cheap bge-small hybrid matches or beats a pipeline built on bigger, specialized retrieval models (a larger embedder and a cross-encoder reranker), and a larger/improved training set does not help either: strong statutory-citation performance here does not require specialized retrieval models or more data. The artifact zeroes hallucination and clears the lift-over-base bar but does not reach the aspirational 0.70 exact-match target. All results are on a small, human-verification-pending real eval set and are reported as preliminary.

AI.title_translation: 训练、检索，还是两者兼备？针对安大略省住宅租赁法正确法律引用的四臂对比研究
AI.tldr: 在法律条文引用任务中，SFT+RAG混合方案优于单一方法，不仅能消除幻觉，还能以较低算力成本实现最佳的引用准确率。
AI.motivation: 解决自我辩护的租户、房东及咨询人员在处理住宅租赁法律问题时，难以精准定位并引用正确法律条款的痛点。
AI.method: 采用四臂对比实验，基于Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct模型，对比了零样本（base）、仅微调（LoRA SFT）、仅检索（RAG）以及SFT+RAG混合方案在安大略省住宅租赁法（RTA）引用任务上的表现。
AI.result: SFT+RAG混合方案表现最佳，精确匹配得分达到0.481且实现了零幻觉。该方案优于仅微调或仅检索方法，且证明了轻量级模型搭配基础检索组件即可达到甚至超越复杂检索流水线的效果。
AI.conclusion: 对于法律条文引用任务，SFT+RAG混合架构是最佳方案。微调增强了模型对检索候选集的鲁棒性，从而在保持零幻觉的同时提升了精确匹配率。研究表明，针对特定任务的优化比单纯增加模型参数或数据量更为有效。
AI.translation: 自我辩护的租户、房东和咨询台工作人员需要被指引到真正管辖其问题的法律条款，并提供正确的法定引用。我们在《2006年安大略省住宅租赁法》（RTA）及其核心法规上研究了这一任务，并实证性地提出了操作者的问题：微调是否足够，还是需要混合检索？我们对Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct模型进行了四臂对比测试（基础零样本、LoRA仅微调、仅RAG、以及SFT+RAG混合），并在一个小型、待人工验证的真实评估集上以引用精确匹配（条款+子条款）进行评分。基础模型无法引用RTA，且仅微调模型会错误记忆条款；检索是必不可少的，并通过构建将幻觉降低至零；SFT+RAG混合方案以0.481的精确匹配得分最高，且没有幻觉引用。其优势在于微调使条款选择对高召回候选集更具鲁棒性，从而避免了零样本RAG的劣势。值得注意的是，这种廉价的bge-small混合方案匹配或超过了基于更大、专门检索模型（更大的嵌入模型和交叉编码重排序器）的流水线，且更大/改进的训练集也没有帮助：在此任务中，强大的法定引用性能并不需要专门的检索模型或更多数据。该成果消除了幻觉并超过了基准线，但尚未达到0.70的理想精确匹配目标。所有结果均基于一个小型、待人工验证的真实评估集，且报告为初步结果。
AI.summary: 本文针对安大略省住宅租赁法（RTA）的法律条款引用任务，评估了四种不同的模型配置。研究发现，仅微调模型易出现错误记忆，仅检索模型存在幻觉风险，而结合SFT与RAG的混合架构能显著提升引用准确率并消除幻觉。实验表明，针对特定法律任务，轻量级模型结合高效检索比盲目扩大模型规模或数据集更具效能。
AI.keywords: 法律条文引用, 检索增强生成, 微调, 安大略省住宅租赁法, 大语言模型
AI.comments: 该研究通过实证对比揭示了在法律引用任务中，结合微调（SFT）与检索增强生成（RAG）的混合方案优于单一方法。其创新之处在于证明了对于特定法律领域，无需依赖超大规模模型或复杂的重排序模型，通过轻量级模型即可有效降低幻觉。局限性在于评估集较小且处于初步阶段，距离理想的准确率仍有差距。

title: Sparse add-on controller design: A Youla approach to system-level performance
summary: The performance of high-tech systems is often dictated by a few performance objectives shared among the many closed-loop controlled subsystems operating in the machine, such as synchronization, coordination, and alignment, which necessitates control methods that explicitly address them to achieve optimal performance. The aim of this paper is to introduce a framework that improves system performance through system-level controllers designed to be implemented as add-ons to the existing subsystem control structure. The developed method parametrizes all stabilizing system-level add-on controllers using the Youla framework, enabling a convex formulation of the sparse $\mathcal{H}_2$ synthesis problem. The result is a sparse add-on controller that achieves the optimal trade-off between combined performance and interconnection complexity, as demonstrated through numerical simulations.

title: Automating SKILL.md Generation for Computer-Using Agents via Interaction Trajectory Mining
summary: Explicit skill libraries make computer-using agents easier to inspect, but it remains unclear whether such libraries can be mined from interaction data in a way that improves downstream policies. We study this question through a three-stage pipeline that segments GUI trajectories, clusters segments into candidate skills, and trains a skill-aware policy from the resulting annotations. The mined clusters are readable on the source benchmark: five of eight clusters have at least 0.95 purity against InteraSkill Workflows labels. However, readability does not imply transfer. GRPO improves IW skill-step accuracy only from 18.5\% to 20.5\%, leaves BrowseComp+ essentially unchanged, and underperforms trivial frequency priors on key source-domain metrics. We therefore present the method as a diagnostic study: trajectory mining can expose inspectable skill structure, but the current boundary detector, orderless segment representation, and offline reward model are insufficient for reliable cross-domain policy improvement.

title: Judging to Improve: A De-biased VLM-as-3D-Judge Protocol for Single-Image 3D Generation
summary: A companion study established a de-biased, cross-model VLM-as-3D-judge that reliably ranks single-image-to-3D mesh quality where cheap geometry and CLIP proxies fall short. This paper asks: can that judge's preferences specialize a strong open generator, TRELLIS, on one asset class (furniture), cheaply and without human labels? Taking the judge from ranking to optimization is where the work lives. Pushing a VLM judge into the training and evaluation loop exposes failure modes ranking never triggered, so our contribution is an optimization-grade hardening of the judge: a training judge (Qwen2.5-VL-7B) held distinct from an evaluation judge (InternVL3-8B) to break circularity; position-bias correction; and fixes for three failure modes (image overload, geometry-hiding splat renders, and reference-free judging that rewards clean-but-wrong outputs), with calibration evidence (clear-gap win-rate 0.83-1.0; base-vs-base ~0.5). Using this protocol as an independent evaluator, and working only from public models and data with lightweight parameter-efficient adaptation, we find our methods match the strong base rather than exceed it. Independent base samples carry essentially no learnable preference (0.94 order-flip rate), so signal must be engineered by quality-contrastive construction. Across six adaptation methods, two input regimes, and a severity sweep, the most targeted - conditioner repair under severe degradation - reaches parity (0.50) with the base, while no method clears the >=65% win-rate target. The result is mechanistic: clean inputs saturate the judge, flow-DIT fine-tuning washes out through the sampler, and conditioning repair is the locus that moves geometry. Win-rates are directional at n=8 objects. Matching a strong public-data base with cheap adaptation is itself informative: exceeding it needs more than lightweight PEFT on public data, and the judge protocol is reusable.

title: An Infrastructure-less, Control-Independent Solution to Relative Localisation of a Team of Mobile Robots using Ranging Measurements
summary: The ability to localise teams of robots is essential for applications ranging from robotic fleets in unstructured environments to cooperative control and navigation tasks. In such contexts, fixed infrastructure is often unavailable, deployments must be fast and flexible, and system requirements must be minimal. We present a decentralised cooperative localisation algorithm that addresses all these challenges at once. The method is anchor-less, fully decentralised, and, unlike most existing approaches, does not require controlling the robots motion to ensure team observability. It relies only on local odometry, sparse inter-agent ranging measurements, and short-range communication, all of which are widely available in practice. The algorithm adopts a multi-hypothesis Bayesian framework that maintains the entire set of feasible solutions, ensuring robustness under transient unobservable conditions. Moreover, through information sharing, each agent benefits from the estimates of the entire group, even in partially connected conditions.

AI.title_translation: 一种基于测距测量、无需基础设施与控制的移动机器人团队相对定位方案
AI.tldr: 提出了一种无需外部设施或特定运动控制的去中心化机器人协同定位算法，通过多假设贝叶斯框架在有限通信条件下实现稳健的相对定位。
AI.motivation: 针对在缺乏固定基础设施、需要快速灵活部署且要求系统配置最小化的复杂环境中，机器人团队如何实现有效且稳健的协同定位问题。
AI.method: 提出了一种去中心化的协同定位算法，采用多假设贝叶斯框架，仅依赖本地里程计、稀疏的机器人间测距测量以及短距离通信。
AI.result: 该方法实现了在无需控制机器人运动的情况下确保团队的可观测性，并在部分连通的条件下通过信息共享提高了定位精度和鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 该算法通过多假设贝叶斯框架和分布式信息共享，成功在无需外部基础设施和运动控制的前提下，实现了移动机器人团队的稳健相对定位。
AI.translation: 机器人团队的定位能力对于从非结构化环境中的机器人车队到协同控制和导航任务等各种应用至关重要。在这种背景下，固定基础设施往往不可用，部署必须快速灵活，且系统要求必须降至最低。我们提出了一种去中心化的协同定位算法，可以同时应对所有这些挑战。该方法无需锚点，完全去中心化，并且与大多数现有方法不同，不需要控制机器人运动来确保团队的可观测性。它仅依赖本地里程计、稀疏的机器人间测距测量和短距离通信，所有这些在实践中都是广泛可用的。该算法采用多假设贝叶斯框架，维护整套可行解，确保了在瞬态不可观测条件下的鲁棒性。此外，通过信息共享，每个智能体都能从整个群体的估计中受益，即使在部分连通的条件下也是如此。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种无需基础设施和运动控制的去中心化机器人团队相对定位算法。该算法利用本地里程计、稀疏测距和通信，通过多假设贝叶斯框架处理数据，确保了在复杂和不可观测环境下的定位鲁棒性与协同效率。
AI.keywords: 相对定位, 去中心化算法, 机器人团队, 测距测量, 多假设贝叶斯框架
AI.comments: 该研究的创新之处在于提出了一种无需基础设施、无需控制机器人运动即可实现相对定位的方法。它通过多假设贝叶斯框架解决了不可观测性问题，并在部分连通网络中实现了信息共享，具有很高的实用价值和鲁棒性。

title: CATCH-ME if you RAG: a dataset of Contextually Annotated multi-Turn Counterspeech against Hate and Misinformation Exchanges
summary: Online hate speech and misinformation frequently overlap, yet NLP research has mainly treated them in isolation. While LLMs represent a scalable solution for assisting humans in the generation of counterspeech for both threats, zero-shot models frequently generate repetitive and vague responses, underscoring the need for high-quality examples to steer model generation. However, existing counterspeech datasets against the overlap of hate and misinformation are scarce and limited to single-turn English dialogues, while real-life interactions span across multiple turns and languages. To bridge this gap, we introduce the first large-scale, expert-curated, multilingual dataset of dialogues tackling the intersection of hate and misinformation. To ensure factual grounding, the dialogues are also anchored in verified external knowledge (i.e., fact-checking articles and NGO reports) and include document- and chunk-level span annotations, making it directly applicable for RAG systems. Covering five languages and targeting hate directed at seven marginalized groups, this novel resource enables the training and evaluation of more persuasive, factually grounded counterspeech models.

title: AutoPass: Evidence-Guided LLM Agents for Compiler Performance Tuning
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) show promise for code compilation tasks, but applying them to runtime performance tuning is difficult due to complex microarchitectural effects and noisy runtime measurements. We present AutoPass, a multi-agent framework for compiler performance tuning that uses compiler and runtime evidence to guide LLM-generated optimization decisions. Rather than treating the compiler as a black box like prior auto-tuning schemes, AutoPass opens up the compiler to the LLM, enabling it to query compiler-internal optimization states and analyze the intermediate representation to orchestrate compiler options. The search process iteratively refines optimization configurations using measured runtime feedback to diagnose regressions and guide latency-improving edits. AutoPass operates in an inference-only, training-free setting and requires no offline training or task-specific fine-tuning, making it readily applicable to new benchmarks and platforms. We implement AutoPass on the LLVM compiler and evaluate it on server-grade x86-64 and embedded ARM64 systems. AutoPass outperforms expert-tuned heuristics and classical autotuning methods, achieving geometric-mean speedups of 1.043x and 1.117x over LLVM -O3 on x86-64 and ARM64, respectively.

AI.title_translation: AutoPass：用于编译器性能调优的证据引导型LLM智能体
AI.tldr: AutoPass通过让LLM“观察”编译器内部状态和中间表示，在无需训练的情况下实现了比专家启发式和传统自动调优更优的编译器性能优化。
AI.motivation: 现有的LLM在编译器性能调优中面临微架构效应复杂和运行时测量噪声大的挑战，且以往的自动调优方案通常将编译器视为黑盒，缺乏对内部机制的理解。
AI.method: 提出AutoPass多智能体框架，通过查询编译器内部优化状态和分析中间表示（IR）获取证据，并结合运行时反馈进行迭代式配置优化，整个过程无需额外训练或微调。
AI.result: 在x86-64和ARM64系统上，AutoPass分别实现了1.043倍和1.117倍的性能提升（相比LLVM -O3），优于专家启发式方法和传统自动调优技术。
AI.conclusion: AutoPass证明了结合编译器内部证据与LLM智能体在性能调优任务中的有效性，为自动化编译器性能优化提供了一种高效、通用且无需额外训练的解决方案。
AI.translation: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在代码编译任务中显示出潜力，但由于复杂的微架构效应和嘈杂的运行时测量，将它们应用于运行时性能调优非常困难。我们提出了AutoPass，这是一个用于编译器性能调优的多智能体框架，它利用编译器和运行时证据来指导LLM生成的优化决策。与以往将编译器视为黑盒的自动调优方案不同，AutoPass向LLM开放了编译器，使其能够查询编译器内部的优化状态并分析中间表示，从而编排编译器选项。搜索过程使用测量的运行时反馈迭代地细化优化配置，以诊断回归并指导延迟改进的编辑。AutoPass在纯推理、无需训练的环境中运行，不需要离线训练或特定于任务的微调，使其易于应用于新的基准测试和平台。我们在LLVM编译器上实现了AutoPass，并在服务器级x86-64和嵌入式ARM64系统上对其进行了评估。AutoPass的表现优于专家调优的启发式方法和传统的自动调优方法，在x86-64和ARM64上分别实现了比LLVM -O3高出1.043倍和1.117倍的几何平均加速。
AI.summary: AutoPass是一个基于证据引导的LLM多智能体框架，通过透视编译器内部状态和中间表示，在无需训练的情况下迭代优化编译器配置，显著提升了服务器和嵌入式平台的运行时性能。
AI.keywords: 编译器优化, LLM智能体, 性能调优, 证据引导, LLVM
AI.comments: AutoPass的创新之处在于将“黑盒”编译器转变为“白盒”，利用编译器内部状态和中间表示（IR）作为证据来引导LLM，从而避免了传统黑盒优化方法中存在的噪声问题和对大量训练数据的依赖。这种无需训练的推理策略在实际应用中具有很高的灵活性和迁移性。

title: ARGUS: Production-Scale Tracing and Performance Diagnosis for over 10,000-GPU Clusters
summary:
Large-scale LLM training requires always-on, fine-grained observability for effective performance diagnosis at scale. Coarse resource monitors alone cannot localize root causes, and fine-grained profilers incur prohibitive (5%-30%) overheads and massive trace volumes, making always-on deployment impractical in large production clusters.
  We propose ARGUS, a low-overhead, fine-grained, always-on tracing and real-time analysis system for training workloads in 10,000+ GPU-scale production clusters. ARGUS decomposes observation along the training call hierarchy into CPU call stacks, framework semantics, and GPU kernel execution, with always-on collection under a combined overhead of less than 2%. It builds a unified data pipeline and compresses raw kernel events by approximately 3,700x from 10 MB to 2.7 KB per rank per step. Its progressive diagnosis framework automatically isolates anomalous windows, straggler ranks, and degraded kernels through iteration-time, phase-level, and kernel-level analysis. Deployed for over six months on a 10,000+ GPU production cluster, ARGUS has supported continuous fail-slow detection and performance optimization. Our case studies further demonstrate its effectiveness across representative anomalies, including compute stragglers, link degradation, pipeline-bubble amplification, FlashAttention JIT stalls, and compute stragglers masked by communication symptoms.

title: Organizing in the Digital Age: Understanding Community, Challenges, and Consequences in Digitally-facilitated Labor Organizing
summary: The contemporary American labor force is highly dispersed, necessitating the use of digital communication tools to bridge spatial and temporal gaps in union organizing. This study provides an in-depth analysis of how workers within various labor unions utilize digital, text-based communication platforms -- including Discord, WhatsApp, and Slack -- for labor organizing. Through 17 qualitative interviews, we examine the challenges and opportunities presented by digital organizing, identifying both technical and social obstacles. Our findings reveal that although digital tools are integral to contemporary labor successes, they also introduce new complexities, such as navigating technical security, managing information overload, and building trust and consensus. Based on these insights, we draw connections to broader understandings of digital organizing and the role of digital tools in unions.

AI.title_translation: 数字时代的组织：理解数字赋能劳工组织中的社区、挑战与后果
AI.tldr: 本文通过定性研究揭示了数字工具在现代劳工组织中的关键作用，同时指出了其在技术安全、信息过载及信任建立方面带来的新挑战。
AI.motivation: 现代美国劳动力高度分散，传统的劳工组织方式受限，迫切需要了解数字通信工具如何帮助克服时空障碍，以及在数字转型过程中面临的挑战。
AI.method: 采用定性研究方法，对来自不同工会的成员进行了17次访谈，以分析他们使用Discord、WhatsApp和Slack等数字平台进行劳工组织的情况。
AI.result: 研究发现数字工具对当代劳工运动的成功至关重要，但同时也引入了技术安全、信息过载以及在数字空间中建立信任和达成共识的复杂性。
AI.conclusion: 数字工具已成为现代劳工组织不可或缺的一部分，但工会必须克服技术安全、信息过载和信任构建等社会技术挑战，才能有效利用这些工具实现组织目标。
AI.translation: 当代美国劳动力高度分散，迫使工会组织必须使用数字通信工具来弥合时空差距。本研究深入分析了不同工会中的工人如何利用数字文本通信平台（包括Discord、WhatsApp和Slack）进行劳工组织。通过17次定性访谈，我们探讨了数字组织带来的挑战与机遇，识别了技术与社会层面的障碍。研究结果表明，尽管数字工具对于当代劳工运动的成功不可或缺，但它们也引入了新的复杂性，例如应对技术安全、管理信息过载以及建立信任和共识。基于这些见解，我们将研究结果与数字组织的更广泛理解以及数字工具在工会中的作用联系起来。
AI.summary: 本文通过对17名工会成员的定性访谈，探讨了数字通信平台（如Discord、WhatsApp和Slack）在现代分散型劳工组织中的应用。研究分析了数字工具带来的机遇与挑战，并指出这些工具在促进组织协作的同时，也带来了技术安全、信息管理和人际信任方面的复杂问题。
AI.keywords: 数字劳工组织, 工会, 数字通信工具, 组织挑战, 定性研究
AI.comments: 该研究通过实证分析探讨了数字工具在现代劳工组织中的双刃剑效应，强调了技术在赋能工会活动的同时，也带来了信任构建和信息管理的挑战，为数字劳工组织研究提供了重要的实践视角。

title: CRAX: Fast Safe Reinforcement Learning Benchmarking
summary: Safety is a core concern for deploying reinforcement learning (RL) agents in real-world domains such as robotics and autonomous driving. While benchmarks have been central to progress in RL, existing safety benchmarks with high-fidelity 3D physics remain computationally slow, limiting large-scale experimentation and rapid prototyping. To address this gap, we propose CRAX (Constrained RL Accelerated with JAX). Built on top of the MuJoCo XLA (MJX) physics engine with realistic 3D dynamics, CRAX leverages vectorized operations and hardware acceleration, yielding up to ~100x speedups over comparable CPU-based safety benchmarks. The benchmark features six environment suites and three agent-specific tasks, each spanning three difficulty levels. Evaluating six popular safe RL methods shows that no single approach dominates across all tasks, and reveals the trade-offs between performance and safety. We find that curriculum learning across difficulty levels and safety transfer can improve performance over direct training in harder settings.

AI.title_translation: CRAX：快速安全强化学习基准测试
AI.tldr: CRAX 是一个利用 JAX 和 MJX 加速的高效安全强化学习基准平台，比传统 CPU 基准快约 100 倍，助力快速原型设计与大规模评估。
AI.motivation: 现有的高保真 3D 物理安全强化学习基准测试计算速度缓慢，限制了大规模实验和快速原型设计。
AI.method: 基于 MuJoCo XLA (MJX) 物理引擎构建，利用 JAX 进行向量化运算和硬件加速，并设计了包含六个环境套件和三个任务的基准测试体系。
AI.result: 相比基于 CPU 的同类基准测试，CRAX 实现了约 100 倍的加速，评估显示没有单一算法在所有任务中占优，并验证了课程学习和安全迁移策略的有效性。
AI.conclusion: CRAX 为安全强化学习提供了一个高效、可扩展的基准平台，证明了利用硬件加速和向量化技术可以显著提升高保真环境的训练效率，并揭示了不同安全 RL 算法在性能与安全性之间的权衡。
AI.translation: 安全性是将强化学习（RL）智能体部署在机器人和自动驾驶等现实领域的核心关注点。虽然基准测试在 RL 的发展中处于核心地位，但现有的具有高保真 3D 物理特性的安全基准测试计算速度仍然缓慢，限制了大规模实验和快速原型设计。为了解决这一差距，我们提出了 CRAX（基于 JAX 加速的约束强化学习）。CRAX 构建在具有逼真 3D 动力学的 MuJoCo XLA (MJX) 物理引擎之上，利用向量化操作和硬件加速，与同类的基于 CPU 的安全基准测试相比，速度提升了约 100 倍。该基准测试包含六个环境套件和三个特定于智能体的任务，每个任务跨越三个难度级别。对六种流行的安全 RL 方法的评估表明，没有单一方法在所有任务中占主导地位，并揭示了性能与安全性之间的权衡。我们发现，跨难度级别的课程学习和安全迁移可以在较难的设置中提高直接训练的性能。
AI.summary: CRAX 是一个基于 JAX 和 MJX 构建的快速安全强化学习基准测试平台，旨在克服现有高保真 3D 物理模拟计算缓慢的局限，通过硬件加速实现显著的性能提升，并支持多难度环境下的算法评估。
AI.keywords: 安全强化学习, 基准测试, JAX, 物理模拟, 硬件加速
AI.comments: CRAX 通过利用 JAX 和 MJX 将高保真物理模拟与硬件加速相结合，有效解决了安全强化学习评估中计算效率低下的瓶颈，为该领域的研究提供了重要的性能基准工具。其局限性在于主要聚焦于模拟环境，与真实物理世界的鸿沟仍需进一步研究。

title: Rethinking Shrinkage Bias in LLM FP4 Pretraining: Geometric Origin, Systemic Impact, and UFP4 Recipe
summary: FP4 training promises substantial reductions in memory and computation cost for LLM pretraining, yet current FP4 hardware paths and recipes, including NVIDIA Blackwell/Rubin-class systems and AMD MI350-series GPUs, remain centered on E2M1 data elements. In this study, we identify a fundamental limitation of that choice: non-uniform formats such as E2M1 inherently suffer from Shrinkage Bias, a systematic negative rounding error caused by the geometric asymmetry of their representable bins. We show that this bias accumulates multiplicatively across layers and is amplified by the Random Hadamard Transform (RHT), providing a unified explanation for the training instability observed in existing E2M1-based FP4 recipes. In contrast, uniform grids (E1M2/INT4) bypass this grid-geometry error and better convert the improved bucket utilization from RHT into higher quantization quality. Based on this finding, we propose UFP4, a uniform 4-bit training recipe that applies RHT to all three training GEMMs while restricting stochastic rounding to dY alone. On Dense 1.5B, MoE 7.9B, and MoE 124B long-run pretraining, UFP4 consistently achieves lower BF16-relative loss degradation than strong E2M1-based baselines, supported by scaling-law analysis and ablation studies. Our results suggest that future accelerators should support E1M2/INT4-style uniform 4-bit grids as first-class training primitives alongside E2M1.

AI.title_translation: 重新思考LLM FP4预训练中的收缩偏差：几何起源、系统性影响及UFP4配方
AI.tldr: 本文揭示了非均匀FP4格式会导致累积的训练偏差，并提出了UFP4——一种基于均匀网格的训练方案，显著提升了模型预训练的稳定性和质量。
AI.motivation: 当前FP4预训练硬件及方案大多基于非均匀的E2M1格式，但在实际应用中存在训练不稳定的问题，缺乏对该现象根源的深入理解。
AI.method: 通过几何分析识别出非均匀格式（E2M1）的收缩偏差问题；提出UFP4训练配方，采用均匀4-bit网格（E1M2/INT4），对所有三个训练GEMM应用随机哈达玛变换（RHT），并将随机舍入限制在dY上。
AI.result: 在Dense 1.5B、MoE 7.9B和MoE 124B模型上，UFP4相比基于E2M1的基线方案，实现了更低的BF16相对损失衰减。
AI.conclusion: 非均匀量化格式（E2M1）因其几何不对称性导致收缩偏差，从而引发训练不稳定。采用均匀格式（E1M2/INT4）配合UFP4训练配方，能显著提升量化质量并保持模型性能。未来的硬件设计应将均匀4-bit网格作为核心支持。
AI.translation: FP4训练有望大幅降低大模型（LLM）预训练的内存和计算成本。然而，当前的FP4硬件路径和方案（包括NVIDIA Blackwell/Rubin系列和AMD MI350系列GPU）主要集中在E2M1数据元素上。在本研究中，我们确定了这一选择的根本局限性：非均匀格式（如E2M1）固有地受到“收缩偏差”（Shrinkage Bias）的影响，这是一种由其可表示区间的几何不对称性引起的系统性负舍入误差。我们证明了这种偏差会在层间累积，并被随机哈达玛变换（RHT）放大，从而为现有基于E2M1的FP4方案中观察到的训练不稳定提供了统一的解释。相比之下，均匀网格（E1M2/INT4）规避了这种网格几何误差，并能更好地将RHT带来的改进的桶利用率转化为更高的量化质量。基于这一发现，我们提出了UFP4，一种均匀的4-bit训练配方，它将RHT应用于所有三个训练GEMM，同时将随机舍入限制在dY上。在Dense 1.5B、MoE 7.9B和MoE 124B的长期预训练中，UFP4在缩放定律分析和消融研究的支持下，始终比强大的基于E2M1的基线实现了更低的BF16相对损失衰减。我们的研究结果表明，未来的加速器应支持E1M2/INT4风格的均匀4-bit网格，作为与E2M1并列的一流训练原语。
AI.summary: 本文研究了FP4预训练中的收缩偏差问题，发现非均匀格式（E2M1）因其几何不对称性导致系统性舍入误差。作者提出了UFP4，一种利用均匀4-bit网格（E1M2/INT4）并结合随机哈达玛变换的训练方案，在多项实验中证明了其比现有E2M1基线更优越的稳定性和量化质量。
AI.keywords: FP4预训练, 收缩偏差, UFP4, 随机哈达玛变换, 均匀量化
AI.comments: 该论文深刻揭示了FP4预训练中被忽视的“收缩偏差”问题，从几何角度解释了非均匀格式（如E2M1）不稳定的根本原因。通过提出UFP4这一均匀量化方案，论文为未来AI加速器的硬件设计提供了重要的理论依据和实践指导，具有很高的实用价值。

title: Towards Modality-imbalanced Federated Graph Learning: A Data Synthesis-based Approach
summary: MultiModal Federated Graph Learning (MM-FGL) offers a natural collaborative training paradigm, but its practical deployment is challenged by two granularities of modality imbalance. Client-level imbalance occurs when certain clients lack entire modalities, while node-level imbalance occurs when individual nodes exhibit missing visual or textual attributes. While several relevant studies exist, our investigation reveals that they predominantly target graph-agnostic or centralized scenarios, rendering them difficult to adapt directly. To address these challenges, we formalize modality-imbalanced MM-FGL as an implicit graph-aware latent semantic representation synthesis problem. This paradigm recovers missing modal semantics directly within the representation space, thereby maximizing alignment with the original data's semantic distribution and mitigating the high variance induced by missing modalities. To this end, we propose FedMGS (Federated Modality-aware Graph Synthesis), which integrates three core components. The availability-aware graph encoder prevents missing modalities from contaminating local structural propagation. The prototype-guided latent semantic synthesizer establishes cross-client semantic anchors for unavailable modalities. The reliability-calibrated semantic fusion mechanism regulates the impact of recovered latent representations prior to predictive readout. Extensive experiments on four tasks show that FedMGS consistently outperforms competitive baselines with gains up to 17.41% with best efficiency-performance tradeoff.

AI.title_translation: 迈向模态不平衡的联邦图学习：一种基于数据合成的方法
AI.tldr: 针对联邦图学习中的模态缺失问题，提出 FedMGS 框架，通过在隐空间合成缺失语义，在保障效率的同时显著提升了模型性能。
AI.motivation: 现有研究多针对图无关或中心化场景，无法直接解决多模态联邦图学习中普遍存在的客户端级和节点级模态缺失导致的语义分布偏移和高方差问题。
AI.method: 提出了 FedMGS 框架，包含三个核心组件：1. 可用性感知图编码器（避免缺失模态污染结构传播）；2. 原型引导的潜在语义合成器（建立跨客户端的语义锚点）；3. 可靠性校准的语义融合机制（调节恢复表示的预测权重）。
AI.result: 在四个任务上的实验表明，FedMGS 相比现有基线模型性能提升高达 17.41%，并实现了最佳的效率与性能平衡。
AI.conclusion: FedMGS 通过在隐空间合成缺失语义，有效解决了多模态联邦图学习中客户端级和节点级的模态不平衡问题，实现了在保持高效性的同时显著提升模型性能。
AI.translation: 多模态联邦图学习 (MM-FGL) 提供了一种自然的协作训练范式，但其在实际部署中受到两种粒度模态不平衡的挑战。客户端级不平衡是指某些客户端缺少完整模态，而节点级不平衡是指单个节点缺少视觉或文本属性。尽管已有相关研究，但我们的调查显示，它们主要针对图无关或中心化场景，难以直接适配。为了解决这些挑战，我们将模态不平衡的 MM-FGL 形式化为一种隐式图感知潜在语义表示合成问题。该范式直接在表示空间内恢复缺失的模态语义，从而最大化与原始数据语义分布的对齐，并减轻由模态缺失引起的高方差。为此，我们提出了 FedMGS (联邦模态感知图合成)，它集成了三个核心组件。可用性感知图编码器可防止缺失模态污染局部结构传播。原型引导的潜在语义合成器为不可用模态建立了跨客户端的语义锚点。可靠性校准的语义融合机制在预测读取之前调节恢复的潜在表示的影响。在四个任务上的大量实验表明，FedMGS 的表现始终优于竞争基线，性能提升高达 17.41%，并具有最佳的效率-性能权衡。
AI.summary: 该论文针对多模态联邦图学习中的模态不平衡难题，提出了一种基于数据合成的 FedMGS 框架。该方法通过在潜在语义空间内恢复缺失模态信息，并结合感知编码、原型引导合成及可靠性融合机制，显著降低了数据缺失带来的负面影响，有效提升了联邦学习的鲁棒性与准确性。
AI.keywords: 多模态联邦图学习, 模态不平衡, 数据合成, 图神经网络, 语义对齐
AI.comments: 该研究创新性地将多模态联邦图学习中的模态缺失问题转化为隐空间语义合成问题，而非简单的填充，有效解决了异构数据带来的偏差。其局限性在于对计算资源的依赖以及在极端缺失情况下的鲁棒性表现仍有待进一步验证。

title: Nonlinear Geotechnical Analysis Using a Polygonal Cell-Based Smoothed Finite Element Framework
summary: Nonlinear geotechnical analysis often involves complex geometries, staged construction, local failure, and mesh-dependent stress and plastic strain responses. This study develops a polygonal cell-based smoothed finite element method (CS-FEM) for nonlinear geotechnical analysis and implements it in ABAQUS through the user element subroutine. The proposed method combines Wachspress interpolation with cell-based strain smoothing, in which the smoothed strain--displacement matrix is evaluated by boundary integration over polygonal smoothing subcells. This formulation avoids direct calculation of shape-function derivatives inside polygonal elements and enables standard polygonal meshes and hybrid quadtree meshes with hanging nodes to be handled in a unified framework. Nonlinear geomaterial behavior is incorporated through incremental elasto-plastic constitutive updates, including the Mohr--Coulomb model and the Duncan--Chang model. Several benchmark and engineering examples, including a perforated plate, strip footing, core rockfill dam, tunnel excavation, and slope stability problems, are presented for verification. The results show that the proposed method accurately predicts displacement, stress, plastic strain, bearing capacity, and factor of safety, while providing improved mesh flexibility and computational efficiency for nonlinear geotechnical analysis.

AI.title_translation: 基于多边形单元平滑有限元框架的非线性岩土分析
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新型多边形单元平滑有限元法（CS-FEM），通过简化计算流程和增强网格适应性，有效提升了复杂岩土工程非线性分析的精度与效率。
AI.motivation: 旨在解决传统有限元方法在处理复杂几何形状、分级施工、局部失效以及网格依赖性带来的应力和塑性应变响应问题时的局限性。
AI.method: 开发了基于多边形单元的平滑有限元法（CS-FEM），结合Wachspress插值与基于单元的应变平滑技术，利用多边形平滑子单元的边界积分计算应变-位移矩阵，并通过ABAQUS用户单元子程序实现，集成了Mohr-Coulomb和Duncan-Chang弹塑性本构模型。
AI.result: 通过多个基准和工程案例验证，该方法能准确预测位移、应力、塑性应变、承载力和安全系数，同时显著提高了网格灵活性和计算效率。
AI.conclusion: 基于多边形单元的CS-FEM方法在处理岩土工程非线性问题时表现出高精度、高效率和出色的网格适应性，是一种非常有前景的数值计算工具。
AI.translation: 非线性岩土分析通常涉及复杂的几何形状、分级施工、局部失效以及与网格相关的应力和塑性应变响应。本研究开发了一种用于非线性岩土分析的基于多边形单元的平滑有限元法（CS-FEM），并通过用户单元子程序在ABAQUS中实现。所提出的方法将Wachspress插值与基于单元的应变平滑相结合，其中平滑的应变-位移矩阵通过多边形平滑子单元的边界积分进行评估。该公式避免了多边形单元内部形函数导数的直接计算，并使得标准多边形网格和带有悬挂节点的混合四叉树网格能够在统一的框架下处理。通过包括Mohr-Coulomb模型和Duncan-Chang模型在内的增量弹塑性本构更新，纳入了非线性土体行为。文中展示了包括穿孔板、条形基础、核心墙堆石坝、隧道开挖和边坡稳定性问题在内的多个基准和工程实例以进行验证。结果表明，该方法能够准确预测位移、应力、塑性应变、承载力和安全系数，同时为非线性岩土分析提供了更高的网格灵活性和计算效率。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种基于多边形单元的平滑有限元法（CS-FEM），用于非线性岩土工程分析。该方法通过Wachspress插值和边界积分技术，简化了多边形网格的计算，并支持四叉树网格。通过在ABAQUS中集成弹塑性本构模型，验证了其在处理复杂岩土工程问题时具有高精度、高效率及良好的网格适应性。
AI.keywords: 多边形单元, 平滑有限元法, 非线性岩土分析, Wachspress插值, 网格灵活性
AI.comments: 该研究通过引入多边形单元和基于单元的应变平滑技术（CS-FEM），有效解决了岩土工程中复杂几何形状和网格依赖性问题。其创新点在于将Wachspress插值与边界积分相结合，避免了复杂的形函数导数计算，并增强了网格划分的灵活性。该方法在ABAQUS中的实现极大地促进了其在工程实践中的应用潜力。

title: DataMagic: Transforming Tabular Data into Data Insight Video
summary: Data videos integrate dynamic charts, voice narration, and synchronized animations to communicate data insights as temporal narratives, making them an effective medium for improving data consumption efficiency in the data management lifecycle. However, producing high-quality data videos requires expertise spanning data analysis, narrative design, and video production. Existing approaches fall short: static visualization tools (e.g., BI dashboards) lack narrative logic and animation; authoring tools require users to pre-prepare visualizations rather than working from raw data; pixel-level video generation models cannot guarantee data fidelity or provenance. We demonstrate DataMagic, an end-to-end interactive system that transforms raw tabular data and natural language queries into narrative data-insight videos. To ensure data fidelity, DataMagic introduces the declarative specification DVSpec, which binds visual and animation elements to underlying data fields through data-driven semantic references. To address the combinatorial explosion of the design space, DataMagic adopts a Generate-then-Orchestrate multi-agent architecture that generates candidate scenes in parallel and then optimizes narrative coherence through global orchestration. Leveraging DVSpec's decoupling of logic and rendering, the system further supports three interaction modes and structured provenance-based data Q&A, transforming one-way videos into explorable interactive data interfaces. Evaluation on 109 real-world samples validates the effectiveness of the DataMagic. Homepage: https://datamagic-home.github.io/

title: CoLI: A Reproducible Platform for Continuum Robot Learning via Monolithic 3D Printing and Isomorphic Teleoperation
comments: 8 pages, 7 figures, 1 table, accepted by IROS2026
summary: Continuum robots offer strong potential for manipulation tasks due to their high degrees of freedom, compliant structures, and operational safety. However, their adoption in both research and practical applications has been hindered by reproducibility issues arising from complex fabrication and assembly processes, challenging kinematic modeling, and a lack of intuitive control interfaces. To address these challenges, we present a novel open-source continuum robot design. The platform features a simplified fabrication pipeline enabled by multi-material 3D printing, allowing the arm to be fabricated as a monolithic compliant structure with minimal assembly. Control is achieved through an isomorphic teleoperation interface that establishes a direct actuator-level mapping, eliminating the need for explicit kinematic modeling and providing a singularity-free mapping. Building on this hardware design, the platform further supports imitation-learning-based autonomous control. The proposed system is evaluated through hardware characterization and a set of manipulation tasks. Experimental results demonstrate that the platform provides a reproducible, learning-ready continuum robot system, accelerating algorithmic development and systematic benchmarking for the continuum robotics community.

AI.title_translation: CoLI：通过整体式3D打印和同构遥操作实现连续体机器人学习的可复现平台
AI.tldr: CoLI是一个开源连续体机器人平台，通过整体式3D打印简化制造，并利用同构遥操作避开复杂建模，为机器人学习研究提供了可复现的开发环境。
AI.motivation: 连续体机器人因制造复杂、组装繁琐、运动学建模困难及缺乏直观控制界面，导致研究的可复现性差，限制了其广泛应用。
AI.method: 采用多材料整体式3D打印技术简化制造流程；利用同构遥操作接口实现直接的执行器级映射，无需显式运动学建模；基于此硬件平台支持模仿学习算法。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，该平台不仅实现了硬件的快速制备，还通过遥操作和模仿学习成功完成了各类操作任务，验证了其作为可复现、学习就绪系统的有效性。
AI.conclusion: CoLI平台成功降低了连续体机器人的制作难度与控制复杂度，为连续体机器人领域的学习算法开发和基准测试提供了一个高效、可复现的开源解决方案。
AI.translation: 连续体机器人凭借其高自由度、柔顺结构和操作安全性，在操作任务中展现出巨大潜力。然而，其在研究和实际应用中的普及受到复现性问题的阻碍，这些问题源于复杂的制造和组装工艺、具有挑战性的运动学建模以及缺乏直观的控制接口。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了一种新颖的开源连续体机器人设计。该平台具有多材料3D打印实现的简化制造流程，允许机械臂作为整体式柔顺结构进行制造，几乎无需组装。控制通过同构遥操作接口实现，该接口建立了直接的执行器级映射，消除了显式运动学建模的需要，并提供了无奇异点的映射。在此硬件设计的基础上，该平台进一步支持基于模仿学习的自主控制。我们通过硬件表征和一系列操作任务对所提出的系统进行了评估。实验结果表明，该平台提供了一个可复现、学习就绪的连续体机器人系统，加速了连续体机器人社区的算法开发和系统化基准测试。
AI.summary: CoLI是一个开源的连续体机器人平台，通过多材料整体式3D打印简化了硬件制造，并利用同构遥操作消除运动学建模需求。该系统支持模仿学习，旨在解决连续体机器人研究中制造和控制的复现性难题，加速算法开发与基准测试。

title: Geometry-Aware Superpixel Graph Transformer with Metadata for Skin Lesion Classification
summary: Automated skin cancer classification from dermoscopic images remains challenging due to heterogeneous lesion structure, strong intra-class variability, and subtle visual differences between benign and malignant cases. Existing CNN/ViT pipelines typically rely on global or patch-level features and often combine patient metadata via late fusion, which limits spatially grounded multimodal reasoning. We present a novel region-based graph learning framework that explicitly models lesions as graphs of spatially coherent superpixel regions represented as frozen CNN features. To capture fine-grained lesion arrangements, we encode inter-regional geometry as edge attributes and introduce a dedicated metadata context node connected to all regions, providing structured integration of demographic/clinical variables within the same relational space. Node representations are updated using our edge-aware graph transformer followed by attention-driven propagation, and a final graph-level embedding for benign-malignant classification. Experiments on four public benchmarks demonstrate that explicit region-level relational modeling and graph-native multimodal fusion yield consistent gains over the state-of-the-art. Consequently, we establish a new graph-centric perspective in which CNN features are modeled as relational nodes and improved through contextual integration, yielding more expressive and robust classifications.

AI.title_translation: 用于皮肤病变分类的几何感知超像素图Transformer及其元数据集成方法
AI.tldr: 提出了一种将皮肤病变建模为超像素图的新方法，通过编码区域几何关系并深度融合临床元数据，显著提升了病变分类的准确性。
AI.motivation: 现有的CNN/ViT模型在处理皮肤病变时，往往依赖全局或补丁级特征，且临床元数据融合方式单一，缺乏空间基础的多模态推理能力。
AI.method: 提出一种基于超像素的图学习框架，将皮肤病变建模为图，利用边缘属性编码区域间的几何关系，并引入上下文节点整合临床/人口统计学元数据，最后通过边缘感知图Transformer和注意力机制进行分类。
AI.result: 在四个公开基准数据集上的实验结果表明，该方法在皮肤病变分类任务中均取得了优于当前最先进水平（SOTA）的性能。
AI.conclusion: 该方法通过显式的区域级关系建模和图原生多模态融合，有效提升了皮肤病变分类的准确性和鲁棒性，优于现有的主流方法。
AI.translation: 由于皮肤病变结构的异质性、类内差异大以及良恶性之间细微的视觉差异，自动化的皮肤癌分类仍然具有挑战性。现有的CNN/ViT流程通常依赖全局或补丁级特征，且往往通过后期融合方式结合患者元数据，这限制了基于空间基础的多模态推理。我们提出了一种新颖的基于区域的图学习框架，明确地将病变建模为由冻结的CNN特征表示的空间相干超像素区域图。为了捕捉细粒度的病变排列，我们将区域间几何结构编码为边缘属性，并引入一个连接所有区域的专用元数据上下文节点，在相同的关系空间内实现人口统计学/临床变量的结构化集成。节点表示通过我们的边缘感知图Transformer进行更新，随后进行注意力驱动的传播，最终得到用于良恶性分类的图级嵌入。在四个公共基准测试上的实验表明，显式的区域级关系建模和图原生多模态融合比现有最先进技术取得了持续的提升。因此，我们建立了一种新的以图为中心的视角，其中CNN特征被建模为关系节点，并通过上下文集成得到改进，从而产生更具表达力和鲁棒性的分类。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种几何感知的超像素图Transformer模型，通过将病变区域建模为图结构，整合空间几何信息和临床元数据，实现了皮肤病变的高效分类。
AI.keywords: 皮肤病变分类, 图Transformer, 超像素, 多模态融合, 几何感知
AI.comments: 该研究的创新之处在于提出了一种基于超像素的图学习框架，将临床元数据作为上下文节点融入图结构，实现了空间几何特征与多模态信息的深度融合，为皮肤病变分类提供了一种更具可解释性和鲁棒性的新范式。

title: Agentic AutoResearch forSpace Autonomy: An Auditable, LLM-Driven Research Agent for Aerospace Control Problems
summary: Spacecraft guidance, navigation, and control functions are increasingly realized as learned policies distilled from expert solvers. Developing such a policy is itself a research process: an investigator selects an architecture and hyperparameters, runs experiments, and must determine whether an apparent improvement is genuine or merely seed noise. This paper presents AutoResearch, a framework in which a large language model autonomously drives that loop for aerospace control problems, coupled with a credibility layer, built into the loop, that certifies each reported result against the problem's own measured seed noise. The language model serves only as the offline research agent that develops the control policy; the trained policy it produces is then deployed onboard the spacecraft, while the model itself never operates the vehicle. At each iteration the agent reads a plain-language problem description and the run history, proposes a single edit to the training script, executes it, and logs the outcome. No reported result is credited until it passes the same three checks: measured per-problem seed noise, reseeded verification of the best configuration, and leave-one-out pruning of the agent's edits. The same loop is applied, unchanged, to two aerospace control problems: a Clohessy-Wiltshire relative rendezvous and a safety-constrained collision-avoidance docking past a keep-out zone, each calibrated against a known optimal control benchmark. In both, the audited policy clears the measured seed noise by many standard deviations; an undirected search over the same parameters does not. On the docking problem the gap becomes categorical: undirected search yields no feasible policy, while the learned policy stays outside the keep-out zone on every seed.

AI.title_translation: 面向空间自主的代理式自动研究：一种用于航空航天控制问题的可审计、LLM驱动的研究代理
AI.tldr: AutoResearch利用LLM自动迭代优化航天控制策略，并通过严格的“可信度层”审计排除随机噪声，生成了在复杂对接任务中表现卓越且高度可靠的控制策略。
AI.motivation: 航天控制策略的研发过程繁琐且易受随机种子噪声干扰，现有的手动研发过程效率低下，需要一种能够自主、可审计且能有效区分真实改进与噪声的自动化方法。
AI.method: 提出AutoResearch框架，利用LLM作为离线研究代理，通过读取问题描述和历史记录，自动迭代修改训练脚本；引入包含测量种子噪声、重置种子验证和留一法剪枝的“可信度层”进行严格审计。
AI.result: 在Clohessy-Wiltshire相对交会和带避障约束的对接两个任务中，AutoResearch生成的策略均显著超过了无向搜索，特别是在对接问题上，AutoResearch成功实现了无碰撞的稳定控制，而无向搜索则无法找到可行策略。
AI.conclusion: AutoResearch框架通过自动化的研发循环和严格的审计验证机制，能够成功生成优于传统无向搜索策略的航天控制策略，证明了LLM在航天自主研发中的潜力和可靠性。
AI.translation: 航天器的制导、导航和控制功能越来越多地被实现为从专家求解器中提炼出的学习策略。开发此类策略本身就是一个研究过程：研究人员选择架构和超参数，运行实验，并必须确定明显的改进是真实的还是仅仅由随机种子噪声引起的。本文介绍了AutoResearch，这是一个框架，其中大语言模型自主驱动航空航天控制问题的研发循环，并耦合了一个内置的、针对问题测量种子噪声验证每个报告结果的可信度层。语言模型仅作为开发控制策略的离线研究代理；它生成的训练策略随后被部署在航天器上，而模型本身从不操作飞行器。在每次迭代中，代理读取纯语言的问题描述和运行历史，提出对训练脚本的单一修改，执行它，并记录结果。在通过测量的种子噪声、最佳配置的重置种子验证和代理编辑的留一法剪枝这三个检查之前，没有结果会被采纳。相同的循环被应用于两个航空航天控制问题：Clohessy-Wiltshire相对交会和通过禁区进行的安全约束防撞对接，每个问题都根据已知的最优控制基准进行了校准。在这两个任务中，审计后的策略在许多标准差上都超过了测量的种子噪声；而对相同参数的无向搜索则做不到这一点。在对接问题上，这种差距是决定性的：无向搜索没有产生可行的策略，而学习到的策略在每个种子上都保持在禁区之外。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为AutoResearch的框架，利用大语言模型自动执行航天控制策略的研发循环。该系统通过集成一个可信度审计层，对模型生成的每一个改进建议进行严格验证，确保了最终部署的控制策略能够克服随机噪声干扰，在复杂的航空航天控制任务中表现出优异的性能。
AI.keywords: 航天自主, 大语言模型, 控制策略, 自动化研发, 可信度审计
AI.comments: 该研究创新性地将大语言模型（LLM）引入航天控制策略的自动化研发流程，并引入了“可信度层”来处理随机性带来的噪声干扰。其重要性在于通过严格的审计机制确保了AI生成的控制策略在航空航天这一高风险领域的可靠性。局限性在于目前仅在两个受控问题上进行了验证，在更复杂、非线性的真实航天任务中的扩展性仍需进一步探索。

title: Linked Fates: How Small of an Ambiguity Increase Can Make the Difference Between Equaling and Separating from P?
summary:
Ambiguity-bounded versions of $\mathrm{NP}$, denoted $\mathrm{UP}_{\leq f(n)}$, bound by $f(n)$ the number of accepting paths the nondeterministic polynomial-time Turing machine can have on inputs of length $n$. Such classes range from Valiant's completely unambiguous ($f(n)=1$) class $\mathrm{UP}$ to $\mathrm{NP}$ itself, where there is no bound or, equivalently, there is the toothless exponential bound ($f(n) = 2^{n^{O(1)}}$).
  This paper seeks to understand which of these classes stand and fall together as to whether they equal deterministic polynomial time. Informally put, what ranges of ambiguities have linked fates? That is, for which pairs of nondecreasing functions, $(f_1 ,f_2)$, satisfying $(\forall n)[f_1(n) \leq f_2(n)]$, does it hold that $\mathrm{P} = \mathrm{UP}_{\leq f_1(n)} \implies \mathrm{P} = \mathrm{UP}_{\leq f_2(n)}$. More particularly, for which pairs does that hold robustly, i.e., it holds in the real world and every relativized world? And for which pairs does that implication fail to hold robustly, i.e., there is an oracle $A$ such that $\mathrm{P}^A = \mathrm{UP}_{\leq f_1(n)}^A \subsetneq \mathrm{UP}_{\leq f_2(n)}^A$?
  The only previously known positive result is Watanabe's 1988 result that $ \mathrm{P} = \mathrm{UP}_{\leq 1} \implies (\forall k \geq 1)[\mathrm{P} = \mathrm{UP}_{\leq k}]$, which even holds robustly. His result, though lovely, applies only to constant-bounded ambiguities. As our positive result, we present a new class of cases (Theorem 3.8) that apply (and even robustly apply) at greater ambiguity levels. To give our class of cases, we leverage two approaches: a novel path-poisoning approach that works even on superconstant ambiguities (Theorem 3.5) and a new application of the power of padding (Theorems 3.3/3.4). As negative results, we show that for essentially all other cases, no linkage holds robustly.

title: The Significance of Style Diversity in Annotation-Free Synthetic Data Generation
summary: Generating high-utility synthetic data for intent classification typically requires human-annotated seed data, which is often unavailable in fast-paced industrial settings. In this paper, we propose a framework for synthetic dialogue generation that works entirely without human-annotated data, relying solely on intent definitions. Our proposed dialogue generation framework utilizes two different types of topic and style attributes to improve data diversity. Also, we propose two novel post-hoc stylization models called Univ and Exam to transform synthetic LLM-generated utterances into more varied, human-like linguistic styles. To enhance data quality, we utilize an LLM-as-a-judge filtering process. Experimental results on both industrial and public datasets demonstrate that the proposed approach achieves up to 93.3% of the performance obtained using human-annotated training data. Crucially, the findings reveal that style diversity is more critical than topic diversity for synthetic data utility, as it prevents models from learning spurious stylistic correlations. Furthermore, the study shows that incorporating style attributes during the generation process is more effective than post-hoc style adaptation.

AI.title_translation: 无标注合成数据生成中风格多样性的重要性
AI.tldr: 本文提出一种无需人工标注的合成数据生成框架，证明了在合成数据中风格多样性比主题多样性更能提升模型性能。
AI.motivation: 在工业场景中，高质量意图分类所需的标注数据往往难以获取，现有的合成数据生成方法常依赖人工标注的种子数据。
AI.method: 提出了一种无需人工标注的对话生成框架，利用主题和风格属性增加多样性；引入Univ和Exam两种事后风格化模型；并使用“LLM-as-a-judge”进行数据质量过滤。
AI.result: 实验表明，该方法可达到人类标注数据93.3%的性能；发现风格多样性对于提升数据效用至关重要；验证了生成过程中注入风格属性比事后调整更有效。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，在合成数据生成中，风格多样性比主题多样性更重要，且生成过程中的属性注入优于事后风格转换，该方法在无需人工标注的情况下能达到人类标注数据93.3%的性能。
AI.translation: 为意图分类生成高实用性的合成数据通常需要人工标注的种子数据，这在快节奏的工业环境中往往难以实现。在本文中，我们提出了一个完全不需要人工标注数据、仅依赖意图定义的合成对话生成框架。我们提出的框架利用两种不同类型的主题和风格属性来提高数据多样性。此外，我们还提出了两种名为Univ和Exam的新型事后风格化模型，将合成的LLM生成话语转换为更多样化、更像人类的语言风格。为了提高数据质量，我们采用了“LLM-as-a-judge”过滤过程。在工业和公共数据集上的实验结果表明，该方法达到了使用人工标注训练数据所获性能的93.3%。至关重要的是，研究结果表明，风格多样性对于合成数据的效用比主题多样性更关键，因为它防止了模型学习到虚假的风格相关性。此外，研究表明，在生成过程中加入风格属性比事后风格适应更有效。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种无需人工标注的合成对话生成框架，通过在生成过程中结合主题和风格属性，并配合事后风格化模型与LLM过滤机制，有效提升了意图分类的数据质量。研究发现，风格多样性在合成数据中比主题多样性更具决定性。
AI.keywords: 合成数据生成, 意图分类, 风格多样性, 大语言模型, 无标注学习
AI.comments: 该研究揭示了风格多样性在合成数据中的关键作用，挑战了传统上对主题多样性的过分关注。其提出的无需人工标注的框架具有很高的工业应用价值，但在复杂语境下的泛化能力仍需进一步验证。

title: PowerAgentBench-Dyn: A Benchmark for Agentic AI in Power System Dynamic Studies
summary: Large Language Model (LLM)-based agents are increasingly being used to automate multi-step engineering work flows by interacting with software tools, interpreting intermediate results, and autonomously planning subsequent actions. Power system dynamic studies represent a particularly promising yet largely unexplored application domain for these agents. Unlike static computational tasks, dynamic studies often require more time on model parameter calibration, engineering judgment, and decision making under constrained action spaces. This paper introduces PowerAgentBench-Dyn, a benchmark designed to evaluate Agentic AI systems on power system dynamic-analysis tasks. The benchmark targets problems that cannot be reduced to a single optimization or coding task, but instead require a type of reasoning, tool usage, and iterative experimentation routinely performed by experienced power system engineers. The proposed framework includes two initial benchmark tasks. The first, the Dynamic Model Quality Review Benchmark, evaluates agents' ability to validate and diagnose dynamic models based on model-quality compliance criteria specified by system operators. The second, the Dynamic Security Risk Screening Benchmark, assesses agents' capability to leverage semantic memory and a limited simulation budget to identify, rank, and analyze the most critical short-circuit contingencies from an unseen fault dataset, as well as propose and evaluate possible mitigation measures. For each task, we define the simulation environment, observation and action spaces, and evaluation metrics. The benchmark is reproducible in a metric-based sense: released cases and simulator settings define a deterministic evaluator, while stochastic agent behavior is assessed over repeated runs using success rates and other metrics. The benchmark supports the development of future Agentic AI for power system operation and planning.

title: FlowBender: Feedback-Aware Training for Self-Correcting Conditional Flows
summary: Conditional diffusion and flow models routinely fail to satisfy the very constraints that define their task. For instance, a depth-conditioned model often produces images whose re-extracted depth disagrees with the input, even though the forward operator--the depth predictor defining the constraint--is available during both training and inference. Existing approaches generally fall into two categories: supervised models that treat the conditioning signal as a static cue and ignore alignment information at inference, and guidance-based methods that consult it through hand-tuned linear updates, typically trading fidelity to the condition against the plausibility of the generated sample. We argue that the fundamental gap in both paradigms is that the model is never trained to utilize its own alignment error. We introduce FlowBender, a closed-loop framework that treats this error as a first-class input, training the network to learn a correction policy conditioned on inference-time feedback. At each step, an unguided look-ahead pass estimates the clean signal, a task-specific deviation is computed via the forward operator, and a refinement pass consumes this signal to produce a corrected velocity. We propose several variants of FlowBender, including a gradient-based formulation for differentiable operators and a zero-order variant for non-differentiable settings such as JPEG compression. For efficient sampling, we introduce a prior-step shortcut that enables closed-loop correction at a minimal additional computational cost. Across image-to-image translation, restoration, and 3D mesh texturing, FlowBender consistently outperforms standard supervised baselines, alignment-loss-augmented training, and state-of-the-art inference-time guidance, improving fidelity and plausibility simultaneously rather than trading them against each other. Project page: https://flow-bender.github.io/

AI.title_translation: FlowBender：用于自我修正条件流的反馈感知训练
AI.tldr: FlowBender 引入了一种闭环训练机制，让条件生成模型能够利用推理时的对齐误差进行自我纠正，从而在满足约束条件的同时提升生成图像的质量。
AI.motivation: 现有的条件扩散和流模型往往无法满足预定义的约束条件，且传统的监督学习忽略了推理时的对齐信息，而引导式方法通常需要在条件保真度与生成合理性之间进行权衡。
AI.method: 提出 FlowBender 框架，将推理时的对齐误差作为输入，训练模型学习修正策略。包含基于梯度的变体（适用于可导算子）和零阶变体（适用于不可导算子），并通过前一步快捷方式（prior-step shortcut）降低计算开销。
AI.result: 在图像到图像转换、图像修复和 3D 网格纹理化任务中，FlowBender 均优于现有的监督基线、对齐损失增强模型及 SOTA 推理引导方法，实现了保真度与合理性的双重提升。
AI.conclusion: FlowBender 通过闭环反馈训练机制，有效提升了条件生成模型在各种任务中的约束满足度与生成质量，且具有较好的通用性和计算效率。
AI.translation: 条件扩散模型和流模型通常无法满足定义其任务的约束条件。例如，深度条件模型生成的图像，其重提取的深度往往与输入不符，尽管在训练和推理过程中都可以使用定义约束的前向算子（深度预测器）。现有方法通常分为两类：将条件信号视为静态提示并在推理时忽略对齐信息的监督模型；以及通过手动调整线性更新来咨询该信号的引导式方法，这通常以牺牲生成样本的合理性为代价来换取对条件的保真度。我们认为两种范式的根本差距在于模型从未被训练去利用自身的对齐误差。我们引入了 FlowBender，一个闭环框架，它将此误差视为一类输入，训练网络学习一种以推理时间反馈为条件的修正策略。在每一步中，无引导的前瞻（look-ahead）传递估计干净信号，通过前向算子计算特定任务的偏差，并通过修正传递消耗该信号以产生修正后的速度。我们提出了 FlowBender 的几种变体，包括用于可微算子的基于梯度的公式和用于不可微设置（如 JPEG 压缩）的零阶变体。为了高效采样，我们引入了一个前一步快捷方式，使闭环修正能够以最小的额外计算成本实现。在图像到图像转换、恢复和 3D 网格纹理化任务中，FlowBender 一致地优于标准的监督基线、对齐损失增强训练和最先进的推理时间引导，在提高保真度和合理性的同时，避免了两者之间的权衡。
AI.summary: FlowBender 是一种用于条件流模型的闭环训练框架，它通过将推理过程中的对齐误差反馈给模型，使其学会根据实时反馈进行自我修正，从而在不牺牲生成质量的前提下显著提高了对任务约束的满足程度。
AI.keywords: 条件生成模型, 闭环反馈, 自我修正, 流模型, 约束优化
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于将“对齐误差”显式地纳入训练过程，使模型学习如何根据实时反馈进行自我修正，而非仅仅依赖静态条件或事后的启发式引导。这解决了传统条件生成模型在满足约束条件与保持生成质量之间的权衡困境。

title: LLM agent safety, multi-turn red-teaming, jailbreak benchmarks, adversarial robustness, safety-critical systems
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly proposed as supervisory components for safety-critical systems, yet their robustness under sustained, adaptive adversarial pressure remains poorly characterized. We present NRT-Bench, a benchmark for multi-turn red-teaming of LLM agents acting as operators of a safety-critical system, instantiated in a simulated nuclear power plant control room. A five-role operator team, each backed by a configurable LLM, runs a plant governed by six critical safety functions (CSFs), while adversaries inject messages over four channels in bounded multi-turn sessions with per-turn feedback. Harm is an objective signal rather than LLM-judged text: a run terminates the moment any CSF is lost, attributed to the causing message. Evaluating four frontier operator models under a fixed-attack paired-replay protocol, we find that adaptive multi-turn attacks reliably push the operator team past a safety limit: across the four models, between 8.7% and 12.1% of attack sessions end with the plant losing a critical safety function. Although the four models look almost equally robust by this aggregate rate, their failures barely overlap: of $149$ sessions, none defeat all four models while a third defeat at least one, so vulnerabilities are nearly disjoint across models rather than nested. The effect of added defences is strongly model-dependent: the same guardrail stack or safety-advisor agent that lowers attack success for one model can raise it for another. We release the simulation venue, attack dataset, and replay tooling for reproducible safety evaluation of LLM agents.

AI.title_translation: LLM代理安全性、多轮红队测试、越狱基准、对抗稳健性、安全关键系统
AI.tldr: 本文提出了NRT-Bench，通过模拟核电站环境评估LLM代理的安全性，发现模型在多轮对抗攻击下极易失效，且不同模型的漏洞高度互不重叠，防御机制难以通用。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型代理越来越多地被用于安全关键系统，但其在持续、适应性对抗压力下的稳健性尚未得到充分表征。
AI.method: 开发了NRT-Bench基准测试，在核电站控制室模拟环境中，通过五角色操作员团队协作运行系统，并引入外部对抗性消息进行多轮攻击，以系统关键安全功能（CSF）是否丧失作为伤害评估指标。
AI.result: 实验发现，在多轮攻击下，四个前沿模型均有8.7%至12.1%的概率导致系统关键安全功能丧失；各模型的脆弱性几乎不重叠，且增加防御措施的效果具有高度的模型依赖性。
AI.conclusion: LLM代理在面对持续的、适应性的对抗压力时存在显著的安全风险，且不同模型的脆弱性表现出极高的异构性，现有的防御措施缺乏通用性。
AI.translation: 大型语言模型（LLM）代理越来越多地被提议作为安全关键系统的监管组件，然而它们在持续、适应性对抗压力下的稳健性仍未得到充分表征。我们提出了NRT-Bench，这是一个用于对充当安全关键系统操作员的LLM代理进行多轮红队测试的基准，并在模拟核电站控制室中进行了实例化。一个由五名操作员组成的团队（每个操作员由可配置的LLM支持）运行一个由六个关键安全功能（CSF）管理的工厂，而对手在有限的多轮会话中通过四个通道注入消息，并伴有每轮反馈。伤害是一个客观信号，而非LLM判断的文本：一旦任何CSF丧失，运行立即终止，并归因于导致该结果的消息。在固定的攻击配对回放协议下评估四个前沿操作员模型，我们发现适应性多轮攻击可靠地将操作员团队推向安全极限：在四个模型中，8.7%到12.1%的攻击会话以工厂失去关键安全功能而告终。尽管这四个模型在总体攻击成功率上看起来几乎同样稳健，但它们的失败几乎没有重叠：在149次会话中，没有一个会话能击败所有四个模型，而有三分之一至少击败了一个模型，因此脆弱性在模型间几乎是不重叠的，而不是嵌套的。增加防御措施的效果在很大程度上取决于模型：同样的护栏堆栈或安全顾问代理可以降低一个模型的攻击成功率，却会提高另一个模型的成功率。我们发布了仿真场地、攻击数据集和回放工具，以进行LLM代理的可重复安全性评估。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了NRT-Bench，这是一个用于评估LLM代理在安全关键系统（如核电站）中表现的基准测试。研究通过多轮对抗攻击发现，尽管模型在整体成功率上表现相似，但它们各自的脆弱性各不相同，且现有防御措施的效果因模型而异，凸显了提升LLM代理对抗稳健性的复杂性。
AI.keywords: LLM代理, 多轮红队测试, 安全关键系统, 对抗稳健性, 基准测试
AI.comments: 该研究揭示了LLM代理在安全关键系统中的脆弱性，并强调了模型安全性在不同架构下的差异性。其创新之处在于将“伤害”定义为客观的系统故障指标而非主观的文本评估，并证明了不同模型之间的脆弱性几乎是不重叠的，这对开发通用的安全防御机制提出了巨大挑战。

title: MaRDI Open Interfaces for Interoperable Nonlinear Optimization
summary: MaRDI Open Interfaces is a software package that aims to improve interoperability in scientific computing, particularly, for nonlinear optimization. To this end, this package holds two main characteristics. First, it provides unified interfaces for typical numerical problems to help switching between solvers for the same problem type. Second, it automates data marshalling between programming languages. Hence, computational scientists can conduct experiments faster by using the package, with fewer code-modification and testing efforts. In this work we describe the general structure of the software package and show examples with the interface for nonlinear optimization.

AI.title_translation: 用于可互操作非线性优化的 MaRDI 开放接口
AI.tldr: MaRDI Open Interfaces 通过统一求解器接口和自动化跨语言数据处理，简化了科学计算中的实验流程。
AI.motivation: 旨在解决科学计算领域中不同求解器接口不统一以及在不同编程语言间进行数据转换繁琐的问题，从而提高科研人员的实验效率。
AI.method: 开发了一个包含统一数值问题接口和跨语言自动数据编组功能的软件工具包，以简化求解器切换与实验流程。
AI.result: 成功构建了通用软件框架，并通过非线性优化的接口示例验证了其在减少代码修改量和测试工作量方面的有效性。
AI.conclusion: MaRDI Open Interfaces 通过提供统一接口和自动数据编组，有效降低了科学计算中切换求解器和跨语言开发的复杂度。
AI.translation: MaRDI Open Interfaces 是一个旨在提高科学计算（特别是非线性优化）互操作性的软件包。为此，该软件包具备两个主要特征。首先，它为典型的数值问题提供了统一的接口，有助于在处理同一问题类型时切换求解器。其次，它实现了编程语言之间的数据编组自动化。因此，计算科学家通过使用该软件包，可以以更少的代码修改和测试工作量更快地进行实验。在这项工作中，我们描述了该软件包的通用结构，并展示了非线性优化接口的示例。
AI.summary: MaRDI Open Interfaces 是一个旨在提升科学计算互操作性的软件包，通过提供统一的数值问题接口和跨语言数据编组自动化，显著降低了非线性优化等领域中切换求解器的难度和开发成本。
AI.keywords: 非线性优化, 互操作性, 科学计算, 接口标准化, 自动数据编组
AI.comments: 该论文介绍的 MaRDI Open Interfaces 解决了科学计算中不同求解器接口不统一及多语言数据交换困难的痛点，对于提升科研效率和软件生态的互操作性具有重要意义。局限性在于目前主要展示了非线性优化领域的应用，其通用性在其他领域的推广效果有待进一步验证。

title: Direct Advantage Estimation for Scalable and Sample-efficient Deep Reinforcement Learning
summary: Direct Advantage Estimation (DAE) has been shown to improve the sample efficiency of deep reinforcement learning algorithms. However, its reliance on full environment observability limits its applicability in realistic settings, and its requirement to model transition probabilities incurs substantial computational overhead for high-dimensional observations. In the present work, we address both limitations. First, we extend the theoretical framework of DAE to partially observable domains with minimal modifications. Second, we reduce its computational complexity by introducing discrete latent dynamics models that efficiently approximate transition probabilities. We evaluate our approach on the Arcade Learning Environment and find that DAE scales effectively with function approximator capacity while retaining high sample efficiency.

AI.title_translation: 面向可扩展且样本高效的深度强化学习的直接优势估计
AI.tldr: 本文通过扩展DAE以适应部分可观测环境并引入离散潜在动力学模型，有效解决了其在复杂任务中的计算瓶颈与适用性问题。
AI.motivation: 传统的直接优势估计（DAE）依赖于完全可观测环境，且在高维观测下建模转移概率计算开销巨大，限制了其在实际场景中的应用。
AI.method: 将DAE理论框架扩展至部分可观测领域，并使用离散潜在动力学模型来近似转移概率，从而降低计算复杂度。
AI.result: 在Arcade学习环境中的实验表明，改进后的DAE能够有效扩展函数逼近器的容量，同时保持了高样本效率。
AI.conclusion: 通过理论扩展和离散潜在动力学模型，DAE在部分可观测环境和高维观测下表现出良好的可扩展性和样本效率。
AI.translation: 直接优势估计（DAE）已被证明可以提高深度强化学习算法的样本效率。然而，它对完全环境可观测性的依赖限制了其在现实场景中的适用性，且其对转移概率建模的要求在高维观测下会产生巨大的计算开销。在本研究中，我们解决了这两个限制。首先，我们将DAE的理论框架扩展到部分可观测领域，且只需进行极小的修改。其次，我们通过引入能有效近似转移概率的离散潜在动力学模型，降低了其计算复杂度。我们在Arcade学习环境中评估了我们的方法，发现DAE能够随着函数逼近器容量的增加而有效扩展，同时保持了高样本效率。
AI.summary: 本文旨在解决直接优势估计（DAE）在深度强化学习中的局限性。通过将DAE扩展至部分可观测环境，并利用离散潜在动力学模型降低计算开销，提升了算法在处理高维观测时的效率与可扩展性。
AI.keywords: 直接优势估计, 深度强化学习, 部分可观测环境, 潜在动力学模型, 样本效率
AI.comments: 该论文通过扩展DAE理论框架至部分可观测环境，并引入离散潜在动力学模型降低计算复杂度，成功解决了DAE在实际应用中的两大瓶颈。其创新点在于平衡了理论扩展与计算效率，证明了DAE在复杂高维环境下的可扩展性与样本效率。

title: ExSpike: A General Full-Event Neuromorphic Architecture for Exploiting Irregular Sparsity with Event Compression
comments: Accepted by the 36th International Conference on Field-Programmable Logic and Applications (FPL 2026); 9 pages, 9 figures
summary: Spiking neural networks (SNNs) promise energy-efficient computing due to their sparse spatio-temporal activity. However, effectively translating such irregular sparsity into practical performance and energy gains remains challenging, as full-event computing architectures are still underexplored. This paper proposes ExSpike, a general full-event neuromorphic architecture that fully exploits irregular sparsity in SNNs. To realize pure event-driven execution, we first propose a set of dataflow optimizations to ensure that the inputs to each SNN layer remain spike-based, thereby enabling full-event execution throughout the network. We then design a hardware-efficient full-event architecture, named ExSpike, which supports the optimized pure event-driven dataflow and an additional Attention Core for spike-driven self-attention. To further improve computing efficiency, we introduce adjacent-position event compression to reduce redundant accumulations across spatially adjacent spike sequences. ExSpike is implemented on an AMD Xilinx Virtex-7 FPGA and evaluated on both classification and segmentation workloads. Experimental results show that ExSpike achieves high normalized energy efficiency across diverse SNN models while maintaining competitive accuracy, delivering up to 479.15 GOPS, 281.85 GOPS/W, and 0.80 GOPS/W/PE. In particular, ExSpike achieves up to 10$\times$ higher PE-normalized energy efficiency than the SOTA FPGA-based SNN accelerator (FireFly-T). The code for ExSpike is available at \url{https://github.com/xiaoyuehai/ExSpike}.
comment: Accepted by the 36th International Conference on Field-Programmable Logic and Applications (FPL 2026); 9 pages, 9 figures

AI.title_translation: ExSpike：一种利用事件压缩挖掘不规则稀疏性的通用全事件神经形态架构
AI.tldr: ExSpike是一种新型全事件SNN硬件架构，通过纯脉冲数据流和事件压缩技术，在保持高准确度的同时，实现了比现有SOTA方案高出10倍的能效比。
AI.motivation: 现有的脉冲神经网络（SNN）虽然具有稀疏的时空活性，但如何将这种不规则的稀疏性高效转化为实际的性能和能效增益仍面临挑战，且目前针对“全事件”计算架构的研究尚显不足。
AI.method: 1. 提出一套数据流优化方法，确保各层输入保持为脉冲形式；2. 设计支持纯事件驱动数据流和脉冲驱动自注意力机制的硬件架构；3. 引入相邻位置事件压缩技术，减少空间相邻脉冲序列的冗余累加。
AI.result: 在FPGA上实现并验证，在分类和分割任务中表现优异，最高达到479.15 GOPS和281.85 GOPS/W，能效比现有最先进的SNN加速器（FireFly-T）高出10倍。
AI.conclusion: ExSpike通过全事件驱动的数据流和高效的硬件设计，成功将SNN的稀疏性转化为显著的能效提升，证明了全事件架构在实现高效神经形态计算方面的潜力。
AI.translation: 脉冲神经网络（SNN）因其稀疏的时空活性而具有节能计算的前景。然而，如何有效地将这种不规则的稀疏性转化为实际的性能和能效增益仍然是一个挑战，因为全事件计算架构尚未得到充分探索。本文提出了ExSpike，这是一种通用的全事件神经形态架构，旨在充分利用SNN中的不规则稀疏性。为了实现纯事件驱动执行，我们首先提出了一套数据流优化方法，确保每个SNN层的输入保持为脉冲形式，从而在整个网络中实现全事件执行。随后，我们设计了一种硬件高效的全事件架构ExSpike，它支持优化的纯事件驱动数据流以及用于脉冲驱动自注意力的Attention Core。为了进一步提高计算效率，我们引入了相邻位置事件压缩，以减少空间相邻脉冲序列之间的冗余累加。ExSpike在AMD Xilinx Virtex-7 FPGA上实现，并在分类和分割工作负载上进行了评估。实验结果表明，ExSpike在多种SNN模型中实现了极高的归一化能效，同时保持了具有竞争力的准确度，最高可达479.15 GOPS、281.85 GOPS/W和0.80 GOPS/W/PE。特别是，ExSpike的PE归一化能效比最先进的FPGA SNN加速器（FireFly-T）高出10倍。ExSpike的代码已在GitHub开源。
AI.summary: 本文提出了ExSpike架构，这是一种通用的全事件神经形态计算系统。通过优化数据流以保持纯脉冲处理、设计专用的硬件架构（含自注意力核心）以及引入相邻位置事件压缩技术，ExSpike有效地挖掘了SNN的不规则稀疏性，显著提升了计算能效。
AI.keywords: 脉冲神经网络, 全事件架构, 稀疏性, 事件压缩, 神经形态计算
AI.comments: ExSpike的创新点在于提出了“全事件”计算架构，彻底消除了非脉冲数据的处理开销，并通过相邻位置事件压缩技术进一步优化了计算效率。该架构对于推动SNN在资源受限设备上的落地具有重要意义，但其在处理极度不规则稀疏性时的通用扩展性仍有待进一步观察。

title: Pseudo-Feature Padding: A Lightweight Defense Against False Data Injection in Power Grids
summary: Deep Neural Networks DNNs have achieved remarkable accuracy in various tasks including their application in CyberPhysical Systems CPS for detecting False Data Injection Attacks FDIA during critical operations However the unique infrastructure of CPS makes DNNs vulnerable to exploitation by attackers aiming to evade detection Additionally the distinct nature of CPS presents challenges for conventional defense mechanisms against FDIA This paper proposes an innovative defense framework that strengthens DNNs against such attacks by introducing an additional input layer that performs padding in the input samples using pseudofeature values derived from the inputs statistical distribution This padding increases the input dimensionality in a randomized and dataaware manner making adversarial attacks computationally infeasible due to the nontransferable nature of crafted perturbations and the unpredictability of the padded structure Our method is lightweight modelagnostic and requires no modifications to the core architecture making it highly deployable in realworld CPS settings We evaluated our framework on critical power grid applications such as state estimation using the IEEE 14bus 30bus 118bus and 300bus systems Experiments under adversarial settings demonstrate that our padding strategy significantly improves model robustness with negligible impact on performance and effectively mitigates attacks that would otherwise bypass conventional defenses

AI.title_translation: 伪特征填充：一种针对电力网虚假数据注入的轻量级防御机制
AI.tldr: 通过在输入数据中加入随机伪特征进行填充，该方法以极低的计算代价显著提升了电力网DNN模型抵御虚假数据注入攻击的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 电力网信息物理系统（CPS）中的深度神经网络（DNN）易受虚假数据注入攻击（FDIA）的影响，且传统防御机制难以有效应对CPS的特殊架构，亟需一种轻量级且易于部署的防御方案。
AI.method: 提出了一种创新防御框架，在输入层增加一层伪特征填充，利用输入数据的统计分布生成随机且数据感知的填充值，从而增加输入维度并增强模型防御力。
AI.result: 在IEEE 14、30、118及300总线系统上的实验表明，该方法在几乎不影响原始性能的情况下，显著提升了模型抵御对抗性攻击的能力，并能有效拦截传统防御方案无法规避的攻击。
AI.conclusion: 伪特征填充技术为电力网CPS提供了一种高效、通用且易于部署的防御手段，能显著增强DNN模型在面对虚假数据注入攻击时的鲁棒性。
AI.translation: 深度神经网络（DNN）在包括检测电力网信息物理系统（CPS）虚假数据注入攻击（FDIA）在内的各种任务中表现出色。然而，CPS独特的架构使得DNN容易被攻击者利用以规避检测。此外，CPS的特殊性也给传统的FDIA防御机制带来了挑战。本文提出了一种创新的防御框架，通过引入一个额外的输入层，利用从输入统计分布中导出的伪特征值对输入样本进行填充，从而增强DNN的防御能力。这种填充以随机且感知数据的方式增加了输入维度，使得对抗性攻击因扰动的不可迁移性和填充结构的不可预测性而在计算上变得不可行。我们的方法是轻量级的、模型无关的，且不需要修改核心架构，使其在现实世界的CPS环境中具有高度的可部署性。我们在IEEE 14、30、118和300总线系统等关键电力网应用（如状态估计）上评估了我们的框架。在对抗性环境下的实验表明，我们的填充策略显著提高了模型的鲁棒性，同时对性能的影响可忽略不计，并有效地缓解了那些本可以绕过传统防御的攻击。
AI.summary: 针对电力网CPS中DNN模型易受虚假数据注入攻击的问题，本文提出了一种轻量级的伪特征填充防御框架。该方法通过在输入中引入基于数据统计特性的随机填充，增加了输入维度，利用对抗性扰动的不可迁移性和填充结构的不可预测性，实现了高效的攻击防御，且具有模型无关和易于部署的特点。
AI.keywords: 虚假数据注入攻击, 深度神经网络, 电力网, 伪特征填充, 对抗性鲁棒性
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种极具创新且轻量级的防御策略，通过引入随机化的伪特征填充来增加输入维度，有效打破了对抗性扰动的可迁移性。其最大的优势在于模型无关性（model-agnostic）和低计算开销，非常适合资源受限且对实时性要求极高的电力网物理信息系统（CPS）。

title: On the Redundancy of Timestep Embeddings in Diffusion Models
summary: Diffusion models rely heavily on explicit timestep embeddings to modulate the denoising process across various noise scales. In this work, we challenge the necessity of these temporal signals by analyzing their impact on U-Net and Diffusion Transformer architectures. Beyond empirical evidence, we provide a theoretical framework demonstrating that, under certain conditions, the global minimizer of the diffusion training objective can be achieved without explicit timestep conditioning. Our findings reveal a surprising robustness when timestep embeddings are completely removed. Extensive ablation studies on the CelebA and CIFAR-10 datasets show that these time-agnostic models can maintain high structural fidelity and even surpass their conditioned counterparts in competitive metrics, including FID, precision, and recall. Our analysis suggests these architectures can implicitly infer noise scales from the corrupted input under specific assumptions, rendering explicit temporal conditioning redundant. This study challenges long-standing temporal conditioning paradigms and paves the way for more efficient and structurally focused generative architectures.

title: Neural network surrogates with uncertainty quantification for inverse problems in partial differential equations
summary: Inverse problems for differential equations arise throughout science and engineering, where one seeks to infer unknown model parameters from noisy or incomplete observations. Traditional numerical methods for these problems are often computationally expensive, particularly in Bayesian settings where evaluating the likelihood becomes costly for complex forward models and high-dimensional parameter spaces. To address this challenge, we introduce DeepGaLA, a neural-network surrogate for differential equation solvers that provides uncertainty-aware predictions, reducing overconfident inference when training data are limited. To evaluate the fidelity of the surrogate-induced posterior approximations in practice, we show that a short run of delayed-acceptance Markov chain Monte Carlo can serve as an effective diagnostic. Across a range of numerical experiments, DeepGaLA delivers forward-model approximations with accuracy comparable to established Gaussian-process surrogates, while better maintaining efficiency as parameter dimension grows. Moreover, it can incorporate differential-equation constraints, including in nonlinear settings. Overall, these results indicate that uncertainty-quantified neural surrogates can enable scalable and reliable Bayesian inference for inverse problems in complex systems.
