title: Med-R2: Perception and Reflection-driven Complex Reasoning for Medical Report Generation
summary: Automated medical report generation (MRG) is increasingly used to reduce the burden of manual reporting and for decision support. Large vision-language models (LVLMs) hold great promise for automated MRG due to their fine-grained image-text alignment and advanced text-generation capabilities. Currently, state-of-the-art MRGs primarily focus on adapting pre-trained LVLMs with direct supervised fine-tuning (SFT), a fine-tuning strategy with medical image-report pairs. However, several factors limit the performance of these LVLMs. Firstly, direct SFT enables LVLMs to generate medical reports directly without an intermediate thinking process of pathological feature perception and diagnostic reasoning. This causes a potential failure to perceive pathological features and thus leads to misdiagnosis. Secondly, direct SFT lacks the incorporation of radiology-specific knowledge guidance, causing LVLMs to misinterpret perceived pathological features and make incorrect diagnoses. To address these gaps, we propose a novel fine-tuning strategy named Med-R2. We introduce a perception-driven long reasoning process that precedes report generation and incorporates radiology-specific knowledge as guidance. Additionally, to alleviate potential perceptual errors in complex reasoning, a reflection mechanism is introduced to refine the perception of pathological features and the generated report. Our experiments demonstrate that Med-R2 effectively enhances the capability of pathological features perception and diagnosis accuracy for MRG via fine-tuned LVLMs.

AI.title_translation: Med-R2：面向医学报告生成的感知与反射驱动复杂推理框架
AI.tldr: Med-R2 通过在医学报告生成中加入推理和反射机制，解决了大模型直接微调导致的误诊和感知偏差问题。
AI.motivation: 现有基于直接监督微调（SFT）的医疗报告生成模型缺乏中间的病理特征感知与诊断推理过程，且缺乏专业放射学知识指导，导致模型容易产生漏诊或误诊。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为 Med-R2 的微调策略，包含感知驱动的长推理过程（整合放射学知识）以及用于修正感知和报告生成的反射机制。
AI.result: 实验表明，Med-R2 有效增强了微调后大视觉语言模型对病理特征的感知能力，并提高了医学报告生成的诊断准确性。
AI.conclusion: Med-R2 框架通过引入感知驱动的推理过程和反射机制，有效提升了大型视觉语言模型在医学报告生成中的病理特征感知能力和诊断准确性。
AI.translation: 自动医学报告生成（MRG）正日益被用于减轻手工报告的负担并提供决策支持。大型视觉语言模型（LVLMs）凭借其细粒度的图文对齐和先进的文本生成能力，在自动 MRG 领域展现出巨大潜力。目前，最先进的 MRG 主要集中于利用医学图像-报告对，通过直接监督微调（SFT）来适配预训练的 LVLMs。然而，多个因素限制了这些 LVLMs 的性能。首先，直接 SFT 使 LVLMs 在没有经过病理特征感知和诊断推理的中间思维过程的情况下直接生成报告。这导致模型可能无法感知病理特征，从而引发误诊。其次，直接 SFT 缺乏放射学特定知识的引导，导致 LVLMs 误解已感知的病理特征并做出错误诊断。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了一种名为 Med-R2 的新型微调策略。我们引入了一个在报告生成之前的感知驱动的长推理过程，并整合了放射学特定知识作为引导。此外，为了减轻复杂推理中潜在的感知错误，我们引入了一种反射机制来优化病理特征的感知和生成的报告。实验表明，Med-R2 有效增强了微调后的 LVLMs 在 MRG 任务中的病理特征感知能力和诊断准确性。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为 Med-R2 的新型医学报告生成微调策略。该方法通过在报告生成前引入感知驱动的推理过程（结合放射学知识），并配合反射机制来修正感知与生成结果，解决了现有模型直接微调导致的推理缺失和知识匮乏问题，显著提升了诊断质量。
AI.keywords: 医疗报告生成, 大视觉语言模型, 病理特征感知, 诊断推理, 反射机制
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地引入了“感知-推理-反射”的闭环机制，解决了现有医疗报告生成模型在直接微调中缺乏中间推理过程和专业知识指导的问题，显著提升了诊断的准确性和可靠性。

title: HBS -- Hardware Build System: Characterizing and comparing direct-Tcl and indirect-abstract approaches for hardware build systems
summary: Build systems become an indispensable part of the software implementation and deployment process. New programming languages are released with the build system integrated into the language tools, for example, Go, Rust, or Zig. However, in the hardware description domain, no official build systems have been released with the predominant Hardware Description Languages (HDL) such as VHDL or SystemVerilog. Moreover, hardware design projects are often multilingual. The paper characterizes and compares two common approaches for hardware build system implementations. The first one, the direct-Tcl approach, in which the build system code is executed directly by the EDA tool during the design build flow. The second one, the indirect-abstract approach, in which the build system produces a Tcl script, which is later run by a proper EDA tool. As none of the existing direct-Tcl build systems was close to the indirect-abstract build systems in terms of supported functionalities, the paper also presents a new direct-Tcl hardware build system called HBS. The implemented build system was used as a representative of direct-Tcl build systems in comparison with indirect-abstract build systems.

title: TerraMind: Large-Scale Generative Multimodality for Earth Observation
summary: We present TerraMind, the first any-to-any generative, multimodal foundation model for Earth observation (EO). Unlike other multimodal models, TerraMind is pretrained on dual-scale representations combining both token-level and pixel-level data across modalities. On a token level, TerraMind encodes high-level contextual information to learn cross-modal relationships, while on a pixel level, TerraMind leverages fine-grained representations to capture critical spatial nuances. We pretrained TerraMind on nine geospatial modalities of a global, large-scale dataset. In this paper, we demonstrate that (i) TerraMind's dual-scale early fusion approach unlocks a range of zero-shot and few-shot applications for Earth observation, (ii) TerraMind introduces "Thinking-in-Modalities" (TiM) -- the capability of generating additional artificial data during finetuning and inference to improve the model output -- and (iii) TerraMind achieves beyond state-of-the-art performance in community-standard benchmarks for EO like PANGAEA. The pretraining dataset, the model weights, and our code are open-sourced under a permissive license.

AI.title_translation: TerraMind：面向地球观测的大规模生成式多模态模型
AI.tldr: TerraMind 是首个结合双尺度融合与“模态思维”技术的地球观测多模态基础模型，在多项基准测试中表现卓越并已开源。
AI.motivation: 现有的多模态模型在地球观测领域缺乏对高层上下文与细粒度空间信息的有效整合，亟需一个能够处理多模态数据并具备生成能力的通用基础模型。
AI.method: 提出了一种双尺度预训练方法，结合了 token 级上下文编码与像素级细粒度表示，并引入了“模态思维”（Thinking-in-Modalities, TiM）机制，在微调和推理阶段生成人工数据以增强输出。
AI.result: TerraMind 在 PANGAEA 等地球观测标准基准测试中取得了超越当前最先进水平（SOTA）的性能，并解锁了多种零样本和少样本应用场景。
AI.conclusion: TerraMind 通过双尺度预训练和 TiM 机制，在地球观测任务中表现优异，不仅超越了现有基准，还为零样本和少样本应用提供了强大的通用基础架构。
AI.translation: 我们提出了 TerraMind，这是首个用于地球观测（EO）的任意到任意生成式多模态基础模型。与其他多模态模型不同，TerraMind 在跨模态的 token 级和像素级双尺度表示上进行了预训练。在 token 层面，TerraMind 对高层上下文信息进行编码以学习跨模态关系；在像素层面，TerraMind 利用细粒度表示来捕捉关键的空间细微差别。我们在一个全球大规模数据集的九种地理空间模态上预训练了 TerraMind。在本文中，我们证明了：(i) TerraMind 的双尺度早期融合方法为地球观测开启了一系列零样本和少样本应用；(ii) TerraMind 引入了“模态思维”（TiM）——即在微调和推理过程中生成额外人工数据以提高模型输出的能力；(iii) TerraMind 在 PANGAEA 等地球观测社区标准基准测试中达到了超越当前最先进水平的性能。预训练数据集、模型权重和代码均已在许可协议下开源。
AI.summary: TerraMind 是首个面向地球观测的任意到任意生成式多模态基础模型。它通过结合 token 级上下文关系与像素级空间细节的双尺度早期融合技术进行预训练，并引入了“模态思维”机制，从而在多项基准测试中实现了性能突破。
AI.keywords: 地球观测, 多模态基础模型, 生成式AI, 双尺度融合, 遥感
AI.comments: TerraMind 创新性地引入了双尺度（token级和像素级）早期融合机制，并提出了“模态思维”（TiM）概念，显著提升了地球观测模型在多模态理解与生成方面的表现。其开源策略对遥感领域的研究具有重要推动作用。

title: VibeCheck: Using Active Acoustic Tactile Sensing for Contact-Rich Manipulation
summary: The acoustic response of an object can reveal a lot about its global state, for example its material properties or the extrinsic contacts it is making with the world. In this work, we build an active acoustic sensing gripper equipped with two piezoelectric fingers: one for generating signals, the other for receiving them. By sending an acoustic vibration from one finger to the other through an object, we gain insight into an object's acoustic properties and contact state. We use this system to classify objects, estimate grasping position, estimate poses of internal structures, and classify the types of extrinsic contacts an object is making with the environment. Using our contact type classification model, we tackle a standard long-horizon manipulation problem: peg insertion. We use a simple simulated transition model based on the performance of our sensor to train an imitation learning policy that is robust to imperfect predictions from the classifier. We finally demonstrate the policy on a UR5 robot with active acoustic sensing as the only feedback. Videos can be found at https://roamlab.github.io/vibecheck .

title: Quantum preconditioning method for finite difference discretizations of the Poisson equation via Schrödingerization
summary: We present a quantum preconditioning framework for solving linear systems arising from a finite difference discretization of the Poisson equation. It is based on the combination of the Schrödingerization technique \cite{JLY22b,JLYPRL24} and the BPX multilevel preconditioner in order to achieve near-optimal complexity. The Schrödingerization technique transforms linear partial and ordinary differential equations into Schrödinger-type systems with unitary evolution in one higher dimension, making them suitable for quantum simulation. A key contribution is a structure-aware construction of the block-encoding for the symmetrically preconditioned matrix $A_S = S^\top A S$, where $A$ is the stiffness matrix and $S$ encodes the BPX preconditioner in factored form. By establishing a novel commuting identity, we avoid the unfavorable normalization scaling that would otherwise arise from naive multiplication of block-encodings. This yields an exact block-encoding of $A_S$ with normalization $\mathcal{O}(d^2(L+1))$, where $d$ is the spatial dimension and $L$ is the number of levels. Combined with the Schrödingerization-based Hamiltonian simulation, the overall quantum algorithm achieves a query complexity of $\mathcal{O}\big(\mathrm{poly}(d)\varepsilon^{-1} \mathrm{polylog}(\varepsilon^{-1}) \big)$ for estimating linear functionals of the solution to a given tolerance $\varepsilon$.

AI.title_translation: 基于薛定谔化的泊松方程有限差分离散化的量子预条件方法
AI.tldr: 通过结合薛定谔化技术与BPX多层预条件子，本文提出了一种求解泊松方程的高效量子算法，实现了近最优的查询复杂度。
AI.motivation: 为了解决有限差分离散化泊松方程所产生的线性系统，旨在通过量子算法实现近最优的计算复杂度。
AI.method: 利用薛定谔化技术将线性偏微分方程转化为薛定谔型系统，并结合BPX多层预条件子。关键创新点是通过建立新的交换恒等式，构造了预条件矩阵 $A_S$ 的结构感知块编码，从而避免了不必要的归一化缩放。
AI.result: 提出了一种新的量子算法，对于给定的容差 $\varepsilon$，估计解的线性泛函的查询复杂度为 $\mathcal{O}\big(\mathrm{poly}(d)\varepsilon^{-1} \mathrm{polylog}(\varepsilon^{-1}) \big)$。
AI.conclusion: 该研究成功通过薛定谔化和BPX预条件子构造了一种高效的量子算法，实现了对泊松方程有限差分离散化线性系统的高效求解，达到了近最优的查询复杂度。
AI.translation: 我们提出了一种用于求解泊松方程有限差分离散化所产生的线性系统的量子预条件框架。该框架基于薛定谔化技术与BPX多层预条件子的结合，以实现近最优的复杂度。薛定谔化技术将线性偏微分方程和常微分方程转换为高一维度的具有幺正演化的薛定谔型系统，使其适用于量子模拟。一个关键贡献是对称预条件矩阵 $A_S = S^\top A S$ 的结构感知块编码构造，其中 $A$ 是刚度矩阵，$S$ 以因子形式编码了 BPX 预条件子。通过建立一个新的交换恒等式，我们避免了块编码朴素相乘所产生的不利归一化缩放。这产生了一个归一化为 $\mathcal{O}(d^2(L+1))$ 的 $A_S$ 精确块编码，其中 $d$ 是空间维度，$L$ 是层数。结合基于薛定谔化的哈密顿量模拟，该总体量子算法在估计解的线性泛函时，对于给定容差 $\varepsilon$，实现了 $\mathcal{O}\big(\mathrm{poly}(d)\varepsilon^{-1} \mathrm{polylog}(\varepsilon^{-1}) \big)$ 的查询复杂度。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种基于薛定谔化和BPX多层预条件子的量子预条件框架，用于求解泊松方程的有限差分离散化问题。通过引入结构感知的块编码构造方法，成功避免了归一化缩放问题，实现了高效的量子模拟，并达到了近最优的查询复杂度。
AI.keywords: 量子预条件, 薛定谔化, 泊松方程, BPX多层预条件子, 量子算法
AI.comments: 该论文通过将薛定谔化技术与BPX多层预条件子相结合，解决了量子算法求解线性系统时的复杂性问题。其核心创新在于提出了一个结构感知的块编码（block-encoding）构造方法，通过建立新的交换恒等式，有效避免了朴素乘法带来的不利归一化缩放，从而实现了近最优的查询复杂度。这是一个在量子科学计算领域非常前沿且具有重要理论意义的工作。

title: FreshRetailNet-50K: A Stockout-Annotated Censored Demand Dataset for Latent Demand Recovery and Forecasting in Fresh Retail
summary: Accurate demand estimation is critical for the retail business in guiding the inventory and pricing policies of perishable products. However, it faces fundamental challenges from censored sales data during stockouts, where unobserved demand creates systemic policy biases. Existing datasets lack the temporal resolution and annotations needed to address this censoring effect. To fill this gap, we present FreshRetailNet-50K, the first large-scale benchmark for censored demand estimation. It comprises 50,000 store-product time series of detailed hourly sales data from 898 stores in 18 major cities, encompassing 863 perishable SKUs meticulously annotated for stockout events. The hourly stock status records unique to this dataset, combined with rich contextual covariates, including promotional discounts, precipitation, and temporal features, enable innovative research beyond existing solutions. We demonstrate one such use case of two-stage demand modeling: first, we reconstruct the latent demand during stockouts using precise hourly annotations. We then leverage the recovered demand to train robust demand forecasting models in the second stage. Experimental results show that this approach achieves a 2.73% improvement in prediction accuracy while reducing the systematic demand underestimation from 7.37% to near-zero bias. With unprecedented temporal granularity and comprehensive real-world information, FreshRetailNet-50K opens new research directions in demand imputation, perishable inventory optimization, and causal retail analytics. The unique annotation quality and scale of the dataset address long-standing limitations in retail AI, providing immediate solutions and a platform for future methodological innovation. The data (https://huggingface.co/datasets/Dingdong-Inc/FreshRetailNet-50K) and code (https://github.com/Dingdong-Inc/frn-50k-baseline}) are openly released.

AI.title_translation: FreshRetailNet-50K：一个用于生鲜零售潜在需求恢复与预测的缺货标注截断需求数据集
AI.tldr: 本文发布了首个大规模标注缺货状态的生鲜零售数据集FreshRetailNet-50K，通过重构缺货期间的潜在需求，显著提升了需求预测的准确性并消除了系统性偏差。
AI.motivation: 生鲜零售中因缺货导致的销售数据截断会产生系统性偏差，现有的数据集缺乏足够的时序分辨率和缺货标注来解决这一挑战。
AI.method: 提出两阶段需求建模方法：第一阶段利用小时级缺货标注重构缺货期间的潜在需求；第二阶段利用恢复后的需求训练鲁棒的需求预测模型。
AI.result: 实验表明，该方法将预测准确率提升了2.73%，并将系统性的需求低估偏差从7.37%降低至近乎零。
AI.conclusion: FreshRetailNet-50K数据集通过精确标注缺货事件，有效解决了需求预测中的截断偏差问题，为生鲜零售领域的需求恢复与预测研究提供了重要的基准与工具。
AI.translation: 准确的需求估计对于生鲜零售业务在指导库存和定价政策方面至关重要。然而，它面临着缺货期间截断销售数据的基本挑战，其中未观察到的需求产生了系统性的政策偏差。现有的数据集缺乏解决这种截断效应所需的时间分辨率和标注。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了FreshRetailNet-50K，这是第一个用于截断需求估计的大规模基准。它包含来自18个主要城市898家门店的50,000条详细小时销售数据的时间序列，涵盖了863种精心标注了缺货事件的易腐SKU。该数据集独有的小时库存状态记录，结合丰富的上下文协变量（包括促销折扣、降水和时间特征），实现了超越现有解决方案的创新研究。我们展示了这种两阶段需求建模的应用案例：首先，利用精确的小时标注重构缺货期间的潜在需求。然后，我们在第二阶段利用恢复的需求来训练稳健的需求预测模型。实验结果表明，该方法实现了2.73%的预测准确率提升，同时将系统性需求低估从7.37%降低至接近零偏差。凭借前所未有的时间粒度和全面的现实世界信息，FreshRetailNet-50K在需求填补、易腐库存优化和因果零售分析方面开辟了新的研究方向。该数据集独特的标注质量和规模解决了零售AI中长期存在的局限性，为未来的方法论创新提供了即时解决方案和平台。数据和代码已公开。
AI.summary: 本文发布了FreshRetailNet-50K，这是一个包含50,000条生鲜零售时间序列的大规模数据集，涵盖了898家门店的863种SKU，并提供了独特的小时级缺货标注和丰富的上下文协变量，旨在解决需求预测中的截断偏差问题。
AI.keywords: 生鲜零售, 需求预测, 缺货标注, 需求截断, 数据集
AI.comments: 该论文通过发布首个大规模标注缺货状态的生鲜零售数据集，解决了零售领域长期存在的因缺货导致的“需求截断”问题，具有很高的学术价值和工业应用潜力。其创新点在于提供了小时级的精细化缺货标注，为需求恢复和预测提供了高质量基准。

title: CoMo: Learning Continuous Latent Motion from Internet Videos for Scalable Robot Learning
summary: Unsupervised learning of latent motion from Internet videos is crucial for robot learning. Existing discrete methods generally mitigate the shortcut learning caused by extracting excessive static backgrounds through vector quantization with a small codebook size. However, they suffer from information loss and struggle to capture more complex and fine-grained dynamics. Moreover, there is an inherent gap between the distribution of discrete latent motion and continuous robot action, which hinders the joint learning of a unified policy. We propose CoMo, which aims to learn more precise continuous latent motion from internet-scale videos. CoMo employs an early temporal difference (Td) mechanism to increase the shortcut learning difficulty and explicitly enhance motion cues. Additionally, to ensure latent motion better captures meaningful foregrounds, we further propose a temporal contrastive learning (Tcl) scheme. Specifically, positive pairs are constructed with a small future frame temporal offset, while negative pairs are formed by directly reversing the temporal direction. The proposed Td and Tcl work synergistically and effectively ensure that the latent motion focuses better on the foreground and reinforces motion cues. Critically, CoMo exhibits strong zeroshot generalization, enabling it to generate effective pseudo action labels for unseen videos. Extensive simulated and real-world experiments show that policies co-trained with CoMo pseudo action labels achieve superior performance with both diffusion and auto-regressive architectures.

title: Reinforcement Twinning for Hybrid Control of Flapping-Wing Drones
summary: Controlling flapping-wing drones requires controllers that handle time-varying, nonlinear, underactuated dynamics from incomplete, noisy sensor data. Recent advances in artificial intelligence (AI), particularly reinforcement learning (RL), have opened new perspectives for addressing such complex control problems through data-driven policy optimization from interaction with the environment. Yet purely data-driven methods are sample-inefficient, demanding extensive, sometimes unsafe exploration, especially without guiding physical models. This motivates hybrid AI-physics frameworks. This article proposes a hybrid model-free/model-based flight-control approach using the reinforcement twinning algorithm. The model-based (MB) component uses an adjoint formulation and an adaptive digital twin continuously identified from live trajectories; the model-free (MF) component uses RL. The two agents share knowledge via transfer learning, imitation learning, and shared experience between the real environment and the digital twin, coordinated by a policy referee that selects which agent acts in reality based on digital-twin performance and a real-to-virtual consistency ratio. The framework is evaluated for the longitudinal control of a flapping-wing drone, modelled as a nonlinear time-varying system driven by quasi-steady aerodynamic forces. The hybrid strategy is tested under three adaptive-model initializations: (1) offline identification from existing data, (2) random initialization with fully online identification, and (3) offline pre-training with biased parameters followed by online adaptation. In all cases, the hybrid framework improves performance, robustness, and sample efficiency over purely model-free and purely model-based approaches.

AI.title_translation: 用于扑翼无人机混合控制的强化孪生算法
AI.tldr: 提出了一种结合数字孪生与强化学习的混合飞行控制框架，显著提高了扑翼无人机在复杂动力学环境下的控制性能与样本效率。
AI.motivation: 扑翼无人机具有非线性、欠驱动和时变动力学特性，且传感器数据存在噪声。纯数据驱动的强化学习方法样本效率低且探索过程不安全，而传统物理模型方法在复杂环境下存在局限，因此需要一种结合AI与物理模型的混合控制框架。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为“强化孪生”（Reinforcement Twinning）的混合控制框架。该方法结合了模型预测控制（基于伴随公式和自适应数字孪生）与模型无关的强化学习，通过迁移学习、模仿学习以及由“策略裁判”协调的实时环境与数字孪生间的交互来共同优化控制策略。
AI.result: 在扑翼无人机纵向控制任务中，该混合框架在所有测试条件下（离线/在线识别、预训练等）均表现出比纯模型驱动或纯数据驱动方法更高的性能、鲁棒性和样本效率。
AI.conclusion: 实验证明，该混合框架在多种初始化条件下均优于单一的模型驱动或数据驱动方法，显著提升了扑翼无人机控制的性能、鲁棒性和样本效率。
AI.translation: 控制扑翼无人机需要能够处理来自不完整、噪声传感器数据的时间变化、非线性、欠驱动动力学的控制器。人工智能（AI）的最新进展，特别是强化学习（RL），通过与环境交互的数据驱动策略优化，为解决此类复杂控制问题开辟了新视角。然而，纯数据驱动的方法样本效率低下，需要大量的、有时是不安全的探索，特别是在没有指导物理模型的情况下。这促成了混合AI-物理框架的发展。本文提出了一种使用强化孪生算法的混合无模型/有模型飞行控制方法。有模型（MB）组件使用伴随公式和从实时轨迹中持续识别的自适应数字孪生；无模型（MF）组件使用RL。这两个智能体通过迁移学习、模仿学习以及真实环境与数字孪生之间的共享经验共享知识，并由一个策略裁判进行协调，该裁判根据数字孪生性能和实虚一致性比率选择在现实中采取行动的智能体。该框架在扑翼无人机的纵向控制方面进行了评估，该无人机被建模为由准稳态空气动力驱动的非线性时变系统。混合策略在三种自适应模型初始化下进行了测试：（1）从现有数据进行离线识别，（2）完全在线识别的随机初始化，以及（3）带有偏差参数的离线预训练，随后进行在线自适应。在所有情况下，该混合框架在性能、鲁棒性和样本效率方面都优于纯无模型和纯有模型方法。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种用于扑翼无人机控制的“强化孪生”混合框架。该框架融合了基于自适应数字孪生的模型预测控制与基于强化学习的模型无关控制，通过策略裁判协调两者交互，有效解决了扑翼飞行中动力学复杂、样本效率低及安全性挑战，实现了更稳健的飞行控制。
AI.keywords: 扑翼无人机, 强化学习, 数字孪生, 混合控制, 策略优化
AI.comments: 该研究通过结合模型预测控制（MB）和强化学习（MF）的优势，有效解决了扑翼无人机控制中非线性、欠驱动及数据噪声带来的挑战。其核心创新在于“强化孪生”（Reinforcement Twinning）机制，通过数字孪生与策略裁判的协同，显著提升了样本效率与系统鲁棒性，为复杂动力学系统的实时控制提供了新范式。

title: Bioacoustic Geolocation: Species Sounds as Geographic Signals
summary: Can we determine someone's geographic location solely from the sounds they hear? Are acoustic signals enough to localize within a country, state, or even city? In this work, we tackle the challenge of global-scale audio geolocation, with a particular focus on wildlife and natural sounds. We posit that bioacoustic signals contain informative geolocation cues because of well-defined geographic ranges of species. To test this hypothesis, we benchmark image geolocation and soundscape mapping methods, design oracles and species-centric baselines, and propose a hybrid approach that combines species range prediction with retrieval-based geolocation. We further ask whether geolocation improves with species-diverse recordings and spatiotemporal aggregation across neighboring samples. Finally, we extend our study to multimodal geolocation with case studies from movies that combine both audio and visual content. Our results highlight the potential of incorporating bioacoustic signals into geospatial tasks, motivating future work on species recognition and audio geolocation.

AI.title_translation: 生物声学地理定位：作为地理信号的物种声音
AI.tldr: 本文提出利用生物声学信号（物种声音）进行地理定位，通过结合物种分布预测和音频检索，验证了声音在确定地理位置方面的有效性。
AI.motivation: 探索是否仅凭环境中的声音信号就能确定地理位置，并验证生物声学信号中蕴含的物种地理分布规律是否可以作为一种有效的地理定位线索。
AI.method: 通过基准测试图像地理定位和声景映射方法，设计物种中心基准，并提出了一种结合物种范围预测与基于检索的地理定位的混合方法。同时，通过时空聚合分析及音视频多模态案例研究进行验证。
AI.result: 研究结果表明，生物声学信号对地理定位具有显著贡献，通过物种多样性记录和时空聚合可以进一步提升定位精度，且多模态结合（音视频）能够有效增强定位能力。
AI.conclusion: 研究证实了生物声学信号包含丰富的地理位置线索，通过结合物种分布预测与音频检索，能够有效实现全球范围内的音频地理定位。
AI.translation: 我们能否仅凭听到的声音确定某人的地理位置？声学信号足以在国家、州甚至城市范围内进行定位吗？在这项工作中，我们应对了全球尺度音频地理定位的挑战，特别关注野生动物和自然声音。我们假设生物声学信号包含信息丰富的地理定位线索，因为物种具有明确的地理分布范围。为了验证这一假设，我们对图像地理定位和声景映射方法进行了基准测试，设计了预言机（oracles）和物种中心基准，并提出了一种结合物种范围预测与基于检索的地理定位的混合方法。我们进一步探讨了地理定位是否会随着物种多样性记录和跨相邻样本的时空聚合而改善。最后，我们将研究扩展到多模态地理定位，并结合电影中的音视频内容进行了案例研究。我们的结果突出了将生物声学信号纳入地理空间任务的潜力，为物种识别和音频地理定位的未来工作提供了动力。
AI.summary: 本文探讨了利用环境中的生物声学信号进行全球范围地理定位的可行性。研究提出了一种混合方法，将物种分布范围预测与音频检索相结合，证明了物种声音可作为有效的地理空间线索，并验证了时空聚合及多模态信息对提升定位准确性的积极作用。
AI.keywords: 生物声学, 地理定位, 音频信号, 物种分布, 多模态分析
AI.comments: 该研究在音频地理定位领域具有创新性，将生物声学（物种声音）视为地理信号，这为地理定位任务开辟了新的维度。其意义在于利用生物分布规律解决音频定位问题，并探索了跨模态（音视频）定位的潜力。局限性在于研究依赖于物种分布数据的准确性，且在物种多样性较低的区域可能面临挑战。

title: Bridging Distribution Shift and AI Safety: Conceptual and Methodological Synergies
summary: This paper bridges distribution shift and AI safety through a comprehensive analysis of their conceptual and methodological synergies. While prior discussions often focus on narrow cases or informal analogies, we establish two types connections between specific causes of distribution shift and fine-grained AI safety issues: (1) methods addressing a specific shift type can help achieve corresponding safety goals, or (2) certain shifts and safety issues can be formally reduced to each other, enabling mutual adaptation of their methods. Our findings provide a unified perspective that encourages deeper integration between distribution shift and AI safety research.

title: LaTtE-Flow: Layerwise Timestep-Expert Flow-based Transformer
summary: Recent advances in multimodal foundation models unifying image understanding and generation have opened exciting avenues for tackling a wide range of vision-language tasks within a single framework. Despite progress, existing unified models typically require extensive pretraining and struggle to achieve the same level of performance compared to models dedicated to each task. Additionally, many of these models suffer from slow image generation speeds, limiting their practical deployment in real-time or resource-constrained settings. In this work, we propose Layerwise Timestep-Expert Flow-based Transformer (LaTtE-Flow), a novel and efficient architecture that unifies image understanding and generation within a single multimodal model. LaTtE-Flow builds upon powerful pretrained Vision-Language Models (VLMs) to inherit strong multimodal understanding capabilities, and extends them with a novel Layerwise Timestep Experts flow-based architecture for efficient image generation. LaTtE-Flow distributes the flow-matching process across specialized groups of Transformer layers, each responsible for a distinct subset of timesteps. This design significantly improves sampling efficiency by activating only a small subset of layers at each sampling timestep. To further enhance performance, we propose a Timestep-Conditioned Residual Attention mechanism for efficient information reuse across layers. Experiments demonstrate that LaTtE-Flow achieves strong performance on multimodal understanding tasks, while achieving competitive image generation quality with around 6x faster inference speed compared to recent unified multimodal models.

title: Automatic differentiation for performing the Cauchy-Kovalevskaya procedure in Lax-Wendroff type discretizations
summary: Lax-Wendroff methods combined with discontinuous Galerkin/flux reconstruction spatial discretization provide a high-order, single-stage, quadrature-free method for solving hyperbolic conservation laws. In this work, we introduce automatic differentiation (AD) for performing the Cauchy-Kowalewski procedure used in the element-local time average flux computation step (the predictor step) of Lax-Wendroff methods. The application of AD is similar for methods of any order and does not need positivity corrections during the predictor step. This contrasts with the approximate Lax-Wendroff procedure, which requires different finite difference formulas for different orders of the method and positivity corrections in the predictor step for fluxes that can only be computed on admissible states. The method is Jacobian-free and problem-independent, allowing direct application to any physical flux function. Numerical experiments demonstrate the order and positivity preservation of the method. Additionally, performance comparisons indicate that the wall-clock time of automatic differentiation is always on par with the approximate Lax-Wendroff method.

title: MEAL: A Benchmark for Continual Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
comments: To be published in the International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML) 2026
summary: Benchmarks play a central role in reinforcement learning (RL) research, yet their computational constraints often shape what is studied. Despite the motivation of lifelong learning, most continual RL papers consider only 3-10 sequential tasks, as CPU-bound environments make longer sequences impractical. Meanwhile, continual learning in cooperative multi-agent settings remains largely unexplored. To address these gaps, we introduce MEAL (Multi-agent Environments for Adaptive Learning), the first benchmark for continual multi-agent RL. By leveraging JAX and GPU acceleration, MEAL enables training on sequences of 100 tasks in a few hours on a single GPU. We find that long task sequences reveal failure modes that do not appear at smaller scales.
comment: To be published in the International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML) 2026

title: TransLaw: A Large-Scale Dataset and Multi-Agent Benchmark Simulating Professional Translation of Hong Kong Case Law
comments: Accepted at ICML 2026 - AI for Law
summary: Translating Hong Kong Court Judgments from English to Traditional Chinese is mandated by Articles 8-9 of the Basic Law, yet remains constrained by a shortage of parallel resources and rigorous demands on legal terminology, citation format, and judicial style. We introduce HKCFA Judgment 97-22, the first large-scale sentence-aligned parallel corpus for HK case law, comprising 344 professionally translated judgments (11,099 sentence pairs; 2.1M tokens) spanning 1997-2022. Building on this resource, we propose TransLaw, a multi-agent framework that decomposes translation into word-level expression, sentence-level translation, and multidimensional review, integrating a specialized Hong Kong legal glossary database, Retrieval-Augmented Generation, and iterative feedback, with four-dimensional expert review covering semantic alignment, terminology, citation, and style. Benchmarking 13 open-source and commercial LLMs, we demonstrate that TransLaw significantly outperforms single-agent baselines across all evaluated models, with convergence within 3 iterations. Human evaluation by 10 certified legal translators using our proposed Legal ACS metric confirms gains in legal-semantic accuracy, while showing that TransLaw still trails human experts in stylistic naturalness. The dataset and benchmark code are available at https://github.com/xuanxixi/TransLaw.
comment: Accepted at ICML 2026 - AI for Law

title: Graph Diffusion-Based AeBS Deployment and Resource Allocation in RSMA-Enabled URLLC Low-Altitude Wireless Networks
summary: As a key component of low-altitude wireless networks, aerial base stations (AeBSs) provide flexible and reliable wireless coverage to support 6G ultra-reliable and low-latency communication (URLLC) services. However, limited spectrum resources and severe co-channel interference pose significant challenges to the deployment and resource allocation of AeBSs. To address these limitations, this paper proposes a novel rate-splitting multiple access (RSMA)-enabled transmission design to manage interference and enhance URLLC services in spectrum-constrained multi-AeBS networks. We formulate a joint optimization problem involving AeBS deployment, user association, and resource allocation to maximize the sum rate and coverage of system. Given the NP-hard nature of the problem, we propose a novel alternating optimization framework based on the generative graph diffusion models. Specifically, we model AeBSs and ground users as graph nodes, then we employ a discrete graph generation process solved via denoising diffusion to explore the combinatorial space of deployment and association strategies. Moreover, the successive convex approximation (SCA) is adopted to optimize AeBS beamforming and RSMA rate allocation under finite blocklength constraints. Extensive simulations demonstrate that the proposed algorithm outperforms existing methods in terms of convergence speed, sum rate, and coverage, while also exhibiting robust performance under varying network densities and interference levels.

AI.title_translation: 基于图扩散的RSMA赋能低空无线网络中AeBS部署与资源分配研究
AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于生成式图扩散模型的新算法，解决了低空基站网络中复杂的部署与资源分配问题，显著提升了超可靠低时延通信的性能。
AI.motivation: 低空基站（AeBS）在支持6G超可靠低时延通信（URLLC）时，面临频谱资源受限和严重的同频干扰问题，亟需高效的部署与资源管理策略。
AI.method: 提出了一种基于生成式图扩散模型的交替优化框架，将AeBS部署和用户关联建模为图生成过程；结合连续凸近似（SCA）方法在有限码长约束下优化波束赋形和速率分配。
AI.result: 仿真结果表明，所提算法在收敛速度、总和速率和覆盖率方面均优于现有方法，且在不同网络密度和干扰环境下表现出极强的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 该研究提出的基于图扩散的联合优化框架能有效解决RSMA赋能的低空网络中的资源分配与部署难题，显著提升了系统的频谱效率和通信可靠性。
AI.translation: 作为低空无线网络的核心组成部分，空中基站（AeBSs）提供了灵活可靠的无线覆盖，以支持6G超可靠低时延通信（URLLC）服务。然而，有限的频谱资源和严重的同频干扰给AeBS的部署和资源分配带来了巨大挑战。为了解决这些限制，本文提出了一种新型的速率分裂多址接入（RSMA）传输设计，旨在管理频谱受限的多AeBS网络中的干扰并增强URLLC服务。我们制定了一个联合优化问题，涉及AeBS部署、用户关联和资源分配，以最大化系统总速率和覆盖率。鉴于该问题的NP-hard性质，我们提出了一种基于生成式图扩散模型的新型交替优化框架。具体而言，我们将AeBS和地面用户建模为图节点，然后采用通过去噪扩散求解的离散图生成过程来探索部署和关联策略的组合空间。此外，采用连续凸近似（SCA）在有限码长约束下优化AeBS波束赋形和RSMA速率分配。大量仿真表明，所提算法在收敛速度、总和速率和覆盖率方面均优于现有方法，同时在不同网络密度和干扰水平下也表现出稳健的性能。
AI.summary: 本文针对RSMA赋能的低空无线网络，提出了一种基于图扩散模型的联合优化方案。通过将基站部署与资源分配建模为图生成问题，利用扩散模型处理组合优化挑战，并配合SCA算法优化传输参数，有效提升了URLLC服务的性能。
AI.keywords: 低空基站, 速率分裂多址接入, 超可靠低时延通信, 图扩散模型, 联合优化
AI.comments: 本文创新性地引入了生成式图扩散模型来解决复杂的网络优化问题，这在无线通信领域是一个新兴且具有前瞻性的方法。它成功地将非确定性多项式难题转化为扩散过程，为解决大规模部署和资源分配问题提供了新思路。局限性在于未详细讨论计算开销与实际部署中的时延权衡。

title: Critique of World Model
summary: World Model, the algorithmic simulator of the real-world environment which biological agents experience and act upon, has been an emerging topic in recent years due to the rising need to develop virtual agents with artificial (general) intelligence. There has been much discussion on what a world model really is, how to build it, how to use it, and how to evaluate it. In this essay, starting from the imagination in the famed Sci-Fi classic Dune, and drawing inspiration from the concept of ``hypothetical thinking'' in psychology literature, we argue the primary goal of a world model to be {\it simulating all actionable possibilities of the real world for purposeful reasoning and acting}. We examine the key design dimensions of world modeling: data, representation, architecture, learning objective, and usage, surveying existing approaches and analyzing their tradeoffs. Building on this examination, we propose a new Generative Latent Prediction (GLP) architecture for a general-purpose world model, based on stateful, hierarchical, multi-level, and mixed continuous/discrete representations, and a generative and self-supervised learning framework, with an outlook of a Physical, Agentic, and Nested (PAN) AGI system enabled by such a model.

AI.title_translation: 世界模型批判
AI.tldr: 本文重新定义了世界模型的目标为“模拟所有可操作的现实可能性”，并提出了一种名为GLP的通用世界模型架构，以支持迈向PAN AGI系统。
AI.motivation: 针对目前学术界对世界模型定义、构建、使用及评估存在的模糊认识，旨在通过科幻与心理学视角澄清世界模型的核心目标：即模拟现实中所有可操作的可能性，以服务于目的性推理与行动。
AI.method: 提出了一种基于状态化、层级化、多层级及混合连续/离散表示的“生成式潜在预测（GLP）”架构，并采用生成式与自监督学习框架。
AI.result: 通过对数据、表示、架构、学习目标和用法等关键维度的权衡分析，论证了GLP架构在构建通用世界模型方面的优势，并展望了物理、代理式和嵌套式（PAN）的AGI系统前景。
AI.conclusion: 世界模型应定位为模拟所有可操作现实可能性的工具，以支持智能体进行目的性推理与行动，GLP架构是实现通用世界模型的有效路径。
AI.translation: 世界模型是生物智能体所经历并据此行动的真实环境的算法模拟器，近年来由于对开发具有人工（通用）智能的虚拟智能体的需求日益增长，已成为一个新兴课题。关于什么是真正的世界模型、如何构建、如何使用以及如何评估，目前已有大量讨论。在本文中，我们从科幻经典《沙丘》中的想象力出发，并借鉴心理学文献中“假设性思维”的概念，论证了世界模型的主要目标应该是：为目的性推理和行动模拟真实世界的所有可操作可能性。我们考察了世界建模的关键设计维度：数据、表示、架构、学习目标和用法，调查了现有方法并分析了它们的权衡。基于这一考察，我们提出了一种用于通用世界模型的新的生成式潜在预测（GLP）架构，该架构基于状态化、层级化、多层级和混合连续/离散表示，以及生成式和自监督学习框架，并展望了由这种模型支持的物理、代理式和嵌套式（PAN）AGI系统。
AI.summary: 本文重新审视了世界模型的概念，将其定义为模拟现实所有可操作可能性的工具。作者在分析现有建模方法的基础上，提出了生成式潜在预测（GLP）架构，旨在通过混合表示和自监督学习推动实现物理、代理式和嵌套式（PAN）的通用人工智能。
AI.keywords: 世界模型, 人工通用智能, 生成式潜在预测, 目的性推理, 具身智能
AI.comments: 该论文通过跨学科视角（科幻与心理学）重新定义了世界模型的核心目标，不仅是对现有研究的系统性综述，还提出了具有前瞻性的GLP架构，为迈向PAN AGI系统提供了理论支撑。其创新点在于将世界模型从单纯的预测器提升为支持目的性推理的模拟器。

title: Distributed Resilient State Estimation and Control with Strategically Implemented Security Measures
comments: Accepted for publication in the IEEE Transactions on Automatic Control
summary: This paper addresses the problem of distributed resilient state estimation and control for linear time-invariant systems in the presence of malicious false data injection sensor attacks and bounded noise. We consider a system operator (defender) capable of deploying cybersecurity measures to counteract the sensor compromises. Although such measures enhance resilience against adversarial attacks, they may incur substantial costs; hence, it is crucial to select countermeasures to balance resilience gains and cost efficiency strategically. We first demonstrate that the system's resilience against attacks is maximized through the appropriate implementation of security measures, implying that no attacker can execute undetectable sensor attacks. Building on this analysis, we propose an algorithm that identifies the optimal security measure. While determining this measure is NP-hard in general, we also derive sufficient conditions under which efficient computation is feasible. Furthermore, we develop a distributed resilient state estimation and control scheme informed by the optimal security measure and establish conditions that guarantee bounded estimation and control errors. Finally, we validate the efficacy of our approach via numerical simulations of a vehicle platooning scenario.
comment: Accepted for publication in the IEEE Transactions on Automatic Control

AI.title_translation: 具有策略性实施安全措施的分布式韧性状态估计与控制
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种在成本优化前提下，通过策略性部署安全措施来防御虚假数据注入攻击的分布式控制框架，并验证了其在保障系统误差有界性方面的有效性。
AI.motivation: 在存在恶意虚假数据注入攻击和有界噪声的线性时不变系统中，现有的防御措施往往忽略了实施成本与韧性提升之间的平衡，缺乏一种策略性的最优部署机制。
AI.method: 1. 通过理论分析证明合理部署安全措施可消除不可检测的传感器攻击；2. 提出一种识别最优安全措施的算法，并推导出特定条件下的高效计算方法；3. 开发基于最优安全措施的分布式韧性状态估计与控制方案。
AI.result: 证明了通过适当的安全措施可实现系统韧性最大化；推导出最优安全措施的求解条件；验证了所提方案在车辆编队场景下能有效保证估计与控制误差的有界性。
AI.conclusion: 本文成功构建了一个在成本约束下实现最优防御的分布式韧性控制框架，并通过理论分析与仿真验证了其在保障系统状态估计与控制误差有界方面的有效性。
AI.translation: 本文研究了在恶意虚假数据注入传感器攻击和有界噪声存在的情况下，线性时不变系统的分布式韧性状态估计与控制问题。我们考虑了一个能够部署网络安全措施以抵消传感器损害的系统操作员（防御者）。尽管这些措施增强了对敌对攻击的韧性，但它们可能会产生巨大的成本；因此，策略性地选择防御措施以平衡韧性收益和成本效率至关重要。我们首先证明了通过适当实施安全措施，系统的攻击韧性可以最大化，这意味着没有任何攻击者可以执行不可检测的传感器攻击。在此分析的基础上，我们提出了一种识别最优安全措施的算法。虽然确定该措施在一般情况下是NP-hard问题，但我们也推导出了可以进行高效计算的充分条件。此外，我们开发了一种基于最优安全措施的分布式韧性状态估计与控制方案，并建立了保证估计和控制误差有界的条件。最后，我们通过车辆编队场景的数值模拟验证了我们方法的有效性。
AI.summary: 本文研究了线性时不变系统在虚假数据注入攻击下的分布式韧性估计与控制问题。作者提出了一种在成本约束下优化安全措施部署的策略，通过理论分析证明了最优防御可消除不可检测攻击，并开发了一种分布式算法以实现最优控制与状态估计，最后通过车辆编队仿真验证了方案的有效性。
AI.keywords: 分布式韧性估计, 虚假数据注入攻击, 网络安全, 系统控制, 成本优化
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将安全措施的成本效益纳入了分布式系统状态估计与控制的框架中。通过证明通过适当的安保部署可以消除不可检测攻击，该研究为系统防御提供了理论支撑。其主要局限在于最优解求解的NP-hard性质，尽管作者给出了可高效计算的充分条件，但在大规模复杂系统中的扩展性仍需进一步验证。

title: An approach to the LQG/LTR design problem with specifications for finite-dimensional SISO control systems
comments: typos corrected; references added; additional computational details added
summary: This is an expository paper which discusses an approach to the linear quadratic Gaussian/loop transfer recovery (LQG/LTR) design problem for finite-dimensional single-variable (single-input/single-output, SISO) control systems. The approach is based on the utilisation of weighting augmentation for incorporating design specifications into the framework of the LTR technique for LQG compensator design. The LQG compensator is to simultaneously meet given analytical low- and high-frequency design specifications expressed in terms of desirable sensitivity and controller noise sensitivity functions. The paper is aimed at non-specialists and, in particular, practitioners in finite-dimensional LQG theory interested in the design of feedback compensators for closed-loop performance and robustness shaping of SISO control systems in realistic situations. The proposed approach is illustrated by a detailed design example: the torque control of a geared DC motor with an elastically mounted output shaft.

AI.title_translation: 一种针对有限维SISO控制系统规格的LQG/LTR设计方法
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种改进的LQG/LTR设计方法，通过加权增强技术，使SISO系统补偿器能够同时满足特定的频率响应设计指标。
AI.motivation: 旨在解决有限维SISO控制系统中，如何将具体的低频和高频性能及鲁棒性指标纳入LQG/LTR设计框架，以满足实际应用需求。
AI.method: 通过加权增强（weighting augmentation）技术，将低频和高频的设计指标（灵敏度函数和控制器噪声灵敏度函数）整合到LQG/LTR补偿器设计框架中。
AI.result: 成功实现了一种能够同时满足给定解析设计指标的LQG补偿器设计方法，并通过齿轮直流电机控制案例验证了其有效性。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出了一种改进的LQG/LTR设计方法，能够有效处理SISO系统中低频和高频的特定性能要求，适用于实际工程场景。
AI.translation: 这是一篇综述性论文，讨论了有限维单变量（单输入/单输出，SISO）控制系统的线性二次高斯/回路传输恢复（LQG/LTR）设计问题。该方法基于加权增强的利用，将设计规格纳入LQG补偿器设计的LTR技术框架中。LQG补偿器需同时满足给定的分析性低频和高频设计规格，这些规格以理想的灵敏度函数和控制器噪声灵敏度函数来表示。本文面向非专业人士，特别是对在实际情况中为SISO控制系统设计闭环性能和鲁棒性整形反馈补偿器感兴趣的有限维LQG理论从业者。文中所提方法通过一个详细的设计案例进行了说明：带有弹性安装输出轴的齿轮直流电机的转矩控制。
AI.summary: 本文探讨了针对有限维SISO系统的LQG/LTR设计方法。通过引入加权增强技术，作者提出了一种将低频和高频性能指标整合进补偿器设计框架的新方案，旨在帮助实践者更好地处理实际工程中的鲁棒性和性能整形问题，并以齿轮直流电机控制为例进行了验证。

title: We Need to Rethink Benchmarking in Anomaly Detection
summary: Despite the continuous proposal of new anomaly detection algorithms and extensive benchmarking efforts, progress seems to stagnate, with only minor performance differences between established baselines and new algorithms. In this position paper, we argue that this stagnation is due to limitations in how we evaluate anomaly detection algorithms. In current benchmarks, a trivial algorithm that only checks for extreme values in individual features performs competitively with state-of-the-art deep learning methods, despite failing on simple cases such as anomalies within an annulus of normal points. Moreover, existing benchmarks do not adequately reflect the diversity of anomaly detection applications, making it difficult for practitioners to reliably select algorithms for their applications. Consequently, we need to rethink benchmarking in anomaly detection. In our opinion, anomaly detection should be studied using scenarios that group applications sharing relevant characteristics, defined through a common taxonomy. Benchmarking within scenarios enables scenario-specific choices for preprocessing, metrics, and model selection, clarifying which advances transfer across similar applications and providing practitioners with reliable guidance for their specific contexts.

title: On the Limitations of Ray-Tracing for Learning-Based RF Tasks in Urban Environments
comments: This work was supported by funding under the bilateral agreement between CNR (Italy) and HESC MESCS RA (Armenia) as part of the DeepRF project for the 2025-2026 biennium, and by the HESC MESCS RA grant No. 22rl-052 (DISTAL)
summary: We study the realism of Sionna v1.0.2 ray-tracing for outdoor cellular links in central Rome. We use a real measurement set of 1,664 user-equipments (UEs) and six nominal base-station (BS) sites. Using these fixed positions we systematically vary the main simulation parameters, including path depth, diffuse/specular/refraction flags, carrier frequency, as well as antenna's properties like its altitude, radiation pattern, and orientation. Simulator fidelity is scored for each base station via Spearman correlation between measured and simulated powers, and by a fingerprint-based k-nearest-neighbor localization algorithm using RSSI-based fingerprints. Across all experiments, solver hyper-parameters are having immaterial effect on the chosen metrics. On the contrary, antenna locations and orientations prove decisive. By simple greedy optimization we improve the Spearman correlation by 5% to 130% for various base stations, while kNN-based localization error using only simulated data as reference points is decreased by one-third on real-world samples, while staying twice higher than the error with purely real data. Precise geometry and credible antenna models are therefore necessary but not sufficient; faithfully capturing the residual urban noise remains an open challenge for transferable, high-fidelity outdoor RF simulation.

AI.title_translation: 论城市环境中基于学习的射频任务中射线追踪的局限性
AI.tldr: 射线追踪模拟器在户外射频任务中受限于天线配置和城市环境噪声，仅靠模拟数据尚无法完全取代真实测量。
AI.motivation: 评估Sionna射线追踪模拟器在户外城市蜂窝网络环境下的真实表现，并探讨其在基于学习的射频任务中的局限性。
AI.method: 利用罗马市中心1664个用户设备和6个基站的真实测量数据集，系统性地调整射线追踪模拟器（Sionna）的参数（如路径深度、折射/反射设置等）以及天线属性（高度、朝向等），并使用Spearman相关系数和kNN定位算法评估模拟器保真度。
AI.result: 模拟器超参数对结果影响较小，而天线的位置和朝向具有决定性影响。通过优化天线参数，Spearman相关性提高了5%至130%，定位误差降低了三分之一，但仍远高于使用真实数据获得的误差。
AI.conclusion: 精确的几何建模和可靠的天线模型是必要的，但不足以模拟高保真度的户外射频环境，捕捉城市环境中的残余噪声仍是当前的一大挑战。
AI.translation: 我们研究了Sionna v1.0.2射线追踪在罗马市中心户外蜂窝链路中的真实感。我们使用了一组包含1664个用户设备（UE）和6个名义基站（BS）的真实测量集。利用这些固定位置，我们系统地改变了主要的模拟参数，包括路径深度、漫反射/镜面反射/折射标志、载波频率，以及天线的属性，如高度、辐射方向图和方向。通过测量功率与模拟功率之间的Spearman相关性，以及使用基于RSSI指纹的k近邻（kNN）定位算法，对每个基站的模拟器保真度进行评分。在所有实验中，求解器超参数对所选指标的影响微乎其微。相反，天线的位置和方向被证明是决定性的。通过简单的贪婪优化，我们将不同基站的Spearman相关性提高了5%到130%，同时使用仅模拟数据作为参考点的kNN定位误差在真实样本上降低了三分之一，尽管仍比仅使用真实数据的误差高出两倍。因此，精确的几何结构和可信的天线模型是必要的，但还不够；忠实地捕捉残余城市噪声对于可迁移、高保真的户外射频模拟仍然是一个悬而未决的挑战。
AI.summary: 本文研究了Sionna射线追踪模拟器在户外城市环境下的保真度。通过对比真实测量数据，发现模拟器的核心参数对结果影响有限，而天线的精确配置至关重要。尽管优化参数可显著提升模拟效果，但由于难以模拟城市环境中的复杂噪声，其在完全替代真实数据方面仍存在局限性。
AI.keywords: 射线追踪, 射频模拟, 城市环境, 蜂窝链路, 天线建模
AI.comments: 该研究揭示了在基于学习的射频任务中，仅靠射线追踪（Ray-Tracing）模拟器往往不足以完全替代真实测量数据。其创新之处在于通过系统性变量分析，明确了天线参数（位置、朝向）对模拟保真度的决定性影响，并指出了城市环境残余噪声建模这一尚未解决的挑战。研究对于开发更精准的无线通信模拟工具具有重要的现实指导意义。

title: Oranits: Mission Assignment and Task Offloading in Open RAN-based ITS using Metaheuristic and Deep Reinforcement Learning
summary: In this paper, we explore mission assignment and task offloading in an Open Radio Access Network (Open RAN)-based intelligent transportation system (ITS), where autonomous vehicles leverage mobile edge computing for efficient processing. Existing studies often overlook the intricate interdependencies between missions and the costs associated with offloading tasks to edge servers, leading to suboptimal decision-making. To bridge this gap, we introduce Oranits, a novel system model that explicitly accounts for mission dependencies and offloading costs while optimizing performance through vehicle cooperation. To achieve this, we propose a twofold optimization approach. First, we develop a metaheuristic-based evolutionary computing algorithm, namely the Chaotic Gaussian-based Global ARO (CGG-ARO), serving as a baseline for one-slot optimization. Second, we design an enhanced reward-based deep reinforcement learning (DRL) framework, referred to as the Multi-agent Double Deep Q-Network (MA-DDQN), that integrates both multi-agent coordination and multi-action selection mechanisms, significantly reducing mission assignment time and improving adaptability over baseline methods. Extensive simulations reveal that CGG-ARO improves the number of completed missions and overall benefit by approximately 7.1% and 7.7%, respectively. Meanwhile, MA-DDQN achieves even greater improvements of 11.0% in terms of mission completions and 12.5% in terms of the overall benefit. These results highlight the effectiveness of Oranits in enabling faster, more adaptive, and more efficient task processing in dynamic ITS environments.

title: An Angular-Temporal Interaction Network for Light Field Object Tracking in Low-Light Scenes
summary: High-quality 4D light field representation with efficient angular feature modeling is crucial for scene perception, as it can provide discriminative spatial-angular cues to identify moving targets. However, recent developments still struggle to deliver reliable angular modeling in the temporal domain, particularly in complex low-light scenes. In this paper, we propose a novel light field epipolar-plane structure image (ESI) representation that explicitly defines the geometric structure within the light field. By capitalizing on the abrupt changes in the angles of light rays within the epipolar plane, this representation can enhance visual expression in low-light scenes and reduce redundancy in high-dimensional light fields. We further propose an angular-temporal interaction network (ATINet) for light field object tracking that learns angular-aware representations from the geometric structural cues and angular-temporal interaction cues of light fields. Furthermore, ATINet can also be optimized in a self-supervised manner to enhance the geometric feature interaction across the temporal domain. Finally, we introduce a large-scale light field low-light dataset for object tracking. Extensive experimentation demonstrates that ATINet achieves state-of-the-art performance in single object tracking. Furthermore, we extend the proposed method to multiple object tracking, which also shows the effectiveness of high-quality light field angular-temporal modeling.

AI.title_translation: 面向低光照场景下光场目标跟踪的角度-时间交互网络
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种ATINet网络，通过新的极线平面结构图像表示和自监督时域交互学习，解决了低光照环境下光场目标跟踪的建模难题。
AI.motivation: 现有的光场目标跟踪方法在处理复杂低光照场景时，难以实现可靠的时域角度建模，导致特征表达能力不足。
AI.method: 1. 提出了一种新的极线平面结构图像（ESI）表示法，通过捕捉极线平面内光线角度的变化来增强低光照下的视觉表达；2. 构建了角度-时间交互网络（ATINet），学习角度感知表示和角度-时间交互线索；3. 引入自监督优化机制以增强时域几何特征交互；4. 构建了一个大规模的光场低光照跟踪数据集。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，ATINet在单目标跟踪任务中达到了最先进的性能，并成功扩展至多目标跟踪任务，验证了高质量光场角度-时间建模的有效性。
AI.conclusion: ATINet通过高效的几何结构建模和角度-时间交互学习，显著提升了低光照场景下的光场目标跟踪性能，并在单目标和多目标跟踪任务中均取得了优异表现。
AI.translation: 高质量的4D光场表示及其高效的角度特征建模对于场景感知至关重要，因为它能提供判别性的空间-角度线索来识别移动目标。然而，目前的发展在时域角度建模方面仍面临挑战，特别是在复杂的低光照场景中。在本文中，我们提出了一种新颖的光场极线平面结构图像（ESI）表示法，该方法明确定义了光场内部的几何结构。通过利用极线平面内光线角度的突变，该表示可以增强低光照场景下的视觉表达，并减少高维光场中的冗余。此外，我们提出了一种用于光场目标跟踪的角度-时间交互网络（ATINet），该网络从光场的几何结构线索和角度-时间交互线索中学习角度感知表示。同时，ATINet可以通过自监督方式进行优化，以增强跨时间域的几何特征交互。最后，我们引入了一个用于目标跟踪的大规模光场低光照数据集。大量实验表明，ATINet在单目标跟踪方面达到了最先进的性能。此外，我们将所提方法扩展到多目标跟踪，也证明了高质量光场角度-时间建模的有效性。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种用于低光照场景下光场目标跟踪的角-时交互网络（ATINet）。通过引入新的极线平面结构图像（ESI）表示法，有效增强了低光照下的视觉特征，并利用ATINet学习角度感知和时域交互线索。此外，通过自监督学习优化和发布大规模低光照光场数据集，该方法在单/多目标跟踪任务中均表现出色。
AI.keywords: 光场目标跟踪, 低光照场景, 角度-时间交互网络, 极线平面结构图像, 自监督学习
AI.comments: 该论文通过引入新的ESI表示法有效解决了光场数据在低光照条件下的特征建模难题，并提出了自监督优化策略，不仅提升了单目标跟踪的精度，还验证了方法在多目标跟踪任务中的泛化能力，具有较高的学术价值和实际应用潜力。

title: HGCN(O): A Self-Tuning GCN HyperModel Toolkit for Outcome Prediction in Event-Sequence Data
summary: We propose HGCN(O), a self-tuning toolkit using Graph Convolutional Network (GCN) models for event sequence prediction. Featuring four GCN architectures (O-GCN, T-GCN, TP-GCN, TE-GCN) across the GCNConv and GraphConv layers, our toolkit integrates multiple graph representations of event sequences with different choices of node- and graph-level attributes and in temporal dependencies via edge weights, optimising prediction accuracy and stability for balanced and unbalanced datasets. Extensive experiments show that GCNConv models excel on unbalanced data, while all models perform consistently on balanced data. Experiments also confirm the superior performance of HGCN(O) over traditional approaches. Applications include Predictive Business Process Monitoring (PBPM), which predicts future events or states of a business process based on event logs.

title: Continual Learning with Support Boundary Experience Blending
summary: Continual learning (CL) seeks to mitigate catastrophic forgetting when models are trained with sequential tasks. A common approach, experience replay (ER), stores past exemplars but only sparsely approximates the data distribution, yielding fragile and oversimplified decision boundaries. We address this limitation by introducing Support Boundary Data (SBD), generated via differential-privacy-inspired noise into latent features to create boundary-adjacent representations that implicitly regularize decision boundaries. Building on this idea, we propose Experience Blending (EB), a framework that jointly trains on exemplars and SBD through a dual-model aggregation strategy. EB has two components: (1) latent-space noise injection to generate support boundary data, and (2) end-to-end training that jointly leverages exemplars and SBD. Unlike standard experience replay, SBD enriches the feature space near decision boundaries, leading to more stable and robust continual learning. Extensive experiments on CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, Tiny ImageNet, and ImageNet1K demonstrate consistent accuracy improvements of 10%, 6%, 14%, 2%, respectively.

AI.title_translation: 基于支持边界经验混合的连续学习
AI.tldr: 通过生成并混合决策边界附近的模拟数据，增强了连续学习模型的鲁棒性，有效缓解了灾难性遗忘。
AI.motivation: 现有的经验回放（ER）方法在处理连续学习任务时，由于仅存储稀疏的旧样本，导致模型对数据分布的近似不足，从而产生脆弱且过度简化的决策边界，导致灾难性遗忘。
AI.method: 提出经验混合（Experience Blending, EB）框架，包含两个核心步骤：1. 在潜空间注入差分隐私启发的噪声以生成支持边界数据（SBD）；2. 采用双模型聚合策略，联合训练真实样本与生成的SBD。
AI.result: 在CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100、Tiny ImageNet和ImageNet1K数据集上，该方法分别实现了10%、6%、14%和2%的准确率提升。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，通过生成并融合支持边界数据（SBD）来增强经验回放，能有效缓解连续学习中的灾难性遗忘，提升模型在连续任务上的准确率和稳定性。
AI.translation: 连续学习（CL）旨在缓解模型在顺序任务训练过程中的灾难性遗忘。经验回放（ER）是一种常见方法，通过存储部分历史样本进行训练，但这种方法仅能稀疏地近似数据分布，导致决策边界脆弱且过度简化。为了解决这一局限，我们引入了支持边界数据（SBD），通过在潜特征中加入受差分隐私启发的噪声，创造出邻近边界的表征，从而隐式地规范化决策边界。基于此，我们提出了经验混合（EB）框架，通过双模型聚合策略，联合训练历史样本与SBD。EB包含两个部分：（1）潜空间噪声注入以生成支持边界数据；（2）利用样本与SBD进行端到端联合训练。与标准经验回放不同，SBD丰富了决策边界附近的特征空间，从而带来了更稳定、更鲁棒的连续学习效果。在CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100、Tiny ImageNet和ImageNet1K上的广泛实验表明，该方法分别实现了10%、6%、14%和2%的准确率提升。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种基于支持边界数据（SBD）的经验混合（EB）连续学习框架。该框架通过在潜空间中注入噪声生成边界附近的样本，弥补了传统经验回放对数据分布近似的不足，从而强化了决策边界并提升了模型的连续学习性能。
AI.keywords: 连续学习, 经验回放, 决策边界, 支持边界数据, 灾难性遗忘
AI.comments: 该研究通过在潜空间注入噪声来生成“支持边界数据”，巧妙地解决了经验回放方法中决策边界过度简化的问题。这种方法不仅引入了正则化，还通过双模型聚合策略提升了模型的鲁棒性，在多个基准数据集上均取得了显著的准确率提升，具有很强的实用价值和创新性。

title: Periodic robust robotic rock chop via virtual model control
summary: Robotic cutting is a challenging, contact-rich manipulation task where the robot must simultaneously negotiate unknown object mechanics, large contact forces, and precise motion requirements. Our hypothesis is that this complexity can be alleviated through the design of a physically structured virtual-model controller that uses switched virtual mechanisms to generate a robust, rhythmic rock-chop motion for robotic cutting, without requiring pre-planned trajectories or precise environmental information. Motion is generated by the interaction between the environment, the robot's dynamics, and the virtual forces of the switching virtual mechanism, ultimately realized through the available actuation. Through theoretical analysis and experimental validation, we demonstrate that the controlled robot behavior settles into a stable periodic motion. Experiments with a Franka manipulator demonstrate robust cuts across five different vegetables, achieving sub-millimeter slice accuracy for thicknesses from 1 mm to 6 mm at a rate of nearly one cut per second. The controller maintains high performance despite changes in knife shape or cutting board height, and successfully adapts to a different humanoid manipulator, demonstrating robustness and platform independence.

title: ShoppingBench: A Real-World Intent-Grounded Shopping Benchmark for LLM-based Agents
comments: Accepted for oral presentation at AAAI 2026
summary: Existing benchmarks in e-commerce primarily focus on basic user intents, such as finding or purchasing products. However, real-world users often pursue more complex goals, such as applying vouchers, managing budgets, and finding multi-products seller. To bridge this gap, we propose ShoppingBench, a novel end-to-end shopping benchmark designed to encompass increasingly challenging levels of grounded intent. Specifically, we propose a scalable framework to simulate user instructions based on various intents derived from sampled real-world products. To facilitate consistent and reliable evaluations, we provide a large-scale shopping sandbox that serves as an interactive simulated environment, incorporating over 2.5 million real-world products. Experimental results demonstrate that even state-of-the-art language agents (such as GPT-4.1) achieve absolute success rates under 50% on our benchmark tasks, highlighting the significant challenges posed by our ShoppingBench. In addition, we propose a trajectory distillation strategy and leverage supervised fine-tuning, along with reinforcement learning on synthetic trajectories, to distill the capabilities of a large language agent into a smaller one. As a result, our trained agent achieves competitive performance compared to GPT-4.1.

AI.title_translation: ShoppingBench：一个面向LLM代理的真实意图导向购物基准测试
AI.tldr: ShoppingBench是一个涵盖250万真实商品、挑战性极高的电商基准测试，揭示了现有模型在复杂购物任务上的不足，并提出了一种通过蒸馏提升模型电商能力的新方法。
AI.motivation: 现有电商基准测试仅关注基础购买意图，无法满足现实中复杂购物场景（如凑单、预算管理、多商品匹配等）的需求。
AI.method: 1. 构建包含250万真实商品的交互式购物沙箱；2. 设计分级意图指令生成框架；3. 采用轨迹蒸馏策略，结合监督微调与强化学习，将大型代理的能力迁移至小型模型。
AI.result: GPT-4.1在ShoppingBench上的成功率不足50%，表明任务难度极高；通过所提蒸馏策略训练的小型模型性能可比肩GPT-4.1。
AI.conclusion: ShoppingBench是一个具有挑战性的电商基准测试，揭示了当前顶尖LLM在处理复杂购物意图时的不足，并验证了通过轨迹蒸馏和强化学习提升小型模型电商能力的有效性。
AI.translation: 现有的电子商务基准测试主要关注基本的用户意图，例如查找或购买产品。然而，现实中的用户往往追求更复杂的目标，例如使用优惠券、管理预算以及寻找多产品卖家。为了弥补这一差距，我们提出了ShoppingBench，这是一个新颖的端到端购物基准测试，旨在涵盖日益具有挑战性的落地意图级别。具体而言，我们提出了一个可扩展的框架，基于从采样真实产品中派生出的各种意图来模拟用户指令。为了促进一致且可靠的评估，我们提供了一个大规模的购物沙箱，作为交互式模拟环境，整合了超过250万个真实产品。实验结果表明，即使是最先进的语言代理（如GPT-4.1）在我们基准任务上的绝对成功率也低于50%，凸显了ShoppingBench带来的重大挑战。此外，我们提出了一种轨迹蒸馏策略，并利用监督微调以及针对合成轨迹的强化学习，将大型语言代理的能力蒸馏给小型代理。结果显示，我们训练的代理实现了与GPT-4.1相当的竞争性能。
AI.summary: 本文提出了ShoppingBench，这是一个用于评估大模型代理在真实复杂电商场景下处理多级意图能力的基准测试。通过构建大规模商品沙箱并引入轨迹蒸馏策略，该研究有效提升了小型模型在复杂购物任务中的表现。
AI.keywords: ShoppingBench, 大语言模型代理, 电商基准测试, 意图识别, 轨迹蒸馏
AI.comments: 该论文通过构建包含250万真实商品的交互式沙箱，弥补了现有电商基准测试在复杂任务处理上的不足，强调了LLM在处理多步骤购物意图时的局限性，并提供了一种有效的模型蒸馏方法，具有很高的实用价值和研究意义。

title: Composed Object Retrieval: Object-level Retrieval via Composed Expressions
summary: Retrieving fine-grained visual content based on user intent remains a challenge in multimodal systems. Although current Composed Image Retrieval (CIR) methods combine reference images with retrieval texts, they are constrained to image-level matching and cannot localize specific objects. To this end, we propose Composed Object Retrieval (COR), a new object-level retrieval task that retrieves target object(s) from candidate objects in a target image and grounds the retrieved result with pixel-level masks. Given a reference object, its mask, a target image, and a retrieval text describing the desired modification, COR requires models to perform composed visual-textual reasoning rather than relying on explicit category names. This setting introduces several challenges, including fine-grained compositional matching, negative-object filtering under visually similar distractors, and flexible single- or multi-object retrieval. We construct COR125K, the first large-scale COR benchmark, containing 125,541 retrieval triplets across 408 categories with base/novel splits for evaluating category-level generalization. We also present CORE, a unified end-to-end model that integrates reference region encoding, adaptive vision-text interaction, and region-level contrastive learning to align composed representations with target objects while suppressing background and distractors. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CORE significantly outperforms existing CIR-based pipelines and strong baselines in both base and novel categories, establishing a simple and effective foundation for fine-grained object-level multimodal retrieval. Code will be released publicly at https://github.com/wangtong627/COR.

title: The Search for Relevance: A Context-Aware Paradigm Shift in Semantic and Task-Oriented V2X Communications
summary: The design of communication systems has traditionally prioritized the reliable and timely delivery of data. However, the scalability challenges faced by the evolution towards a data-driven hyper-connected society and economy demand new communication paradigms that carefully curate the content being transmitted. This paper proposes a joint semantic and task-oriented communication paradigm where connected devices transmit only the information necessary to convey the desired meaning that is relevant to the intended receivers, based on their context. We qualitatively and quantitatively analyze the potential benefits of the proposed semantic and task-oriented communication paradigm in the Vehicle-to-Everything (V2X) domain. The V2X domain offers a unique environment for the development and deployment of semantic and task-oriented V2X communications, as it is rich in contextual information and Connected and Autonomous Vehicles (CAVs) are native semantic devices. The qualitative analysis focuses on a cooperative perception use case and shows how semantic and task-oriented V2X communications can reduce the amount of information transmitted by each vehicle without compromising the situational awareness of its intended receivers. The quantitative analysis numerically demonstrates that semantic and task-oriented V2X communications can achieve a two-fold improvement in communication efficiency which can significantly benefit the scalability of future V2X networks.

AI.title_translation: 相关性探索：语义与任务导向V2X通信的上下文感知范式转移
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种语义与任务导向的V2X通信新范式，通过仅传输上下文相关信息，在保证感知性能的同时实现通信效率翻倍。
AI.motivation: 传统的通信系统侧重于数据的可靠和及时传输，但在数据驱动的超连接社会中，面临严重的扩展性挑战，迫切需要一种能够精简传输内容的新范式。
AI.method: 提出了一种联合语义和任务导向的通信范式，根据接收方的上下文需求，仅传输实现预期意义和任务目标所需的相关信息，并结合定性（协同感知用例）与定量分析验证其在V2X环境中的性能。
AI.result: 研究表明，该范式在不影响接收方态势感知的前提下，能够有效减少车辆传输的数据量，并实现通信效率两倍的提升。
AI.conclusion: 语义和任务导向的V2X通信范式能够显著提高通信效率并支持网络的可扩展性，是未来智能交通系统通信架构的重要演进方向。
AI.translation: 通信系统的设计传统上优先考虑数据的可靠和及时交付。然而，迈向数据驱动的超连接社会和经济所面临的可扩展性挑战，要求新的通信范式能够仔细甄选传输内容。本文提出了一种联合语义和任务导向的通信范式，即连接设备仅传输根据接收方上下文判断出的、传达预期意义所需的相关信息。我们在车联网（V2X）领域对该范式的潜在益处进行了定性和定量分析。V2X领域为语义和任务导向通信的开发与部署提供了独特环境，因为它拥有丰富的上下文信息，且网联自动驾驶汽车（CAVs）本身就是天然的语义设备。定性分析侧重于协同感知用例，展示了语义和任务导向的V2X通信如何在不损害接收方态势感知的前提下，减少每辆车的传输信息量。定量分析从数值上证明了该范式可以实现通信效率的两倍提升，显著有益于未来V2X网络的可扩展性。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种面向V2X环境的语义和任务导向通信新范式。通过根据接收方的上下文仅传输必要信息，该方法在保证协同感知质量的同时，显著降低了数据传输量，在定量分析中实现了通信效率翻倍，为解决未来大规模V2X网络的扩展性瓶颈提供了有效途径。
AI.keywords: 语义通信, 任务导向通信, V2X, 协同感知, 通信效率
AI.comments: 该论文通过引入语义和任务导向通信，从传统的“可靠传输”范式转向“相关性优先”范式，为解决未来超大规模V2X网络的可扩展性挑战提供了具有前瞻性的思路。其局限在于目前仅针对协同感知场景进行了分析，在更广泛、动态的复杂交通场景下的普适性有待进一步验证。

title: Collaborative Multi-Modal Coding for High-Quality 3D Generation
summary: 3D content inherently encompasses multi-modal characteristics and can be projected into different modalities (e.g., RGB images, RGBD, and point clouds). Each modality exhibits distinct advantages in 3D asset modeling: RGB images contain vivid 3D textures, whereas point clouds define fine-grained 3D geometries. However, most existing 3D-native generative architectures either operate predominantly within single-modality paradigms-thus overlooking the complementary benefits of multi-modality data-or restrict themselves to 3D structures, thereby limiting the scope of available training datasets. To holistically harness multi-modalities for 3D modeling, we present TriMM, the first feed-forward 3D-native generative model that learns from basic multi-modalities (e.g., RGB, RGBD, and point cloud). Specifically, 1) TriMM first introduces collaborative multi-modal coding, which integrates modality-specific features while preserving their unique representational strengths. 2) Furthermore, auxiliary 2D and 3D supervision are introduced to raise the robustness and performance of multi-modal coding. 3) Based on the embedded multi-modal code, TriMM employs a triplane latent diffusion model to generate 3D assets of superior quality, enhancing both the texture and the geometric detail. Extensive experiments on multiple well-known datasets demonstrate that TriMM, by effectively leveraging multi-modality, achieves competitive performance with models trained on large-scale datasets, despite utilizing a small amount of training data. Furthermore, we conduct additional experiments on recent RGB-D datasets, verifying the feasibility of incorporating other multi-modal datasets into 3D generation.

AI.title_translation: 用于高质量3D生成的协同多模态编码
AI.tldr: TriMM通过协同整合RGB、RGBD和点云等多模态数据，实现了在少量训练数据下生成高质量3D内容的目标。
AI.motivation: 现有的3D生成模型多局限于单一模态，忽略了不同模态（如RGB的纹理和点云的几何信息）之间的互补优势，且受到训练数据范围的限制。
AI.method: 1) 提出协同多模态编码（Collaborative Multi-modal Coding），整合不同模态特征；2) 引入辅助2D和3D监督以提升鲁棒性；3) 基于多模态编码，利用三平面（triplane）潜在扩散模型生成3D资产。
AI.result: 实验表明，TriMM在少量训练数据下即可达到与大规模数据集训练模型相当的竞争性性能，并显著提升了3D资产的纹理和几何细节质量。
AI.conclusion: TriMM 通过协同多模态编码和辅助监督机制，证明了在少量数据下利用多种模态信息可以显著提升3D生成的质量，为3D内容生成开辟了新的研究路径。
AI.translation: 3D内容本身具有多模态特性，可以投影到不同的模态中（如RGB图像、RGBD和点云）。每种模态在3D资产建模中都有其独特的优势：RGB图像包含生动的3D纹理，而点云定义了细粒度的3D几何结构。然而，大多数现有的3D原生生成架构要么主要在单模态范式下运行，从而忽略了多模态数据的互补优势，要么仅限于3D结构，从而限制了可用训练数据集的范围。为了全面利用多模态进行3D建模，我们提出了TriMM，这是第一个从基础多模态（如RGB、RGBD和点云）中学习的端到端3D原生生成模型。具体而言：1) TriMM引入了协同多模态编码，在整合模态特定特征的同时保留了它们独特的表征优势。2) 此外，引入了辅助的2D和3D监督，以提高多模态编码的鲁棒性和性能。3) 基于嵌入的多模态编码，TriMM采用三平面潜在扩散模型来生成高质量的3D资产，增强了纹理和几何细节。在多个知名数据集上的广泛实验表明，尽管仅使用了少量训练数据，TriMM通过有效利用多模态，仍实现了与在大规模数据集上训练的模型相当的竞争性能。此外，我们对最新的RGB-D数据集进行了额外实验，验证了将其他多模态数据集纳入3D生成的可行性。
AI.summary: 本文提出了TriMM，这是首个通过协同多模态编码（RGB、RGBD、点云）来提升3D生成质量的端到端模型。通过整合多模态互补特征及辅助监督，该模型在少量数据下实现了高质量的3D资产生成。
AI.keywords: 3D生成, 多模态学习, 潜在扩散模型, TriMM, 协同编码
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于提出了首个利用多模态（RGB、RGBD、点云）进行高效3D生成的框架TriMM，有效解决了现有模型在单模态限制或数据利用率上的不足。其局限性在于未在超大规模数据集上进行对比验证，且对多模态数据的对齐要求较高。

title: Robust Convex Model Predictive Control with collision avoidance guarantees for robot manipulators
summary: Industrial manipulators typically operate in cluttered environments, where safe motion planning is critical. However, model uncertainties further complicate this task, which leads to conservative speed limits to reduce the influence of disturbances. Hence, there is a need for control methods that can guarantee safe motions which are executed fast. We address this by suggesting a novel model predictive control (MPC) solution for manipulators, where our two main components are a robust tube MPC and a corridor planning algorithm to obtain collision-free motion. Our solution results in a convex MPC formulation, which we can solve fast, making our method practically useful. We demonstrate the efficacy of our method in a simulated environment with a 6 DOF industrial robot operating in cluttered environments with uncertain model parameters. We outperform benchmark methods by tolerating higher levels of model uncertainty while achieving faster motion.

title: Learn from What We HAVE: History-Aware VErifier that Reasons about Past Interactions Online
summary: We introduce a novel History-Aware VErifier (HAVE) to disambiguate uncertain scenarios online by leveraging past interactions. Robots frequently encounter visually ambiguous objects whose manipulation outcomes remain uncertain until physically interacted with. While generative models alone could theoretically adapt to such ambiguity, in practice they obtain suboptimal performance in ambiguous cases, even when conditioned on action history. To address this, we propose explicitly decoupling action generation from verification: we use an unconditional diffusion-based generator to propose multiple candidate actions and employ our history-aware verifier to select the most promising action by reasoning about past interactions. Through theoretical analysis, we demonstrate that employing a verifier significantly improves expected action quality. Empirical evaluations and analysis across multiple simulated and real-world environments including articulated objects, multi-modal doors, and uneven object pick-up confirm the effectiveness of our method and improvements over baselines. Our project website is available at: https://liy1shu.github.io/HAVE_CoRL25/

AI.title_translation: 从已有经验中学习：利用在线历史交互进行推理的历史感知验证器 (HAVE)
AI.tldr: 通过将机器人动作生成与历史感知验证解耦，HAVE 成功消除了在线交互中的视觉歧义，显著提升了机器人的操作成功率。
AI.motivation: 机器人在线操作中常遇到视觉歧义，导致现有的生成模型在处理不确定性时表现不佳，即使利用动作历史也难以达到最优效果。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为 HAVE 的历史感知验证器，采用解耦策略：使用无条件扩散模型生成多个候选动作，随后利用 HAVE 模块基于历史交互信息对这些动作进行评估和选择。
AI.result: 理论分析表明验证器可提升动作质量；在模拟和真实世界的复杂任务（如关节物体操作、多模态门开启、不均匀物体抓取）中，实验结果证实该方法显著优于现有基线模型。
AI.conclusion: HAVE 证明了利用历史交互信息进行动作验证能显著提升机器人在不确定环境下的任务成功率，为解决机器人在线操作歧义提供了一种高效、可扩展的框架。
AI.translation: 我们引入了一种新颖的历史感知验证器（HAVE），通过利用历史交互来消除在线场景中的不确定性。机器人在操作中经常遇到视觉模糊的物体，其操作结果在物理交互前往往难以确定。虽然生成模型在理论上可以适应这种歧义，但在实践中，即使在给定动作历史的情况下，它们在处理模糊情况时表现依然不佳。为了解决这一问题，我们提出将动作生成与验证显式解耦：使用无条件扩散模型生成多个候选动作，并利用我们的历史感知验证器通过推理过去交互来选择最有希望的动作。通过理论分析，我们证明了使用验证器可以显著提高预期的动作质量。在包括关节物体、多模态门和不均匀物体抓取等多个模拟和现实环境中的实证评估与分析，证实了我们方法的有效性及对基线方法的改进。项目网站：https://liy1shu.github.io/HAVE_CoRL25/
AI.summary: 论文提出了一种名为 HAVE 的历史感知验证器，旨在解决机器人在线交互中的视觉歧义问题。该方法通过解耦动作生成与验证，利用历史交互信息从扩散模型生成的候选动作中筛选最优解，在多种复杂物理操作任务中展现出卓越的性能。
AI.keywords: 机器人交互, 历史感知验证器, 扩散模型, 动作规划, 歧义消除
AI.comments: 该论文通过引入历史感知验证器（HAVE），巧妙地解决了机器人在线交互中因视觉歧义导致的动作不确定性问题。其核心创新在于将“动作生成”与“动作验证”解耦，这种策略在处理复杂物理交互（如关节物体、多模态门）时表现出很强的鲁棒性，是迈向更智能、更具适应性机器人操作的重要一步。

title: Charting the Future of Scholarly Knowledge with AI: A Community Perspective
summary: Despite the growing availability of tools designed to support scholarly knowledge extraction and organization, many researchers still rely on manual methods, sometimes due to unfamiliarity with existing technologies or limited access to domain-adapted solutions. Meanwhile, the rapid increase in scholarly publications across disciplines has made it increasingly difficult to stay current, further underscoring the need for scalable, AI-enabled approaches to structuring and synthesizing scholarly knowledge. Various research communities have begun addressing this challenge independently, developing tools and frameworks aimed at building reliable, dynamic, and queryable scholarly knowledge bases. However, limited interaction across these communities has hindered the exchange of methods, models, and best practices, slowing progress toward more integrated solutions. This manuscript identifies ways to foster cross-disciplinary dialogue, identify shared challenges, categorize new collaboration and shape future research directions in scholarly knowledge and organization.

AI.title_translation: 以AI勾勒学术知识的未来：一个社区的视角
AI.tldr: 面对学术文献爆炸，各研究领域正独立开发AI知识组织工具，本文呼吁建立跨学科协作机制，打破技术孤岛，共同构建高效的学术知识管理体系。
AI.motivation: 尽管AI工具不断涌现，但研究人员仍依赖手动方法，且各领域在构建学术知识库时缺乏交流，导致知识处理效率低下、资源碎片化，难以应对日益增长的学术文献压力。
AI.method: 本文旨在通过梳理当前学术知识组织面临的挑战，识别跨学科协作的契机，并构建一个框架来促进研究社区间的交流、方法共享及未来研究方向的规划。
AI.result: 提出了一个旨在打破学术社区孤岛的愿景，通过明确共享挑战和分类合作模式，为未来构建集成化的AI学术知识组织系统指明了方向。
AI.conclusion: 通过促进跨学科对话与协作，整合分散的方法与模型，是构建未来可扩展、动态且可查询的学术知识库的关键路径。
AI.translation: 尽管旨在支持学术知识提取和组织的工具越来越多，但许多研究人员仍依赖于手动方法，这有时是因为对现有技术不熟悉或缺乏针对特定领域的解决方案。与此同时，各学科科研论文的快速增长使得人们越来越难以跟上最新进展，这进一步凸显了对可扩展的、AI赋能的学术知识结构化和综合方法的迫切需求。各个研究社区已经开始独立解决这一挑战，开发旨在构建可靠、动态和可查询的学术知识库的工具和框架。然而，这些社区之间有限的互动阻碍了方法、模型和最佳实践的交流，减缓了向更集成化解决方案的进展。本手稿确定了促进跨学科对话、识别共同挑战、分类新的协作模式以及塑造学术知识与组织未来研究方向的方法。
AI.summary: 本文探讨了在学术文献激增的背景下，如何利用AI技术实现学术知识的结构化与合成。针对当前研究社区间缺乏交流、工具碎片化的问题，文章提出了促进跨学科对话的策略，旨在通过共享方法与实践，推动构建更高效、动态的学术知识库。
AI.keywords: 人工智能, 学术知识组织, 跨学科合作, 知识图谱, 知识合成
AI.comments: 该论文具有重要的前瞻性，指出了当前学术知识处理领域的碎片化问题，并强调了跨学科交流对构建通用、高效AI工具的重要性。其局限在于目前尚处于倡议阶段，具体的技术实现路径和跨社区协作机制仍需后续研究进一步明确。

title: From Construction to Injection: Edit-Based Fingerprints for Large Language Models
summary: Reliable model fingerprints are essential for protecting large language models (LLMs) against unauthorized redistribution and commercial misuse. In black-box deployment, verification is hindered by defensive filtering of suspected fingerprint queries, as well as by downstream model modifications that may weaken embedded ownership evidence. These risks require fingerprints to be robust in both construction and injection. For construction, prior paradigms face an imperceptibility trade-off: natural-language fingerprints may be accidentally activated, whereas garbled fingerprints are statistically exposed and easier to filter. For injection, existing methods struggle to preserve persistent trigger--target behaviors under model modification. We propose an end-to-end injected fingerprinting framework to address these challenges. Code-mixing Fingerprints (CF) use lowest-perplexity code-mixing under a high-complexity constraint to mitigate this two-sided imperceptibility trade-off. Multi-Candidate Editing (MCEdit) constructs structurally redundant, margin-separated trigger--target mappings to enable graceful degradation under model modification. Extensive evaluations on imperceptibility, detectability, and harmlessness demonstrate robust ownership verification with negligible impact on utility.

AI.title_translation: 从构建到注入：大型语言模型的基于编辑的指纹技术
AI.tldr: 提出了一种新型LLM指纹框架，通过代码混淆和冗余编辑策略，有效提升了模型版权保护在黑盒环境下的隐蔽性与抗修改鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有的LLM指纹技术在黑盒部署中面临防御性过滤和下游模型修改的挑战，且在指纹构造的隐蔽性与注入的鲁棒性之间存在难以调和的权衡。
AI.method: 提出了一种端到端的指纹嵌入框架，包含两个核心组件：一是“代码混淆指纹（CF）”，利用低困惑度代码混淆来平衡不可见性；二是“多候选编辑（MCEdit）”，通过构造结构冗余和边界分离的触发-目标映射，增强模型修改后的鲁棒性。
AI.result: 实验证明，该方法在保持模型实用性的前提下，不仅实现了极高的隐蔽性和低可检测性，还能在模型遭受修改时保持稳健的版权验证能力。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的CF和MCEdit框架能够有效地在黑盒部署环境下实现稳健的LLM版权指纹嵌入，且在保持模型原有性能的同时具备极高的隐蔽性和抗干扰能力。
AI.translation: 可靠的模型指纹对于保护大型语言模型（LLM）免受未经授权的重新分发和商业滥用至关重要。在黑盒部署中，验证过程受到对疑似指纹查询的防御性过滤以及可能削弱嵌入所有权证据的下游模型修改的阻碍。这些风险要求指纹在构建和注入方面都必须具备鲁棒性。在构建方面，先前的范式面临着不可见性的权衡：自然语言指纹可能会被意外激活，而乱码指纹则在统计上容易暴露且更容易被过滤。在注入方面，现有方法难以在模型修改下保持持久的触发-目标行为。我们提出了一个端到端的注入式指纹框架来应对这些挑战。代码混淆指纹（CF）在高复杂度约束下使用最低困惑度的代码混淆，以缓解这种双向的不可见性权衡。多候选编辑（MCEdit）构建结构冗余、边界分离的触发-目标映射，以实现模型修改下的平滑降级。对不可见性、可检测性和无害性的广泛评估表明，该方法能够实现稳健的所有权验证，且对模型效用几乎没有影响。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种针对大型语言模型（LLM）的端到端指纹嵌入框架，通过代码混淆指纹（CF）和多候选编辑（MCEdit）技术，解决了现有指纹方案在黑盒部署中易受过滤及模型修改影响的难题，实现了隐蔽性、鲁棒性与模型性能之间的最优平衡。
AI.keywords: 大型语言模型, 模型指纹, 版权保护, 代码混淆, 鲁棒性
AI.comments: 该研究巧妙地平衡了大型语言模型水印的不可见性与鲁棒性之间的权衡，通过引入代码混淆和冗余编辑策略，为模型版权保护提供了更具弹性的方案。其局限性可能在于对不同语言或特定领域模型的泛化能力需进一步验证。

title: More Parameters Than Populations: A Systematic Literature Review of Large Language Models within Survey Research
comments: This working paper is outdated as of June 2026 - please refer to the full version with substantive changes here: https://doi.org/10.31235/osf.io/eubj4_v1 This work was presented at NLPOR 2025 (non-archival): https://openreview.net/forum?id=0Hxhwa56Yg
summary: [Working Paper] Survey research has a long-standing history of being a human-powered field, but one that embraces various technologies for the collection, processing, and analysis of various behavioral, political, and social outcomes of interest, among others. At the same time, Large Language Models (LLMs) bring new technological challenges and prerequisites in order to fully harness their potential. In this paper, we report work-in-progress on a systematic literature review based on keyword searches from multiple large-scale databases as well as citation networks that assesses how LLMs are currently being applied within the survey research process. We synthesize and organize our findings according to the survey research process to include examples of LLM usage across three broad phases: pre-data collection, data collection, and post-data collection. We discuss selected examples of potential use cases for LLMs as well as its pitfalls based on examples from existing literature. Considering survey research has rich experience and history regarding data quality, we discuss some opportunities and describe future outlooks for survey research to contribute to the continued development and refinement of LLMs.

AI.title_translation: 参数多于人口：调查研究中大型语言模型的系统性文献综述
AI.tldr: 本文综述了大型语言模型在调查研究各阶段的应用现状、潜在风险及未来贡献方向。
AI.motivation: 随着大语言模型（LLM）的兴起，调查研究领域面临着如何利用这些新技术提升研究潜力的挑战与需求，需要系统梳理LLM在调查研究中的应用现状与局限。
AI.method: 通过关键词搜索多个大型数据库及引用网络，进行系统性文献综述，并按调查研究的三个阶段（数据收集前、数据收集、数据收集后）对发现进行综合与分类。
AI.result: 研究梳理了LLM在调查研究三个阶段的多种应用案例与潜在缺陷，并强调了调查研究在提升LLM数据质量和模型完善方面的独特价值。
AI.conclusion: LLM在调查研究的全流程中具有广泛的应用潜力，但其应用必须建立在严谨的数据质量评估基础之上，调查研究领域在规范LLM应用方面大有可为。
AI.translation: [工作论文] 调查研究作为一个长期由人工驱动的领域，一直以来都在采用各种技术来收集、处理和分析行为、政治和社会结果等。与此同时，大型语言模型（LLM）带来了新的技术挑战和先决条件，以充分发挥其潜力。在本文中，我们报告了一项关于系统性文献综述的进展，该综述基于多个大型数据库的关键词搜索以及引用网络，评估了LLM目前在调查研究过程中的应用情况。我们根据调查研究流程对研究结果进行了综合与组织，涵盖了LLM在三个广泛阶段的使用示例：数据收集前、数据收集和数据收集后。我们基于现有文献讨论了LLM的潜在用例及缺陷。考虑到调查研究在数据质量方面拥有丰富的经验和历史，我们讨论了一些机会，并描述了调查研究为LLM的持续开发和完善做出贡献的未来前景。
AI.summary: 本文是一篇关于大型语言模型（LLM）在调查研究中应用的系统性文献综述。研究通过分析多数据库文献，将LLM的应用划分为数据收集前、收集过程中及收集后三个阶段，探讨了其应用潜力与面临的陷阱，并指出了调查研究领域对改进LLM模型开发的贡献方向。
AI.keywords: 大型语言模型, 调查研究, 系统性文献综述, 数据质量, 技术应用
AI.comments: 该综述填补了LLM在调查研究领域应用的知识空白，通过系统性梳理三个阶段的应用案例与潜在风险，为未来研究提供了框架。其创新性在于将新兴的AI技术与传统的调查方法论相结合，强调了交叉学科的潜力。

title: A Cycle Walk for Sampling Measures on Spanning Forests for Redistricting
comments: 34 pages, 13 figures; Updated version with corrected text and figures
summary:
We introduce the Cycle Walk, a new Markov chain Monte Carlo method for sampling distributions on balanced graph partitions, motivated by applications in political redistricting. The method operates on spanning forests and combines two types of updates: local "cycle" moves within districts and global moves that exchange population between adjacent districts while preserving balance constraints. This construction enables efficient Metropolis--Hastings correction while allowing proposals at multiple spatial scales.
  We show that the Cycle Walk naturally interpolates between existing approaches based on local updates and a class of global update methods derived from recombination (RECOM). Through a range of numerical experiments on synthetic graphs and real-world precinct data, we demonstrate that the Cycle Walk exhibits improved empirical convergence diagnostics for distributions that place weaker weight on spanning-tree counts, a regime that is challenging for existing methods. In particular, the algorithm remains effective when incorporating alternative compactness measures that more closely reflect policy-relevant criteria.
  These results suggest that the Cycle Walk provides a flexible and computationally efficient framework for sampling from a broader class of redistricting distributions than previously accessible with MCMC techniques.
comment: 34 pages, 13 figures; Updated version with corrected text and figures

AI.title_translation: 一种用于选区划分生成树森林测度采样的循环游走方法
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新的 MCMC 采样算法“Cycle Walk”，通过结合局部和全局移动，有效解决了选区划分中不同紧凑度测度下的采样收敛难题。
AI.motivation: 现有的选区划分采样方法在处理特定的紧凑度度量或不同权重分布时存在收敛困难，需要一种能够跨尺度采样并保持平衡约束的更灵活方法。
AI.method: Cycle Walk 算法，一种基于生成树森林的马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛方法。它结合了区内局部“循环”移动和区际人口交换的全局移动，同时采用 Metropolis-Hastings 修正以确保采样正确性。
AI.result: 数值实验表明，Cycle Walk 在合成图和真实数据上表现出更好的经验收敛性，特别是在对生成树计数权重较弱的分布中，且能有效整合更符合政策标准的紧凑度度量。
AI.conclusion: Cycle Walk 算法为选区划分的分布采样提供了一个灵活且高效的框架，能够处理比现有 MCMC 技术更广泛的分布类型，特别是在处理具有挑战性的紧凑度度量时表现优异。
AI.translation: 我们引入了“循环游走”（Cycle Walk），这是一种用于平衡图划分分布采样的全新马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛方法，其灵感来源于政治选区划分的应用。该方法在生成树森林上运行，并结合了两种类型的更新：区内的局部“循环”移动，以及在保持平衡约束的前提下交换相邻区之间人口的全局移动。这种结构在允许跨空间尺度提议的同时，实现了高效的 Metropolis-Hastings 修正。我们证明了 Cycle Walk 自然地在基于局部更新的现有方法与一类源自重组（RECOM）的全局更新方法之间进行了插值。通过在合成图和真实选区数据上的一系列数值实验，我们证明了对于那些对生成树计数权重较弱的分布（这是现有方法面临挑战的领域），Cycle Walk 表现出了改进的经验收敛诊断。特别是，当结合更能反映政策相关标准的替代紧凑度度量时，该算法依然有效。这些结果表明，Cycle Walk 为从比现有 MCMC 技术可访问范围更广的选区划分分布中进行采样，提供了一个灵活且计算高效的框架。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了一种名为“Cycle Walk”的新型 MCMC 采样方法，专门用于平衡图划分（如政治选区划分）。该方法基于生成树森林，通过结合局部循环更新和全局人口交换移动，实现了跨空间尺度的采样，在保证平衡约束的同时提高了计算效率，并在处理多种紧凑度度量时展现出优于现有方法的收敛性能。
AI.keywords: 选区划分, MCMC, 生成树森林, 马尔可夫链, 采样方法
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种创新的马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛（MCMC）采样方法，弥补了现有局部更新和全局重组（RECOM）方法之间的空缺。其核心贡献在于通过引入跨尺度的循环移动，在保持平衡约束的同时，提高了在不同紧凑度度量下的收敛效率，对政治选区划分问题具有重要的实际应用价值。

title: TASC: Task-Aware Shared Control for Relational Telemanipulation
summary: We present TASC, a Task-Aware Shared Control framework for relational telemanipulation that infers task-level user intent and provides assistance from motion-only input. To support prehensile relational tasks without predefined templates, TASC constructs an open-vocabulary interaction graph from visual input to represent functional object relationships, and infers user intent accordingly. A shared control policy then provides assistance during both grasping and object interaction, guided by spatial constraints predicted by a vision-language model. Our method addresses two key challenges in relational telemanipulation under shared control: (1) task-level intent inference from low-level motion commands, and (2) generalizable assistance across diverse objects and tasks. Experiments in both simulation and the real world demonstrate that TASC improves task efficiency and reduces user input effort compared to prior methods, while enabling zero-shot generalization across diverse relational telemanipulation tasks. The code that supports our experiments is publicly available at https://github.com/fitz0401/tasc.

title: X-ray imaging from nonlinear waves: numerical reconstruction of a cubic nonlinearity
comments: 26 pages, 10 figures. Revised version based on peer-review feedback with improvements to Theorem 1, an addition of Theorem 2, and an additional figure in the time-dependent case
summary: We study an inverse boundary value problem for the nonlinear wave equation in $2 + 1$ dimensions. The objective is to recover an unknown potential $q(x, t)$ from the associated Dirichlet-to-Neumann map using real-valued waves. We propose a direct numerical reconstruction method for the Radon transform of $q$, which can then be inverted using standard X-ray tomography techniques to determine $q$. Our implementation introduces a spectral regularization procedure to stabilize the numerical differentiation step required in the reconstruction, improving robustness with respect to noise in the boundary data. We give rigorous justification and optimal stability estimates for the regularized spectral differentiation of noisy measurements, which may be of independent interest. Numerical experiments demonstrate the feasibility of recovering potentials from boundary measurements of nonlinear waves and illustrate the advantages of the Radon-based reconstruction.
